title: Full-Stack Website Developer for UK Accommodation and Relocation Platform – Two-Phase Project
description:
**Job Title: Full-Stack Website Developer for UK Accommodation and Relocation Platform – Two-Phase Project**

We are looking for an experienced full-stack website developer or small development agency to design and build a professional website for a UK accommodation and relocation company.

Our business arranges short- and medium-term accommodation for:

* Companies booking accommodation for employees and contractors
* Construction and project teams
* Corporate relocations
* Insurance and temporary housing requirements
* Organisations requiring accommodation across the UK

We also work with serviced accommodation operators and property providers who can fulfil client booking requirements.

The project will be completed in two phases.

**Phase 1 – Lead-Generation and Marketing Website**

The first phase should be simple, professional and focused on generating enquiries. We want to launch relatively quickly and begin using the website for sales, marketing and outreach.

The Phase 1 website should include:

* Professional, modern and mobile-responsive design
* Home page with a strong value proposition
* Corporate and contractor accommodation page
* Insurance and temporary relocation accommodation page
* Property/provider partner page
* About Us page
* Contact page
* Corporate accommodation booking enquiry form
* Property provider registration form
* Clear calls to action throughout the website
* Testimonials or case-study section
* Frequently Asked Questions
* Privacy Policy and Terms links
* Basic cookie consent and UK GDPR compliance
* Google Analytics and Search Console setup
* Basic technical and on-page SEO
* Fast loading times
* Secure hosting and SSL setup
* An easy content management system so we can update text, images and pages ourselves
* Form submissions sent to our business email and stored securely
* Basic spam protection
* Social media and LinkedIn links

The website must be structured so that Phase 2 can be added without requiring the Phase 1 website to be rebuilt.

We prefer a straightforward and manageable technology setup. Please avoid recommending multiple systems, subscriptions or integrations unless they provide a clear benefit.

**Phase 2 – Full-Stack Accommodation Platform**

Phase 2 will be developed once the business has generated more leads and the detailed workflow has been confirmed.

Potential Phase 2 functionality may include:

* Secure accounts for corporate clients and property providers
* Property provider dashboard
* Corporate client dashboard
* Provider onboarding and document uploads
* Property listing and management
* Accommodation availability
* Booking request management
* Matching client requirements with suitable properties
* Booking status tracking
* Admin dashboard
* Email notifications and automated updates
* Document and invoice management
* Secure payment functionality
* Reporting and commission tracking
* CRM, accounting or channel-manager integrations if required
* Different user roles and permissions

The final Phase 2 requirements will be agreed separately. However, the developer must consider the future platform when recommending the technology and architecture for Phase 1.

**What We Will Provide**

We can provide:

* Business branding and logo
* Business information and contact details
* Examples of websites we like
* Details of our services and target customers
* Existing business policies and procedures
* Feedback and approvals throughout the project

We would also welcome support with improving the website structure, customer journey and wording where appropriate.

**Required Experience**

Applicants should have experience in:

* Full-stack website development
* Modern, responsive website design
* Lead-generation websites
* Secure forms and data handling
* Content management systems
* SEO-friendly development
* Building scalable websites that can later support user accounts, dashboards and databases
* UK GDPR and cookie-consent requirements
* Testing websites across desktop, tablet and mobile devices

Experience with booking platforms, property technology, serviced accommodation, travel, relocation, marketplaces or client/provider portals would be beneficial.

**Important Requirements**

The successful developer must:

* Recommend a suitable and scalable technology stack
* Explain the proposed setup in plain English
* Keep the initial system simple and cost-effective
* Provide full ownership of the website, source code, domain configuration and relevant accounts
* Ensure the business is not permanently dependent on the developer
* Provide documentation and a complete handover
* Include a reasonable post-launch support period
* Confirm that all work will be original and appropriately licensed
* Maintain confidentiality regarding our business model, systems and customer information

**Please Include in Your Proposal**

Please answer the following questions:

1. What technology stack would you recommend for Phase 1 and why?
2. How would you ensure Phase 1 can be expanded into the Phase 2 platform?
3. Have you built a similar accommodation, property, travel, marketplace or booking website?
4. Please provide two or three relevant examples of your work.
5. Which features would you include in Phase 1 and which would you postpone?
6. How long would Phase 1 take?
7. What is your fixed-price quotation for Phase 1?
8. Please provide a separate preliminary estimate for Phase 2, understanding that the final specification will be agreed later.
9. What ongoing hosting, software or subscription costs would be required?
10. What support and warranty period would you provide after launch?
11. Will we receive full ownership of the source code, designs, accounts and website?
12. Who will personally complete the work, and will any part be subcontracted?

Please begin your proposal with the words **“TWO-PHASE WEBSITE”** so we know you have read the complete brief.

We are looking for someone who can build Phase 1 professionally and potentially work with us on Phase 2 and future improvements as the business grows.

title: [LATAM Remote] Earn $4/hr Recording Everyday Household Activities
description:
Looking for a simple, flexible project you can complete entirely from home?

We are hiring participants across Latin America to collect video datasets for AI model training. Your role is straight to the point: record authentic, first-person (POV) clips of regular home routines you already do every day.

Zero acting, no video editing, no scripts, and no social media posting required.

 Compensation & Flexibility
Hourly Rate: $4.00 USD per approved hour of video footage.

Total Earning Potential: Up to 100 approved hours (Earn up to $400 USD).

Schedule: 100% self-paced—record on your own time with zero daily minimums or caps.

 Tasks You Will Record
Short, unscripted footage showing a first-person perspective (POV) of your hands doing:

 Drinks & Food Prep: Making coffee, brewing tea, preparing snacks, cooking meals, or baking.

 Cleaning & Organizing: Wiping countertops, cleaning tables, or tidying up rooms.

 Pet Care: Feeding, grooming, or taking care of your dog.

Daily Routines: Any other standard household activities.

🛑 STRICT HARDWARE REQUIREMENT
⚠️ Please review this section carefully before submitting your proposal.

To qualify, your phone MUST be one of the exact models listed below. Unlisted devices (such as Samsung A-series, FE models, Lite versions, or older iPhones) are NOT supported.

SUPPORTED SMARTPHONES:

Apple iPhone:

iPhone 12, 13, 14, and 15 Series (Base, Mini, Plus, Pro, Pro Max)

iPhone 16 & 17 Series (EXCEPT 16e and 17e)

Samsung Galaxy:

Galaxy S21 through S26 Series (Base, Plus, Ultra)

Google Pixel:

Pixel 6 through 9 Series (Base and Pro models)

 MANDATORY APPLICATION QUESTIONS
Please include answers to these 3 questions in your response to be considered:

What is your EXACT smartphone model? (e.g., iPhone 13 Pro, Samsung S22)

What country and city are you located in?

Roughly how many hours per week can you record?

(Proposals without the exact phone model will be rejected automatically).

I have seen my grandparents, neighbors, parents and in-laws getting frustrated trying to use the multibuttoned TV remote control’s that every TV has these days -- and even more so if there are multiple remotes.  I would like a video that outlines the problem and shows a proposed solution – a remote that has only two knobs, two buttons and one switch.
The purpose of this video is to get feedback from potential customers before I commit to development.
Please do not respond if you have not read the attachment.  Thank you!

title: Looking for Recruiters & Staffing Agency Owners to Test an AI Automation
description:
I’m looking for recruiters, staffing agency owners, recruiting managers, and talent acquisition professionals who are interested in using AI to automate repetitive work in their recruiting or staffing process.

I’ll build a custom AI automation for your recruiting business at no cost, and you’ll receive $50 for your time testing it and providing honest feedback.

Potential automations include:

* Candidate screening and qualification
* Candidate follow-up and re-engagement
* Interview scheduling
* Resume/CV intake and processing
* Candidate data entry and ATS updates
* New applicant responses
* Candidate status updates
* Client or hiring-manager updates
* Candidate sourcing workflows
* Internal administrative workflows
* Other repetitive processes specific to your recruiting business

How it works

We’ll have a short call to understand your current workflow and identify one useful repetitive process to automate.

I’ll build the system, you’ll test it in your actual workflow, and we’ll have a short follow-up to discuss what worked, what didn’t, and what you’d change.

If you’re happy with the result, I’d also like permission to feature your honest feedback as a testimonial or case study on our website.

To apply, please include:

* Your company or agency website
* Your role
* Type of recruiting/staffing you do
* Approximate number of candidates or placements you handle

title: Automation Engineer – 2-Month Contract
description:
Position: Freelance Automation Engineer 
Duration: 2 months (full-time, ~100–160 hours)
Scope: Complete automation control system design for HFFS packaging line


Project Overview:

Design and implement a complete automation control system for a packaging line featuring an HFFS (Horizontal Form Fill Seal) machine, conveyor system, and labeling machine. You'll work independently on electrical design, PLC programming, machine integration, and system commissioning—with a focus on PLC-to-server communication and predictive maintenance in Month 2.


Core Responsibilities:

1) Electrical & Sensor Design:

- Design electrical control panel (motor starters, VFDs, safety relays, circuit protection).
- Specify and integrate sensors (proximity, pressure, temperature, speed, photo-eye).
- Plan PLC I/O layout and signal conditioning.

2) PLC Programming & Integration

- Write core PLC program for HFFS → Conveyor → Labeling sequencing.
- Implement speed synchronization and safety interlocks
Program PLC-to-PLC communication (Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP, Profibus, etc.).
- Develop error detection and recovery logic.

3) Documentation & Support

- Create operator manuals, technician guides, and troubleshooting procedures.
- Write maintenance plans (preventive, predictive, spare parts).
- Provide post-launch support.


Required Qualifications:

- 3+ years automation engineering experience.
- PLC programming: Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Mitsubishi (or equivalent)
- Electrical design: Motor control, VFD integration, safety circuits, panel layout
- Sensor integration: Proximity, pressure, temperature, speed sensors
- Packaging machinery experience (HFFS or similar intermittent production equipment)
- PLC-to-PLC communication (Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP, Profibus, etc.)
- Speed synchronization and timing logic expertise
- Strong troubleshooting and commissioning skills
- Excellent technical documentation abilities

title: Experienced Feature Film Producer Needed
description:
We are seeking an experienced independent feature film producer to come aboard a drama/dark comedy feature set in Los Angeles, currently in development.

The project currently has approximately $250K in director-backed financing, with a Director, Executive Producer, Producer, Casting Director, and Director of Photography attached. We are looking to build the right producing team and financing strategy around the project.

We are specifically looking for someone who has produced independently financed feature films in roughly the $400K–$3M range and has a verifiable track record helping projects secure financing, recognizable cast attachments, sales/distribution relationships, or major festival placement.

The ideal producer will have experience with:

* Raising or closing independent feature financing
* Investor and production company relationships
* Packaging projects and attaching recognizable actors
* Working with sales agents, distributors, or financiers
* Producing films that have played major or respected international festivals

Priority will be given to producers whose films have been selected by major international festivals.

Please include links to features you have produced, their approximate budget ranges, and a brief explanation of your involvement.

We are not looking for general film consultants, pitch salesmen, fundraising services, or lead-generation services. We are specifically interested in producers with direct, verifiable feature-film experience.

Applicants must have professional producing experience on at least one feature with a budget of around $100K or higher.

Compensation and producing terms will be discussed with selected candidates based on experience and level of involvement.

title: CRM Reactivation Expert — GHL, SMS/A2P | Real Estate & Home Services
description:
CCRM Reactivation Expert — GHL, SMS/A2P | Real Estate & Home Services

Job Description

Technologies NOW is an AI-powered client acquisition and business automation agency building a scalable CRM reactivation service for real estate, home services, and other high-value service businesses.

We are looking for an experienced CRM Reactivation & Automation Expert who can help us implement, launch, manage, and improve systems that turn dormant CRM contacts and old leads into qualified conversations and booked appointments.

Our immediate priority is CRM/database reactivation, SMS automation, A2P/10DLC compliance, email automation, workflow development, and dependable client fulfillment.

This is a hands-on implementation role, not a strategy-only position. We need someone who can get into the CRM, understand the data, build the workflows, configure compliant outreach, test everything end-to-end, troubleshoot problems, and help us develop repeatable systems we can deploy across multiple clients.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

You may be responsible for:

Building and launching CRM/database reactivation campaigns
Importing, cleaning, mapping, and segmenting client databases
Identifying dormant leads and creating appropriate reactivation segments
Configuring pipelines, stages, opportunities, tags, custom fields, and lead routing
Building SMS reactivation and follow-up automations
Building email reactivation and nurture sequences
Creating rapid lead-response workflows
Creating qualification and appointment-booking workflows
Configuring calendars, confirmations, reminders, and no-show follow-up
Building sales handoff and longer-term follow-up processes
Working within a client's existing CRM or integrating it with GoHighLevel when appropriate
Testing the entire process before live deployment
Troubleshooting workflow, data, integration, routing, and deliverability problems
Documenting SOPs and repeatable fulfillment processes
Assisting with client onboarding and implementation
Working with APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar tools when needed
SMS Automation & A2P/10DLC

Hands-on SMS automation and A2P/10DLC experience is an important requirement for this role.

You should have practical experience with areas such as:

A2P/10DLC brand and campaign registration
GoHighLevel / LeadConnector SMS setup
Twilio or similar messaging infrastructure
SMS opt-in and consent requirements
Marketing vs. transactional/non-marketing messaging
STOP, HELP, and opt-out handling
Suppression of opted-out contacts
Forms and booking pages that capture appropriate SMS consent
Privacy Policy and Terms requirements related to SMS registration
A2P campaign use cases and sample messages
Troubleshooting rejected A2P campaigns
Phone-number configuration
Building workflows that respect consent and opt-out status

You do not need to provide legal advice, but you should understand the practical compliance requirements necessary to deploy SMS campaigns responsibly and successfully.

CRM & Industry Experience

Strong GoHighLevel experience is highly desirable.

Experience with CRMs commonly used in real estate and home services is particularly valuable, including:

Follow Up Boss
kvCORE
BoomTown
Real Geeks

description:
## 🇩🇪 Deutsche Fassung

### Virtuelle Assistenz für Dental-Marketing-Agentur (DACH) – langfristig, remote

#### Über uns

Wir sind die einzige Agentur im deutschsprachigen Raum, die sich ausschließlich auf Google-Sichtbarkeit und patientenorientiertes Webdesign für Zahnarztpraxen spezialisiert hat. Über 200 erfolgreiche Projekte, 4,9 Sterne bei 77 Google-Bewertungen, Standorte in Berlin und Uster (CH), Team komplett remote.

Unsere Kunden sind Zahnarztpraxen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. Wir betreuen sie mit Google Ads, lokaler Sichtbarkeit (Google Unternehmensprofil), Website-Relaunches und SEO-Texten.

Wir sind ein kleines, stark automatisiertes Team. Vieles läuft bei uns bereits über eigene Tools, Templates und Automatisierungen. Du arbeitest diese bestehenden Prozesse zuverlässig und sauber ab – und denkst dabei mit, wo etwas besser laufen könnte.

---

#### Deine Aufgaben

**1. Google Unternehmensprofil – dein Hauptbereich**
- Optimierung von Google-Unternehmensprofilen nach unserer Checkliste
- Regelmäßige Veröffentlichung von Beiträgen auf Deutsch nach Vorlage
- Beantwortung von Patientenrezensionen nach Freigabe-Templates
- Pflege und Aktualisierung von Profildaten über mehrere Standorte hinweg
- Dokumentation aller Maßnahmen in unserem internen Dashboard

**2. Textproduktion nach System**
- Zusammenstellung von Expertenprofilen, Zielgruppentexten, Ablaufbeschreibungen und Leistungsvorteilen über unser Template- und Platzhaltersystem in Google Sheets
- Recherche der benötigten Ausgangsinformationen (Praxis-Website, Arztprofile, Onboarding-Unterlagen)
- Das Textgerüst existiert bereits. Du füllst es korrekt, sauber und in gutem Deutsch.

**3. Umsetzung von Praxis-Websites in WordPress**
- Eigenständiges Aufsetzen neuer Praxis-Websites auf Basis unseres bestehenden Templates
- Anlegen der Seitenstruktur und Einpflegen aller Inhalte: Texte, Bilder, Leistungsseiten, Team- und Kontaktseiten
- Eigenständige Layout- und Gestaltungsentscheidungen innerhalb der Möglichkeiten des Templates
- Erkennen, wann eine Anforderung über das Template hinausgeht, und saubere Übergabe an unseren Entwickler
- Laufende Pflege und Aktualisierung bestehender Kundenwebsites

**4. Reporting**
- Monatliche Aufbereitung von Kundenreports aus vorhandenen Datenquellen (Google Ads, Sichtbarkeits-Scans, Rankings)
- Übertragung der Daten in unsere Report-Vorlagen
- Terminierter Versand an Kunden nach Freigabe
- Nachhalten, welche Reports raus sind und welche noch offen sind

**5. Schriftliche Kundenkommunikation**
- Beantwortung eingehender Kunden-E-Mails im Rahmen definierter Standardfälle
- Nachfassen bei Kunden zu ausstehenden Unterlagen, Zugängen, Freigaben und Terminen
- Terminkoordination
- **Nicht Teil der Rolle:** Telefonate oder Video-Calls mit Kunden.

**6. Zuarbeit & Datenpflege**
- Bildaufbereitung: Auswahl, Umbenennung, WebP-Konvertierung für Websites
- Pflege von Statuslisten, Deadlines und Aufgaben in unserem internen Dashboard
- Ablage und Strukturierung von Kundenunterlagen in Google Drive

---

#### So arbeiten wir

Unser Alltag läuft über drei Kerntools. Du solltest damit sicher umgehen oder dich schnell einarbeiten können:

- **Google Workspace** – Drive, Docs, Sheets und Forms. Der Großteil deiner Arbeit findet hier statt: Templates, Checklisten, Reportvorlagen, Kundenablage.
- **Slack** – unsere gesamte interne Kommunikation. Kurze Wege, schnelle Rückfragen, keine langen Meetings.
- **Notion** – Aufgaben, Deadlines und Dokumentation.

Dazu kommen WordPress, Google Unternehmensprofil, Google Ads und unsere eigenen internen Tools.

Wir arbeiten außerdem stark KI-gestützt. Wer ChatGPT, Claude oder vergleichbare Tools im Alltag einsetzt, ist bei uns deutlich schneller unterwegs.

---

#### Das musst du mitbringen

- **Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser**, schriftlich einwandfrei. Deine Texte gehen ungefiltert an Ärzte.
- **Erfahrung im B2B-Umfeld** – idealerweise Agentur, Dienstleister oder Beratung. Wir brauchen jemanden, der professionelle Geschäftskommunikation gewohnt ist.
- **Sicherer Umgang mit WordPress.** Du kannst eine Website auf Basis eines bestehenden Templates eigenständig aufsetzen, Seiten anlegen, Inhalte einpflegen und dabei ein sauberes, stimmiges Ergebnis liefern – ohne dass jemand hinterherräumen muss.
- **Grundlegende Praxis mit dem Google Unternehmensprofil.** Du hast schon selbst Profile bearbeitet – Einträge angelegt, Daten geändert, Beiträge oder Rezensionsantworten veröffentlicht. Ein durchoptimiertes Profil musst du nicht vorweisen können, aber die Oberfläche sollte für dich Routine sein.
- **Grundverständnis von Google-Rankings und lokaler Sichtbarkeit.** Begriffe wie Local Pack, Google-Maps-Ranking oder Ranking-Check sollten für dich keine Fremdwörter sein, und du hast idealerweise schon einmal selbst geprüft, wo eine Website oder ein Profil rankt.
- **Eigenverantwortung.** Du bekommst ein Ziel und arbeitest es ab. Fehlt eine Information, suchst du sie selbst. Fällt dir ein Problem auf, meldest du es, bevor es eskaliert.
- **Verbindlichkeit bei Terminen und Deadlines.** Vereinbarte Termine hältst du. Wenn etwas dazwischenkommt, sagst du früh und über den richtigen Kanal Bescheid.
- **Vorausschauende Abwesenheitsplanung.** Urlaub ist bei uns ausdrücklich erwünscht und wird nicht schiefangesehen – Erholung gehört dazu. Was wir brauchen: rechtzeitige Ankündigung längerer Abwesenheiten und offene Aufgaben, die vorher abgeschlossen oder sauber übergeben sind.
- **Tägliche Erreichbarkeit per E-Mail und Slack.** Du prüfst deine Kanäle selbstständig, ohne dass jemand nachhaken muss.
- **Ausgeprägte digitale Affinität.** Neue Tools schrecken dich nicht ab, du arbeitest dich selbstständig ein und brauchst keine Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitung für jede Software.
- **Sorgfalt vor Geschwindigkeit.** Unsere Kunden prüfen unsere Arbeit teilweise sehr genau.
- **Überschneidende Arbeitszeiten mit MEZ**, mindestens 4 Stunden täglich.
- **Interesse an einer langfristigen, mit der Zeit intensiveren Zusammenarbeit.** Du solltest deine Kapazität in den kommenden Monaten auf Vollzeit ausbauen können und dich auf wenige Auftraggeber konzentrieren wollen.

#### Von Vorteil

- **Erfahrung mit der systematischen Optimierung von Google-Unternehmensprofilen** – Kategorien, Attribute, Leistungseinträge, Profil-Merges, Reinstatements
- Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, Dental- oder Ärztemarketing
- Praxis mit Ranking-Tools und lokalem SEO
- Ein gutes Auge für Layout und Typografie
- Grundverständnis von Google Ads
- Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools wie n8n oder Zapier

---

#### Was wir bieten

- Langfristige, planbare Zusammenarbeit statt Einzelaufträge
- Klar dokumentierte Prozesse, Templates und Checklisten – du startest nicht bei null
- Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den beiden Gründern, kurze Wege
- Wachsender Verantwortungsbereich bei guter Zusammenarbeit
- Remote, freie Zeiteinteilung innerhalb der Kernüberschneidung

**Umfang:** Wir starten mit ca. 15–20 Stunden pro Woche. Diese Rolle ist aber ausdrücklich zum Mitwachsen gedacht: Wenn die Zusammenarbeit passt, geben wir kontinuierlich mehr Aufgaben und Verantwortung ab – auf 40 Stunden und perspektivisch darüber hinaus.

Deshalb ist uns wichtig, dass du diese Kapazität mittelfristig auch frei machen kannst. Wir suchen eine feste Zusammenarbeit, die über Jahre trägt, und möchten die Rolle nicht in sechs Monaten erneut besetzen müssen, weil auf deiner Seite kein Platz mehr ist.

---

#### Ablauf der Bewerbung

1. Bewerbung mit Beantwortung der Screening-Fragen unten
2. Kurze bezahlte Testaufgabe (ca. 2–3 Stunden): Aufsetzen einer Beispielseite in unserem WordPress-Template plus Optimierung eines Google-Unternehmensprofils nach Checkliste
3. Video-Call mit uns
4. Start mit einem bezahlten Probemonat

**Bewerbungen ohne Beantwortung der Screening-Fragen werden nicht berücksichtigt.** Bitte antworte auf Deutsch.

---

#### Screening-Fragen

1. **Beschreibe in 3–5 Sätzen, was du bisher selbst in einem Google Unternehmensprofil gemacht hast.** Was hast du konkret bearbeitet oder verändert, und in welchem Zusammenhang?

2. **Hast du schon einmal eine Website in WordPress auf Basis eines vorhandenen Templates aufgesetzt?** Beschreibe kurz ein Beispiel: Was hast du übernommen, wo musstest du selbst gestalterisch entscheiden, und wo hast du an einen Entwickler übergeben? Ein Link zum Ergebnis ist willkommen.

3. **Für welche Art von Kunden hast du bisher gearbeitet – B2B oder B2C?** Nenne bitte ein konkretes Beispiel für ein B2B-Mandat und deine Rolle darin.

4. **Du sollst einen Text für die Leistungsseite einer Zahnarztpraxis zusammenstellen. In der Vorlage fehlt eine Information, die nur auf der Praxis-Website steht, und dein Ansprechpartner ist im Urlaub. Wie gehst du vor?** (Bitte konkret, nicht allgemein.)

5. **Beschreibe eine Situation, in der du einen vereinbarten Termin oder eine Deadline nicht halten konntest.** Wie hast du reagiert, wen hast du wann informiert und über welchen Kanal?

6. **Welche digitalen Tools und KI-Tools nutzt du in deinem Arbeitsalltag – und wofür konkret?**

7. **Schreibe zwei bis drei Sätze auf Deutsch, mit denen du auf eine 3-Sterne-Google-Rezension einer Zahnarztpraxis antworten würdest, in der ein Patient lange Wartezeit kritisiert, die Behandlung aber lobt.**

8. **Wie viele Stunden pro Woche stehen dir zur Verfügung und in welcher Zeitzone arbeitest du?** Für wie viele Auftraggeber arbeitest du aktuell parallel – und könntest du deine Stunden für uns innerhalb der nächsten Monate auf Vollzeit ausbauen?

title: Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are seeking a highly qualified, organized, and communicative **Chemistry Tutor & Academic Accountability Coach** to support a college **pre-med student** in achieving academic success.

This position is more than traditional tutoring. The ideal candidate will provide strong **college-level Chemistry instruction while also serving as an accountability and organizational coach** to help the student manage coursework, establish effective study habits, stay organized, and remain on track with academic goals.

The ideal candidate will be a **college student, graduate student, or recent graduate with a strong background in Chemistry, Biology, or another science-related field**, preferably with experience in a pre-medical academic environment.

Key Responsibilities

1.Chemistry Tutoring college-level Chemistry.
* Explain challenging chemistry concepts clearly and effectively.
* Assist with homework, assignments, labs, quizzes, and exam preparation.
* Identify academic weaknesses and develop strategies to strengthen understanding.
* Help the student develop effective problem-solving and test-taking skills.
* Prepare the student for upcoming exams and major assignments.

2. Academic Accountability & Organization

* Help the student create and maintain a weekly academic schedule.
* Assist with organizing assignments, exams, projects, and study sessions.
* Help prioritize competing academic responsibilities.
* Establish weekly academic goals and follow up on progress.
* Hold the student accountable for completing agreed-upon tasks and study goals.
* Help develop consistent study routines and time-management skills.
* Conduct regular check-ins to review what was completed, what remains outstanding, and what needs to be adjusted.
* Help the student avoid procrastination and stay ahead of deadlines.
* Encourage independence, responsibility, and ownership of academic performance.

Qualifications
Strong Chemistry background with the ability to tutor college-level Chemistry.**
* Experience working with college students is strongly preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to explain difficult concepts in a clear, patient, and engaging manner.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Ability to provide constructive accountability without being overly controlling.
* Reliable, professional, punctual, and consistent.
* Comfortable working with a high-achieving student in a demanding pre-medical academic program.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build a positive working relationship with the student.

 Preferred Background

* Current or former **pre-med, medical, science, Chemistry, Biology, or related major**.
* Strong academic performance in Chemistry.
* Previous tutoring, academic coaching, mentoring, or teaching experience.
* Experience with **General Chemistry and Organic Chemistry** is highly preferred.
* Familiarity with the academic demands and course requirements commonly associated with pre-med students.

### Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is **academically strong, highly organized, an excellent communicator, and comfortable providing both instruction and accountability**.

This person should be able to say, *"Let's figure out what you need to accomplish this week, create a plan, and then make sure you follow through."*

The goal is not simply to help the student pass Chemistry. The goal is to help the student develop the **organization, discipline, study habits, and accountability skills necessary to succeed in a rigorous pre-medical program.**

title: Senior Mobile Security & Anti-Fraud Research Engineer
description:
Senior Mobile Security & Anti-Fraud Research Engineer

Contract | Remote | Expert-Level

Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Mobile Security & Reverse Engineering specialist for an advanced, authorized mobile security research and testing project.

This is not a standard mobile development position.

The ideal candidate has deep expertise in Android/iOS internals, mobile reverse engineering, runtime instrumentation, device telemetry, network fingerprinting, location systems, device-integrity controls, and commercial anti-fraud/device-intelligence SDKs.

The engagement involves building and testing controlled mobile environments to evaluate how effectively modern fraud-prevention and device-intelligence systems identify manipulated, virtualized, rooted/jailbroken, instrumented, or otherwise non-standard devices.

All testing will be conducted against systems and environments for which appropriate authorization has been obtained.

Key Responsibilities

Mobile Reverse Engineering & Dynamic Analysis

- Perform advanced static and dynamic analysis of Android and iOS applications.
- Analyze application behavior using Frida, Ghidra, IDA Pro, JADX, LLDB, Xposed/LSPosed, objection, radare2/r2frida, or comparable tooling.
- Identify application and SDK collection of device, network, location, sensor, integrity, and behavioral telemetry.
- Analyze native ARM/ARM64 libraries, JNI interfaces, Java/Kotlin code, Objective-C/Swift components, and relevant framework calls.
- Instrument application APIs in controlled test environments to understand how security and fraud-detection signals are generated.

Android & iOS Platform Internals

- Analyze Android framework services including location, networking, sensor, telephony, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and device-integrity components.
- Work with Android framework/AOSP internals, rooted research devices, emulators, custom ROMs, and potentially custom system images.
- Analyze iOS CoreLocation, networking, sensor, device-integrity, and jailbreak-related behavior.
- Evaluate differences between physical devices, emulators/simulators, rooted/jailbroken devices, and modified OS environments.

Location & Environmental Telemetry Research

Evaluate the collection and correlation of:

- GPS/GNSS location
- Cell/network-derived location
- Wi-Fi/BSSID environment
- Bluetooth environment
- IP geolocation
- Time zone and locale
- Sensor telemetry
- Device movement/orientation signals

Develop controlled test scenarios to determine how applications detect inconsistent or manipulated environmental signals.

Device Fingerprinting & Integrity Research

Evaluate device-identification and integrity signals including:

- Android build/system properties
- Root/jailbreak indicators
- Emulator/virtualization detection
- Runtime instrumentation detection
- Frida/Xposed/LSPosed/Magisk-related indicators
- Accelerometer and gyroscope telemetry
- Battery/device-state information
- Graphics/GPU/OpenGL characteristics
- Hardware-backed integrity signals
- Application-installation and environment metadata

Document which signals materially affect device-risk classifications and how resilient detection mechanisms are under authorized adversarial testing.

Network & Transport-Layer Analysis

Analyze mobile network telemetry including:

- HTTP/HTTPS behavior
- TLS characteristics
- DNS resolution
- WebRTC behavior where applicable
- IPv4/IPv6 routing
- Proxy/VPN detection
- ASN/geolocation consistency
- HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 behavior
- Certificate pinning and network-security controls

Evaluate whether network characteristics remain internally consistent across controlled testing environments.

Anti-Fraud / Device-Intelligence SDK Analysis

Analyze commercial or internally developed mobile security, device-intelligence, anti-bot, and anti-fraud technologies.

Relevant experience may include systems such as:

- Incognia
- TeleSign
- Castle
- Fingerprint
- ThreatMetrix/LexisNexis
- SEON
- BioCatch
- Sift
- Similar device-intelligence or mobile risk platforms

The objective is to understand what telemetry these systems rely upon, how signals are correlated, and how effectively they identify abnormal test environments.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of relevant mobile security/reverse-engineering experience preferred.

Strong hands-on experience with several of the following:

- Frida
- Ghidra
- IDA Pro
- JADX / Smali
- Xposed / LSPosed
- Magisk
- LLDB
- radare2 / r2frida
- objection
- Android Debug Bridge / Android SDK
- Android NDK / JNI
- ARM / ARM64 reverse engineering

Candidates should possess deep knowledge of:

- Android application architecture
- Android framework internals
- iOS application architecture
- Mobile application instrumentation
- Root/jailbreak environments
- Emulator and virtualization detection
- Mobile networking
- TLS and HTTP protocols
- Device fingerprinting
- Mobile location architecture
- Mobile sensor APIs
- Application anti-tampering techniques

Highly Preferred Experience

Candidates with any of the following will receive priority consideration:

- AOSP development
- Custom Android ROM development
- Android framework modification
- Custom Android kernel development
- iOS jailbreak/tweak development
- ARM64 native reverse engineering
- Mobile malware research
- Mobile penetration testing
- Anti-fraud engineering
- Device-intelligence research
- Anti-bot/security research
- Mobile application protection/RASP research
- Security research involving high-scale mobile environments

Ideal Candidate

We are specifically looking for someone who operates significantly below the normal Android/iOS application-development layer.

If your experience primarily consists of building standard Android or iOS applications, this position is unlikely to be a fit.

We are looking for someone comfortable answering questions such as:

- What telemetry is actually leaving the device?
- Which layer of the OS generates that telemetry?
- How does an SDK distinguish physical devices from modified environments?
- Which signals are derived independently versus correlated server-side?
- How can we reproduce suspected detection behavior inside an authorized laboratory environment?
- How can the resulting detection mechanisms be strengthened?

Screening Process

Qualified candidates should provide:

1. A brief description of their Android/iOS reverse-engineering experience.
2. Examples of mobile security research, penetration testing, tooling, publications, GitHub repositories, or previous projects.
3. Specific experience with Frida and ARM/ARM64 mobile application analysis.
4. Any experience analyzing device-fingerprinting, anti-fraud, anti-bot, RASP, root/jailbreak, emulator, or device-integrity systems.
5. Hourly or project-based rate.
6. Availability and time zone.

Shortlisted candidates may be given a paid technical evaluation using a controlled test application. The exercise will measure the candidate's ability to identify, instrument, document, and explain mobile telemetry and defensive controls.

Engagement

Type: Independent Contractor
Location: Remote
Schedule: Flexible
Experience Level: Expert / Senior
Duration: Initial project with potential ongoing work
Compensation: Competitive and dependent on demonstrated expertise

Please do not submit generic mobile-development portfolios. We are specifically interested in candidates with demonstrable mobile security, reverse-engineering, OS-internals, or device-intelligence expertise.

title: Direct-Response Video Editor
description:
We build saunas, cold plunges, and red light therapy equipment and we're scaling our Meta ads hard. We have a large library of raw footage — customer installs, studio builds, product shots — and we need one dedicated editor turning it into high-performing ads every single week. You'll work directly with the co-CEO, and this is a long-term seat: full-time, one client (us), guaranteed 40 hours a week.

What you'll do:

Cut 10 short-form video ads per week (15–60 sec) from our footage and written scripts
Write and style captions, add text hooks and headline overlays
Export 4:5 and 9:16 for Meta feed, Reels, and Stories
Iterate winners weekly: new hooks and new first-3-seconds on ads that are scaling
Work from written creative briefs with 24–48 hour turnarounds

You're a fit if:

You've spent 2+ years editing paid social ads — actual Meta/TikTok ads for real brands, not YouTube videos or event films
You can show 3 ads you personally edited and explain exactly what you did on each
You edit for sound-off viewing, know platform safe zones, and cut fast (every 2–3 seconds, no cinematic slow builds)

CapCut or Premiere — your choice. We use OpusClip for rough cuts; you finish and polish

Process: We'll shortlist from applications, then send finalists a short paid test project ($150 flat, 48-hour deadline, two finished ads from our footage). The winner starts a paid 30-day trial at full rate with a 10-ad weekly quota, then we convert to a long-term monthly retainer.

How to apply — read carefully, we filter on this:

Start your proposal with the word STEALTH
Link 3 ads you personally edited and state your exact role on each
Tell us your hourly rate and earliest start date

Proposals missing any of these three will be declined without reading. Generic or AI-written cover letters will be obvious — three good links matter more than three paragraphs.

title: Civil 3D / LiDAR Topographic Linework Specialist
description:
We are a drone LiDAR and reality-capture company looking for an experienced Civil 3D / Survey CAD Technician to assist with ongoing topographic mapping projects.

This is not simply a CAD drafting position. We need someone who understands the complete workflow from an already-processed LiDAR point cloud through survey-control verification, surface creation, contours, and detailed existing-condition linework.

Our projects are completed in coordination with a licensed land surveyor. Maintaining the integrity of the surveyor’s control network, coordinate system, and elevations is critical.

This has the potential to become an ongoing relationship for the right person.

Typical Workflow

For most projects, we will provide:

* Processed and classified LiDAR point cloud
* Survey control and/or benchmark information
* Coordinate system / project datum information
* Ground control and check point coordinates
* Orthomosaic when available
* Project-specific requirements

The technician will generally be responsible for the following workflow:

1. Project Setup

Before performing any processing or drafting:

* Confirm and set the correct coordinate system / zone
* Confirm horizontal datum
* Confirm vertical datum
* Confirm drawing and project units
* Review supplied survey control and benchmark information

The coordinate system, zone, datum, and units must be established correctly before any additional work is performed.

2. Control & Point Cloud Verification

The point cloud will normally already have been processed using the surveyor’s control network.

However, the technician must independently verify that the supplied point cloud agrees with the surveyor’s control and/or check points before proceeding with the final surface and linework.

This may include:

* Comparing point-cloud elevations against survey benchmarks/check points
* Checking horizontal position where applicable
* Identifying systematic horizontal or vertical offsets
* Quantifying discrepancies
* Determining whether discrepancies are within acceptable project tolerances

If an adjustment is required, the technician may be asked to adjust/translate the point cloud or derived data to match the surveyor’s established control or benchmark.

No undocumented adjustment should be made to the data.

Any adjustment should be clearly identified and documented so that we and the surveyor know exactly what was changed and why.

3. Existing-Ground Surface

Once control has been verified, the technician will create the project’s existing-ground surface from the supplied ground-classified LiDAR data.

Responsibilities may include:

* Creating the Civil 3D TIN surface
* Reviewing the surface for anomalies
* Cleaning obvious LiDAR artifacts where appropriate
* Establishing appropriate surface boundaries
* Adding breaklines where necessary
* Reviewing triangulation in critical areas
* Confirming the final surface remains consistent with survey control

The goal is a clean and usable existing-ground surface suitable for topographic mapping and review by our surveyor.

4. Contours

Generate appropriate major and minor contours from the approved surface.

Depending on the project, this may include:

* 1-foot contours
* 0.5-foot contours where the data supports that interval
* Major/index contours
* Contour labeling
* Cleanup of obvious contour artifacts

Contours should accurately represent the underlying surface and should not simply be cosmetically edited in a way that changes the underlying terrain information.

5. Existing-Condition Linework

The technician will create detailed topographic/existing-condition linework using the LiDAR point cloud, orthomosaic when available, and other supplied project data.

Typical features may include:

* Building footprints
* Building edges
* Retaining walls
* Site walls
* Steps and stairways
* Curbs
* Top and bottom of curb where applicable
* Edge of pavement
* Edge of driveway
* Sidewalks
* Hardscape
* Fences
* Drainage features
* Significant grade breaks
* Top and toe of slopes where appropriate
* Visible site improvements
* Visible utility features where identifiable
* Trees and significant vegetation when required
* Other clearly identifiable existing features relevant to a topographic drawing

Tree requirements may vary by project.

We are looking for someone who understands what features are important to an existing-conditions/topographic drawing, not someone who simply traces everything visible in the point cloud.

Accuracy & Survey Control

This is one of the most important parts of the position.

You should be comfortable working with:

* Survey control networks
* Benchmarks
* Ground control points
* Check points
* Northing, Easting, and Elevation values
* Horizontal and vertical datums
* State Plane coordinate systems
* UTM coordinate systems
* US Survey Feet / International Feet / Meters
* Vertical elevation differences
* Point-cloud-to-control comparisons
* Surface validation

You should understand the difference between an actual point-cloud error and a coordinate system, datum, geoid, unit, or benchmark issue.

If something does not match the surveyor’s control, we expect you to investigate and report the discrepancy rather than arbitrarily moving the data until it matches.

Civil 3D & CAD Requirements

Strong experience with Autodesk Civil 3D is preferred.

You should be comfortable with:

* LAS/LAZ and point-cloud workflows
* Civil 3D surfaces
* TIN surface creation and editing
* Surface boundaries
* Breaklines
* Contour generation
* Contour cleanup
* Feature lines and polylines
* Layer management
* Survey/topographic CAD standards
* Lineweights and linetypes
* CTB/STB plot styles
* DWG/DXF deliverables
* Preparing drawings for review and continued work by a licensed surveyor

Experience with Autodesk ReCap, CloudCompare, Global Mapper, QGIS, or other point-cloud/geospatial software is also valuable.

CAD Standards & CTB/STB Requirements

We will not provide a CTB/STB plot style.

The technician should have an established professional CAD standard for topographic/survey drawings or be capable of creating one.

The technician will be responsible for providing the CTB or STB file used to plot the completed linework.

This is important because our surveyor needs to be able to open the drawing, use the same plot style, add additional lines or information, and have the new work match the original drawing.

Layer organization, lineweights, linetypes, and plotting should therefore be clean, consistent, and professional.

Typical Deliverables

Depending on the project, final deliverables may include:

* Civil 3D DWG
* Existing-condition/topographic linework
* Existing-ground Civil 3D surface
* Major and minor contours
* Surface boundaries
* Breaklines where required
* Organized CAD layers
* Appropriate lineweights and linetypes
* CTB or STB plot style file used for the project
* DXF when requested
* Control/check-point accuracy comparison
* Documentation of any adjustment made to the supplied point cloud/data
* PDF of the completed topographic drawing when requested

The goal is to provide our surveyor with a clean Civil 3D project that he can open, review, modify, and continue working with without rebuilding the drawing.

Ideal Candidate

We are especially interested in candidates with experience as a:

* Survey CAD Technician
* Civil 3D Technician
* Topographic Mapping Technician
* LiDAR Technician
* Geospatial / Point Cloud Technician

Experience working directly with licensed land surveyors and survey-controlled LiDAR or traditional topographic survey data is strongly preferred.

Experience specifically creating topographic linework from drone LiDAR point clouds is a major plus.

Ongoing Work

We perform LiDAR data acquisition on projects of varying sizes and would like to establish a relationship with a reliable technician rather than hire someone new for every project.

The ideal person will learn our workflow and our surveyor’s requirements so that future projects can move efficiently from LiDAR processing to completed CAD/topographic deliverables.

Quality, accuracy, communication, and consistency are more important to us than simply finding the lowest hourly rate.

When Applying

Please provide:

1. Your experience with Civil 3D and survey/topographic drafting.
2. Your experience creating linework from LiDAR point clouds.
3. Your experience creating and cleaning Civil 3D surfaces.
4. Your experience generating topographic contours.
5. Your experience working with survey control, benchmarks, coordinate systems, and vertical datums.
6. Whether you have worked directly with licensed land surveyors.
7. The software you normally use for point-cloud and Civil 3D workflows.
8. Whether you have an established CTB/STB and CAD layer standard for topographic drawings.
9. Examples of completed topographic drawings or Civil 3D projects.
10. Your hourly rate or typical project pricing structure.

Please include at least one sample PDF of a topographic drawing you have personally worked on, if available.

Technical Screening Question

Please answer the following in your application:

You receive a ground-classified LiDAR point cloud along with survey control/check points from a licensed surveyor. The point cloud appears to be approximately 0.15 ft higher than the surveyor’s check points. Before making any adjustment to the point cloud, explain how you would determine the cause of the discrepancy and whether a vertical adjustment should actually be made.

We will use your response to this question, along with your previous work examples, as part of our initial screening process.

title: AI Marketing Operations
description:
We are looking for someone with strong marketing and automation experience to help us identify and automate repetitive parts of our marketing operation.

Our team currently spends a significant amount of time on lead research, data entry, follow-up, reporting, campaign analysis, and other repetitive tasks.

We want to determine which parts of our process can be improved using AI and automation.

The project may involve:

* Lead research automation
* Data enrichment
* CRM updates
* Lead qualification
* Email personalization
* Follow-up automation
* Reporting
* Campaign analysis
* Internal workflows
* AI-assisted research and content processes

We currently use several tools and are open to using platforms such as ChatGPT, Make, Zapier, n8n, APIs, and CRM automation.

We are not looking for someone who simply uses AI to write social media posts.

We want someone who understands our marketing processes well enough to identify where AI can actually save time, improve consistency, or increase conversions.

title: Framer Website Redesign for Navius HR
description:
I am looking for an experienced Framer designer/developer to completely redesign and rebuild the website of Navius HR & Recruiting.

The current website is built in Webflow. Rather than simply redesigning the existing site, I want to use this project as an opportunity to rethink the website from the ground up and move it entirely to Framer.

Navius is a boutique HR and recruiting consultancy operating primarily across Germany/DACH and the UK.

The new website should not look or feel like a traditional recruitment agency website. The ambition is a modern, premium and international consulting brand — closer in its visual clarity and confidence to a strategy or management consultancy than to a conventional recruitment firm.

What the Website Should Achieve

The website is primarily a business development and credibility tool, not a large SEO/content platform.

Most visitors will already have encountered Navius through LinkedIn, recommendations, networking or direct outreach. When they visit the website, they should understand within a very short time:

* Who Navius works with
* What problems we solve
* How our approach differs from traditional recruitment agencies
* Why they should trust us with critical hiring or HR challenges
* How they can start working with us

The main conversion goal is to book a meeting / start a conversation.

Target Audience

Primarily:

* Founders and Managing Directors
* CEOs and C-Level executives
* HR and People leaders
* Investors and Family Offices
* Scale-ups
* SMEs and mid-sized companies

Main markets are Germany/DACH and the UK.

Positioning

Navius combines more than 20 years of operational HR, recruiting and leadership experience with a hands-on approach.

We are not a traditional headhunter simply forwarding CVs.

We work closely within our clients' existing structures and help them solve critical hiring and HR challenges.

The brand should feel:

Experienced. Personal. Precise. International. Commercial. Modern.

Not corporate for the sake of being corporate, and definitely not like a typical recruitment agency.

Design Direction

I am looking for a minimalist, premium and highly contemporary design.

Think:

* Strong typography
* Generous whitespace
* Clear visual hierarchy
* Limited amount of text
* Excellent UX
* Subtle and sophisticated animations
* Strong mobile experience
* No unnecessary visual effects
* No generic recruitment imagery or obvious stock photos

I am personally inspired by the clarity, confidence and simplicity of brands such as McKinsey and other premium international consultancies, while Navius should still have its own, more personal character.

Brand Colours

The existing colour direction should remain recognizable but can be modernised:

* Navy / dark blue as the primary colour
* Warm off-white / beige
* Gold used very selectively as an accent
* Dark grey / anthracite for typography where appropriate

I am open to recommendations and would ideally like to see different visual directions early in the process.

Typography

Current preference:

Manrope for headlines
Inter for body copy

However, I am open to alternatives if you can propose a typography system that better supports the premium consulting positioning.

Proposed Website Structure

The website should remain relatively compact. Initial thinking:

1. Home
2. Recruiting
3. Interim HR / HR Management
4. Cases / Selected Projects
5. About
6. Contact / Book a Meeting

I am open to challenging this structure if there is a better UX or storytelling approach.

German & English

The website needs to exist in German and English.

Currently, translations are handled through Weglot. I would like to move away from this setup.

The new Framer website should have two properly maintained language versions.

Importantly, the English website should not simply be a literal translation of the German website. Messaging can be adapted to the UK/international market where appropriate.

Content

This is not primarily a copywriting project, but the new design should help us significantly reduce and sharpen the existing content.

The principle should be:

**Less content. More clarity.**

Visitors should be able to scan the site quickly and understand the value proposition without reading long blocks of copy.

Real projects, experience, numbers and proof should create credibility rather than generic marketing language.

Technical Requirements

* Built entirely in Framer
* Fully responsive
* Excellent mobile experience
* Fast loading
* Easy for me to maintain and edit independently after launch
* German and English versions
* Clean URL structure
* Basic technical SEO
* GEO / AI-search-friendly structure and content
* GDPR-compliant setup
* Integration of meeting booking / contact CTA

What I Am Looking For

I am not looking for someone who simply takes the existing Webflow website and recreates it in Framer.

I am looking for someone who can challenge the current website, rethink the visual concept and create a significantly more modern digital presence for Navius.

Strong experience with premium B2B, consulting, professional services or SaaS websites would be particularly interesting.

Please include examples of relevant Framer projects in your application and briefly explain how you would approach this redesign.

title: Nonprofit Grant Writer & Grant Research Specialist – Youth Sports 501(c)(3)
description:
Icehouse Ignite Softball, Inc. is a newly established 501(c)(3) nonprofit youth sports organization in Virginia focused on creating competitive and developmental opportunities for young female athletes.

We are seeking an experienced nonprofit grant writer/research specialist for ongoing weekly support. We do not need someone who simply writes applications we send them. We need someone who can proactively identify funding opportunities, determine eligibility, manage deadlines, prepare strong applications, and help us build a sustainable grant pipeline.

Immediate funding priorities include:
• Youth sports equipment and training technology
• Electronic coach-to-player communication equipment
• Uniforms, warm-up gear and player equipment
• Tournament and program expenses
• Practice/training facility expenses
• Scholarships and reducing participation costs for families
• Girls' sports and female athlete development
• Community youth-development programs
We also have a long-term vision for an indoor youth baseball/softball training facility in Central Virginia and want someone capable of identifying larger capital, facility, community-development and corporate/foundation funding opportunities as that project develops.
Responsibilities:
• Research local, Virginia, federal, corporate and private-foundation grants
• Verify eligibility BEFORE recommending an opportunity
• Prioritize currently open grants with realistic funding potential
• Identify quick-turnaround equipment and small-project grants as well as larger opportunities
• Prepare and submit grant applications with our approval
• Draft LOIs, narratives, budgets and supporting materials
• Maintain a grant tracker with deadlines, submission dates, requested amounts, status and follow-up dates
• Track submitted applications and follow up when appropriate
• Maintain reusable organizational narratives and grant materials
• Identify corporate giving and sponsorship opportunities in addition to traditional grants

We already have our IRS 501(c)(3) determination, EIN, organizational overview, website, program information, budgets, equipment quotes and other supporting documentation available.

We are looking for someone who can work independently. We do not want to spend significant time in meetings. 

Communication can primarily take place through Upwork messages/email, with concise questions when information is needed.

This is intended to be an ongoing relationship beginning at approximately 5 hours per week.

Please do not apply if your experience is primarily AI-generated grant writing without demonstrated nonprofit grant research and submission experience.

title: Part-Time Candidate Interviewer
description:
We’re looking for a warm, engaging, and reliable Candidate Interviewer to support our remote recruitment team on a part-time, as-needed basis.
This role is focused on conducting candidate interviews using our established interview guide. You’ll speak with candidates, ask questions, keep the conversation engaging, and provide clear feedback after each interview.
The ideal candidate is confident, personable, and comfortable speaking with different types of people. You should be able to follow a structured interview guide while keeping the conversation natural and professional.

What You’ll Do
• Conduct candidate interviews using our established interview guide
 • Create a warm, professional, and engaging experience for candidates
 • Ask follow-up questions when clarification is needed
 • Take accurate interview notes and record candidate responses
 • Provide clear feedback after each interview
 • Assess candidates based on their communication, experience, and overall fit
 • Follow established interview processes and guidelines
 • Communicate interview updates with the team

What We’re Looking For
• C1+ English proficiency is required
 • Fluent and natural spoken English with minimal to no noticeable accent
 • Warm, engaging, and confident communication style
 • Strong listening and questioning skills
 • Comfortable conducting video interviews
 • Able to follow an interview guide while keeping conversations natural
 • Strong attention to detail when taking notes and evaluating responses
 • Reliable, professional, and organized
 • Previous experience in interviewing, customer service, administration, or another people-facing role is a plus

Role Details
• Part-time, as-needed basis
 • Preferred availability: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM US Eastern Time
 • Remote position
 • Pay: $5–$6/hour
 • Long-term opportunity based on performance and availability
Requirements (Equipment & Setup)
• Laptop or desktop (minimum Intel i5 or equivalent)
 • At least 8GB RAM
 • Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 10 Mbps)
 • Backup internet connection
 • Noise-canceling headset with clear microphone
 • Quiet and professional work environment
 • Reliable power supply or backup power solution

title: Truss Desginer
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented CFS (Cold-Formed Steel) Drafter proficient in Keymark, Alpine, and/or Revit to join our design team. This role is responsible for creating precise layouts, managing structural load paths, and preparing production-ready documents for trusses and wall panels.

Primary Responsibilities

Design & Modeling: Generate accurate CFS truss and wall panel layouts using Keymark, Alpine, or Revit.
Structural Analysis: Review building plans to identify load paths through building and ensure proper framing and bearing.
DFMA (Design for Manufacturing): Optimize designs for assembly, ensuring parts fit efficiently and minimize material waste.
Takeoffs & Quoting: Perform accurate hardware takeoffs (screws, clips, connectors) and assist in pricing/sales qualification.
Production Support: Prepare organized drawing packages and production files; enter and navigate jobs within production queue.
Project Management: Basic client interaction during design phases, maintaining tidy file structures and meeting project deadlines consistently.
Process Improvement: Proactively identify gaps in the design-to-production system and suggest optimizations.
Technical Skills & Qualifications:Any prior general experience with reading building plans or CAD software is beneficial. The software we do use is niche and can be learned on the job. We are looking for a bright drafter that ideally has some drafting experience but can learn quickly and contribute to making our team more efficient.

Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of CFS components, gauges, profiles, and product codes.
Software Proficiency:
Expertise in Keymark or Alpine (Trusses).
Proficiency in Revit (Wall Panels).
Structural Intuition: Ability to read complex architectural/structural sets and anticipate load-path issues.
Organization: High level of attention to detail regarding file management and documentation.
Communication: Ability to collaborate with production teams and communicate effectively with clients regarding design.
Career Growth & Skill Levels

We categorize our team based on a comprehensive skill assessment. Candidates will be evaluated on these criteria for compensation and role placement.

Junior Drafter: Focuses on learning building plans, basic truss knowledge, and layout drafting.
Intermediate Drafter: Demonstrates structural intuition, handles quoting, and prepares full document packages.
Experienced Drafter: Proficient in multiple softwares, guides junior staff, and handles complex client communication.
Drafting Coach / Training P.M.: Spearheads large projects, leads training initiatives, and pushes projects into production.
Team Manager / Leadership: Focuses on sales/market knowledge, process improvement, and leading the division.

title: UiPath Expert/Tutor – Apps, Coded Apps, Serverless Robots & Agentic Automation
description:
I’m looking for an experienced UiPath expert/mentor to work with me one-on-one to expand my knowledge of UiPath’s newer capabilities, especially:

* UiPath Apps
* Coded Apps / Coded development
* Serverless Robots
* Agentic Automation
* UiPath Agents / Agent Builder
* Maestro and agentic orchestration
* APIs/SDKs and other modern UiPath capabilities

I already have solid experience with traditional UiPath RPA development, so I’m not looking for beginner-level training.

I’m looking for someone who can work with me through hands-on sessions, where we build small POCs/demo projects together. I want to understand not only how these technologies work, but also real-world use cases, architecture, limitations, and best practices.

What I’m looking for:

* Strong hands-on UiPath experience
* Experience with UiPath Apps and Coded Apps
* Experience with Serverless Robots
* Strong knowledge of Agentic AI / Agentic Automation
* Experience with UiPath Agent Builder and/or Maestro
* Ability to explain concepts clearly and work as a tutor/mentor
* Comfortable with live hands-on sessions and building projects together

I’m looking for an ongoing hourly engagement with someone who can meet with me regularly and help me become comfortable building these solutions independently.

When applying, please briefly describe your hands-on experience with UiPath Apps, Coded Apps, Serverless Robots, and Agentic Automation, including any POCs or real-world projects you have built.

title: Revit / BIM Tutoring & Model Review
description:
Revit / BIM Tutoring & Model Review
I am looking for an experienced Revit/BIM specialist to provide **one-to-one Revit tutoring, technical guidance, and model review** using a residential house model as a practical learning example.

The purpose of the engagement is to improve my understanding of Revit/BIM workflows and quantity take-off. I will be carrying out the modelling work myself and would like an experienced Revit user to guide me through the correct methods, review my work, identify mistakes, and demonstrate techniques where required.

Topics I would like support with include:

* Creating and configuring parametric furniture families, including dimensional and material parameters
* Setting up and organising views, sections and annotations
* Understanding how to create detailed callouts
* Correct methods for tagging windows, doors and rooms
* Creating and configuring window and door schedules
* Creating floor-finish schedules including areas and cost parameters
* Setting up material take-offs for brick, block and plasterboard
* Understanding quantity and pricing parameters within Revit

I would also like the freelancer to review the model as I progress and explain any corrections or improvements that should be made.

**What I am looking for:**

* Strong Autodesk Revit experience
* Good understanding of BIM workflows and quantity take-off
* Ability to explain the process clearly rather than simply provide a finished result
* Experience with residential Revit models would be beneficial

The engagement can be carried out through screen-sharing/tutorial sessions and model reviews.

The schedule is flexible, although I would ideally like to work through these topics over the next few days.

title: Engineer who knows agent sandboxes (E2B, Daytona, Modal) - verified compute product
description:
We run Cathedral (cathedral.computer). Hardware-isolated Intel TDX sandboxes for AI agents, that return a signed receipt proving what actually executed inside them. $0.20 a run, live today.

If you know E2B, Daytona, Modal, Fly Machines, Firecracker or gVisor, you already understand ninety percent of what we do. The last ten percent is that our output is verifiable: the customer gets an attestation they can check offline, without trusting us.

I'm looking for one engineer who knows this category well enough to have opinions about it. Not someone I brief, someone who tells me what we should be doing.

THE WORK

Building and hardening the sandbox platform toward being genuinely ready for customers. Cold start times. Network isolation on the worker path. Reliability under real load. The unglamorous gap between "it works when I run it" and "a stranger can depend on it."

You'd be the second pair of hands on this. I don't have the bandwidth to build it and test it properly, and I'd rather one person owned it than three people touched it.

STACK

Python, Docker, Linux, existing repos with CI. Intel TDX experience is a bonus, not a requirement. The attestation layer works and I'll explain it. What matters more is that you understand what an agent needs from a sandbox and why the incumbents get parts of it wrong.

WHO THIS SUITS

Someone with a view. If you've used E2B and found the cold starts fine but the filesystem semantics annoying, or you think Daytona's snapshot model is the right idea badly executed, that's the conversation I want to have.

If your answer to "what would you change" is "whatever you need," this isn't the right fit and we'll both know quickly.

TO APPLY

Please skip the cover letter. Two things instead:

1. Which agent sandbox products have you actually used, and what's wrong with them? Be specific and be rude if you like.

2. Go to cathedral.computer. Your first run is free. Use it, then tell me one thing you'd change and one thing you think we're wrong about.

Two paragraphs total is plenty. I read all of them and I reply to everyone who actually ran it.

TERMS

Paid trial task first, fixed fee, so we both find out cheaply. Hourly after that if it works. I'd rather pay properly for one good person than cheaply for three.

description:

PLEASE MAKE A SHORT VIDEO (3-5 MINUTES) WALKING US THROUGH TA SCREENSHARE OF  A COMPLICATED OR INTERESTING WORKFLOW OR AUTOMATION THAT YOU HAVE PERSONALLY CREATED IN HUBSPOT AND EXPLAIN WHAT THE WORKFLOW DOES.

OUR INTENT IS TO HEAR YOUR THOUGHTS, AND ASSESS YOUR EXPERTISE AND COMPETENCE IN HUBSPOT AND DEMAND GEN MARKETING.
=============================================================================
.

What You’ll Do

As our HubSpot & Demand Generation Specialist, you’ll be attracting and converting prospects into highly qualified leads. Your expertise in creating powerful, data-driven campaigns will fuel our growth and position us as the top choice for mortgage professionals looking to dominate their market. You’ll collaborate with an energetic team and have the freedom to bring your creative ideas to life while leveraging cutting-edge marketing technologies.

Campaign Management: Plan, execute, and optimize multi-channel demand generation campaigns, including email, social media, paid search, and content marketing.
Lead Nurturing: Develop and manage automated lead nurturing workflows to engage prospects and guide them through the sales funnel.
Performance Analysis: Measure and analyze campaign performance to identify opportunities for optimization and ROI improvement.
Collaboration: Partner with the sales team to align on lead qualification criteria, ensuring a seamless handoff of leads.
Content Strategy: Collaborate with the content team to develop high-value assets such as whitepapers, case studies, and webinars.
Audience Targeting: Leverage data and insights to identify and refine target audiences for campaigns.
Marketing Tech Stack: Manage and optimize marketing tools, including HubSpot CRM and analytics software.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
4+ years of intense HubSpot experience in demand generation or performance marketing, preferably in a SaaS or technology-driven industry.
Strong understanding of paid media strategies, including Google Ads and social media advertising.
Data-driven mindset with expertise in analytics tools like Google Analytics
Excellent project management and organizational skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Familiarity with the mortgage or financial services industry is a plus but not required.

title: YouTube Video Editor  Credit, Business Funding & Finance
description:
YouTube Video Editor Credit, Business Funding & Finance

We are looking for a high-quality YouTube video editor to help grow a personal/business finance YouTube channel focused on:

* Business funding
* Credit optimization
* Credit cards
* Business credit
* Personal loans
* 0% funding
* Banking strategies
* Entrepreneurship
* Real estate investing

What We’re Looking For

We DO NOT want basic talking-head editing.

We want someone who understands YouTube retention and knows how to turn educational financial content into engaging videos.

Your editing should include:

* Fast-paced cuts
* Pattern interrupts
* B-roll
* Motion graphics
* On-screen text
* Screenshots
* Bank/credit card visuals
* Credit report examples
* Charts/graphics when appropriate
* Zooms and punch-ins
* Sound effects
* Clean captions
* Strong first 30–60 seconds
* Professional color correction and audio
* Strategic use of AI tools when helpful

Think:

Alex Hormozi + modern finance YouTube + documentary-style educational content.

Video Length

Most videos will be approximately 8–15 minutes.

We want to publish consistently and are looking for a long-term editor, not someone for one video.

Ideal Candidate

You should:

* Have experience editing YouTube videos
* Understand audience retention
* Understand American business/finance content
* Have excellent English comprehension
* Be able to find relevant B-roll yourself
* Understand how to visually explain complicated concepts
* Be reliable with deadlines
* Be interested in a long-term position

Experience editing finance, credit, business, real estate, entrepreneurship or educational content is strongly preferred.

To Apply

Send me:

1. Your 3 best YouTube edits
2. Any finance/business videos you’ve edited
3. Your price for an 8–15 minute finished video
4. Typical turnaround time
5. What software you use

IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word TITAN so I know you actually read this.

Paid Test

Final candidates will receive the same raw 60–90 second clip.

You will be paid to edit it.

We will hire the editor who does the best job with:

* Hook/retention
* Pacing
* Visual storytelling
* Professionalism
* Understanding our brand

This can turn into consistent weekly work for the right person.

title: HubSpot CRM Specialist-Commercial Real Estate | Database, Pipelines & Automation
description:
Job Description

HubSpot CRM Specialist – Commercial Real Estate | Database, Pipelines & Automation

Hudson & Chase CRE is a commercial real estate brokerage specializing in Manufactured Housing Communities, RV Parks/Resorts, Campgrounds, and Self-Storage throughout the United States.

We are looking for an experienced HubSpot CRM specialist to help build, organize, optimize, and maintain our CRM infrastructure for long-term use.

We already have property and ownership data and need someone who can turn HubSpot into an efficient system our brokerage team can actually use every day.

This is not simply a data-entry position. We need someone who understands CRM architecture, data relationships, pipelines, automation, reporting, and database management.

Responsibilities include:

* Audit our existing HubSpot setup before making major changes
* Organize and clean existing Companies, Contacts, and records
* Design the proper CRM structure for commercial real estate prospecting
* Create and configure custom properties/fields
* Properly associate property-owning entities, owners/principals, contacts, and related companies
* Build sales/prospecting pipelines and deal stages
* Create lists, saved views, filters, and segmentation
* Set up tasks and follow-up workflows
* Build appropriate automations and workflows where available within our HubSpot subscription
* Establish lead/contact status conventions
* Help prevent duplicate companies and contacts
* Create an efficient process for importing large Excel/CSV datasets
* Map spreadsheet fields correctly during imports
* Maintain historical notes and owner/contact information
* Create dashboards and reporting for broker activity, prospecting, opportunities, and deals
* Help integrate HubSpot with our existing business workflow and other systems where appropriate
* Document the CRM structure so it remains maintainable as the company grows

Our database contains commercial properties that may have multiple layers of ownership. For example:

Property → Ownership LLC → Parent/Operating Company → Individual Owner/Principal → Contact Information

We need someone who understands how to structure these relationships intelligently rather than simply creating thousands of disconnected records.

What we’re looking for

Strong hands-on experience building and administering HubSpot CRM is required. Experience with commercial real estate, investment sales, acquisitions, property databases, or CRE brokerage is highly preferred.

When applying, please tell me:

1. How many HubSpot CRM systems have you built or significantly restructured?
2. Have you worked with a commercial real estate company before?
3. How would you structure the relationship between a property, ownership LLC, parent company, and individual decision-maker in HubSpot?
4. Have you handled large Excel/CSV imports and duplicate management?
5. What HubSpot automations/workflows have you personally built?
6. Are you comfortable auditing an existing CRM before changing anything?
7. Please provide examples or screenshots of HubSpot systems, pipelines, dashboards, or workflows you have built, with confidential client information removed.

Important: Please do not send a generic proposal. Start your proposal with “HUDSON” and briefly explain how you would approach the property/LLC/owner relationship described above.

We are looking for someone who can potentially become our long-term HubSpot/CRM specialist as Hudson & Chase CRE grows.

title: Senior Quantitative Finance SMEs
description:
We are seeking Senior Quantitative Finance Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to evaluate complex financial reasoning and validate intricate structural analyses.

You will leverage your real-world expertise to evaluate quantitative reasoning, identify inaccuracies in complex financial models, validate intricate structural analyses, and provide structured, high-quality feedback. We are looking for professionals who can rigorously evaluate the work of other experienced financial engineers and analysts.

Core Focus Area: Traditional Finance & Private Markets
We are exclusively seeking candidates with deep expertise in quantitative analysis within traditional finance, private markets, and institutional banking. This includes, but is not limited to, professionals with backgrounds in:

- Private Equity & Private Credit Modeling (e.g., complex LBOs, waterfall mechanics, credit risk modeling)
- Illiquid Asset Valuation & Real Estate Quantitative Analysis
- Advanced Corporate Finance & Capital Structure Optimization
- Asset/Liability Management (ALM) & Institutional Risk Management
- Econometrics, Financial Forecasting, & Cash Flow Modeling

Ideal Candidates
We are looking for professionals with:

- 5+ years of professional experience in Quantitative Finance, Private Markets, or Advanced Corporate Finance (exceptional candidates with graduate-level degrees in highly quantitative fields such as Financial Engineering, Econometrics, or Statistics will also be considered).
- Deep subject matter expertise in complex financial modeling, private market valuations, and structural risk analysis.
- Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
- Excellent written English communication.
- Experience reviewing and auditing complex valuation frameworks, credit models, or investment memoranda.
- Familiarity with U.S. financial markets and traditional institutional finance (preferred).
