title: Senior WordPress / Amelia Developer – Booking & Customer Journey Takeover
description:
We are looking for an experienced WordPress / Amelia / WooCommerce developer to take over and complete an existing coaching website.

The website is built with:

WordPress
Elementor Pro
Amelia
WooCommerce
Stripe
Polylang

The main customer journey is already in place:

Coaching Program selection → first appointment booking → customer details/account → payment → confirmation → customer profile → scheduling the remaining sessions

The project also includes the related customer experience after booking, such as the customer profile, appointment management, confirmation and appointment emails, video-call information, payment flow and bilingual EN/DE content.

The current implementation combines native Amelia/WooCommerce functionality with some existing customisations. We are looking for someone who can understand the current setup, identify what should be retained, improve what is needed, and then take ownership of completing the remaining work.

How we would like to proceed

We will first shortlist candidates based on relevant hands-on experience.

Selected candidates will receive access to the staging frontend and will be asked to review the current customer journey and provide a brief initial assessment. Test bookings using test data are welcome.

A small number of candidates will then be invited to a call where we will walk through the current setup and requirements together.

The selected developer will start with a paid technical review of the existing backend implementation. Based on that assessment, we would like to continue with the same developer for the remaining implementation.

What we are looking for
Strong hands-on experience with Amelia Packages
Amelia Step-by-Step Booking Form
Amelia Customer Panel
WooCommerce integration and payment flows
WordPress / Elementor Pro
PHP, JavaScript and CSS where required
Experience taking over existing WordPress projects
Ability to distinguish native functionality from custom implementation
Maintainable and update-safe technical solutions
Good understanding of complete customer journeys and UX
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
Clear communication and ability to explain technical decisions

The website is bilingual in English and German and should provide a consistent experience across desktop and mobile.

Application question

Please describe one relevant project where you personally worked with Amelia Packages, Amelia Customer Panel and WooCommerce.

Please briefly explain:

what the customer journey was
what you configured using Amelia's native functionality
what required custom development
what your personal responsibility was

We are particularly interested in real hands-on Amelia experience rather than general WordPress experience.

title: URGENT: Squarespace 7.1 Developer – Custom CSS/JS – Start Tomorrow
description:
URGENT — Squarespace 7.1 Developer Needed — Custom CSS & JavaScript — Existing Prototype — Start Tomorrow

The posted budget is an estimate, not a maximum. Final price will be agreed after you review the prototype and existing Squarespace build. 

I am looking for an experienced Squarespace 7.1 developer with strong custom CSS and JavaScript skills to finish an existing website.
This is NOT a graphic design job. The website design already exists.
I have:
A working website prototype showing exactly how I want the finished website to look
Complete source code for the prototype
An existing Squarespace 7.1 site that has already been partially built
Most content and design decisions already completed
I need someone who can take over the existing Squarespace build, preserve what is already working, and make it closely match the prototype on both desktop and mobile.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS
You must have strong experience with:
Squarespace 7.1
Fluid Engine
Custom CSS
JavaScript
HTML/CSS
Responsive web development
Mobile-specific layout adjustments
Custom Squarespace code implementation
Precise typography, spacing and alignment
Custom buttons/CTAs
Accordions, expandable content and interactive elements
Strong custom CSS and JavaScript experience is required.
I am not looking for someone who only works with standard Squarespace templates and built-in styling controls.

WHAT NEEDS TO BE DONE
The existing Squarespace site needs to be refined to accurately reproduce the prototype.
This includes:
Correct section spacing and proportions
Match heading sizes, line heights and positioning
Match typography throughout
Correct CTA button dimensions, padding, positioning and styling
Reproduce the Three Commitments/Priorities card design from the prototype
Each Commitment card needs to accommodate expandable/drop-down content
Use custom CSS/JavaScript where necessary rather than replacing the design with a standard Squarespace layout
Reproduce custom design details such as vertical accent bars
Correct image sizing, cropping and positioning
Correct section transitions and spacing
Improve overall alignment and visual consistency
Ensure the desktop version closely matches the prototype
Create a polished, responsive mobile version
Preserve portions of the existing Squarespace build that are already correct

IMPORTANT — THIS IS IMPLEMENTATION, NOT REDESIGN
The existing prototype is the visual design specification.
I do not want the website redesigned, reinterpreted or simplified.
The goal is to reproduce the existing prototype as accurately as reasonably possible within Squarespace.
If an element cannot be reproduced accurately using Squarespace's normal controls, I need someone who is comfortable using custom CSS and JavaScript to achieve the intended result.
Please do not apply if your primary experience is graphic design or basic Squarespace template customization.

BEFORE HIRING
I would like to speak with shortlisted candidates before selecting a developer.
I will provide access to:
The current working website prototype
The existing partially built Squarespace site
After reviewing both, I would like you to tell me:
Whether you can reproduce the prototype accurately in Squarespace 7.1
What you would keep from the existing Squarespace build
What, if anything, you recommend rebuilding
How you would approach the custom Commitment/Priority cards and expandable content
How long you estimate the work will take
Cost: I prefer a fixed-price arrangement. The posted budget is an estimate and can be adjusted after you review the prototype and existing Squarespace site. Please provide your fixed price, turnaround time, and what is included. 

WHEN APPLYING
Please provide:
2–3 Squarespace 7.1 websites you personally developed.
Examples of Squarespace projects where you went beyond the standard template or built-in styling controls.
Confirmation that you are experienced with custom CSS and JavaScript in Squarespace.
An example of a site where you handled detailed responsive/mobile customization.
Confirmation that you are comfortable taking over an existing Squarespace build.
Confirmation that you can accurately reproduce an existing prototype rather than redesigning or simplifying it.

URGENT / IMMEDIATE START
This is a time-sensitive project and I need someone who can begin immediately.
The design and content are substantially complete, and an existing Squarespace build is already underway. This is primarily an implementation, correction and final-polish project, not a new website design.
Please include your:
Earliest availability
Estimated turnaround time
Hourly rate or preliminary cost estimate
I am looking to select someone quickly after reviewing qualified applicants.

title: Outbound Sales / B2B Lead Generation — HVAC & Plumbing, Commercial Accounts (Indiana, EST)
description:
We're an HVAC and plumbing company in Indiana. The residential side runs fine — marketing's in place, the phone rings. What we don't have is anyone working the commercial side, and that's the part of this business that actually compounds.

I need one person getting us in front of property managers, facility managers, and general contractors across Indiana. You're not closing deals. Your job is to find the right person, get them talking, and hand off a real opportunity — a bid request, a site walk, a spot on their sub list, or a meeting with whoever signs off on HVAC and plumbing vendors.

Here's the honest version of the work. Most of these calls go nowhere. Gatekeepers, voicemail, "we already have a guy." The person who wins this job is fine with that and keeps dialing, because one property management company running 40 buildings is worth more than a hundred residential calls.

What you'd own:

Building and cleaning target lists — property management firms, GCs, facility managers, multi-site commercial owners in Indiana
Cold calling and emailing during Eastern business hours
Booking meetings and bid opportunities for our team
Logging every touch in CRM so we can see what's actually working
Follow-up. This is where most people quit, and it's where the money is.

We already have calling scripts that work. Improve them if you can. And if you've got your own approach that got results somewhere else — different channel, different sequence, better data sources — tell me about it. I care more about whether you can create real conversations than whether you follow my playbook word for word.

What I need:

Real outbound experience, B2B preferred. Trades or construction is a plus, not a requirement.
Clear, neutral North American English on the phone. You're calling property managers and GCs in Indiana, and a heavy accent loses the call in the first five seconds. That's the job, not a preference.
Available Eastern time, business hours
Disciplined in a CRM
Thick skin

Nice to have: experience selling into property management, facilities, or construction. Apollo, Sales Navigator, Instantly, or similar. Any AI or automation skill for list building and research.

To apply: skip the generic proposal. In a few sentences, tell me about the hardest B2B list you ever worked and what actually came out of it. Numbers if you have them.

1) Recreate our existing content style

Develop creative content ideas and produce engaging short-form videos for mainly for instagram and faceobok.

Performance
Your performance will be evaluated based on the results of the videos you create, including:
Views
Comments
Likes and follower engagement

How to Apply

We’re looking for someone who can create visually appealing videos while also understanding what makes short-form content engaging, shareable, and capable of generating strong organic reach.

title: YouTube Documentary Editor — Business / Money / Technology
description:
We are launching Folavere, a new documentary-style YouTube channel focused on fascinating stories about business, money, technology, industries and economic power.

We are looking for a talented long-form editor who can turn narration and research into a premium 10–15 minute documentary.

This is not a high-volume “YouTube automation” project. We care much more about storytelling, pacing, visual taste and viewer retention than flashy transitions or constant captions.

We will provide:

• Final narration script
• Research/source material
• Detailed production brief
• Story structure and key visual concepts
• Feedback and direction

You should be comfortable:

• Finding appropriate footage and imagery
• Creating clean motion graphics and maps/charts
• Visualizing business and financial concepts
• Sound design and music selection
• Maintaining cinematic documentary pacing
• Working independently from a detailed script

Hiring process

Shortlisted editors will be offered a paid 60–90 second editing test using the opening of our first documentary.

The strongest editor will receive the full project and, if the relationship works, recurring documentary work.

To apply, please send:

1. Your three best relevant long-form examples that you personally edited.
2. Tell us exactly what you did on each.
3. Your normal price for a polished 12–15 minute documentary at the quality shown in your portfolio.
4. Typical turnaround time.
5. Editing/motion-graphics software you use.
6. Whether you source footage/music yourself.
7. Start your response with the word FOLAVERE so we know you read the entire posting.

Please don’t send 20 portfolio links. We want to see your three strongest relevant pieces.

We are interested in building a long-term relationship and increasing production volume and budgets as the channels grow.

title: Pattern design
description:
I need to hire a surface pattern designer to create an original, ornamental floral pattern for a quilted cotton tote bag.

The pattern should be inspired by the aesthetic of Middle Eastern/Islamic decorative textile art — dense floral vine work, a central medallion, and a matching ornamental border, similar in spirit to a rug composition (not a repeating pattern). It needs to be engineered specifically for a fixed panel size: 42 x 35cm artwork, 40 x 33cm finished after seams, with the medallion centered.

Color palette: olive green, navy, cream, and gold accents.

Deliverables needed:
1. Full-color artwork file (TIFF or high-res PNG, 300-600 DPI, wide-gamut RGB) plus a vector version (AI/EPS)
2. A separate simplified vector "quilting guide" file outlining the main motif elements (medallion, large flowers) — this will be used to guide raised trapunto-style stitching on the fabric
3. A layered PSD as an editable source file

Ideal candidate: experience in surface pattern design, seamless/engineered repeat patterns, ornamental or floral textile design. Portfolio examples in a similar style are a strong plus.

title: Professional Slide Decks
description:
**Presentation Designer for High-End Professional Slide Decks**

We’re looking for an experienced presentation designer who has created polished, professional slide decks for clients in areas such as creative, design, sales, marketing, editorial, or similar fields.

This is specifically for someone whose portfolio demonstrates strong visual design - not simply clean PowerPoint formatting or standard corporate templates.

### What we’re looking for

Your work should demonstrate:

* **Creative design variety:** Diverse layouts, templates, shapes, imagery, typography, and visual treatments. We want more than standard stock-photo grids, circular image cutouts, and repetitive slide structures.
* **High-quality infographics:** Polished data visualizations, diagrams, process flows, charts, timelines, and other custom graphics that clearly communicate information.
* **Professional execution:** Slides should feel production-ready, with no text overflow, overlapping elements, inconsistent formatting, illegible fonts, or awkward spacing.
* **Strong visual hierarchy and layout:** Excellent use of whitespace, typography, contrast, color, sizing, and positioning to make information easy to understand.
* **Ability to turn content into visuals:** You should be comfortable taking relatively text-heavy or complex information and determining the best way to communicate it visually rather than simply placing the text onto a slide.

### Relevant experience

We’re especially interested in designers who have worked on:

* Sales and marketing decks
* Creative or brand presentations
* Editorial / report-style presentations
* Pitch decks
* Client-facing strategy presentations
* Data-heavy presentations and infographics

Experience with PowerPoint and/or Google Slides is important. Experience with Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools is a plus.

### To apply

**Please include 3-5 examples of presentation decks you personally designed (no AI generated samples  please)**

We are specifically reviewing portfolios for visual quality and variety, so please send examples that demonstrate different design styles rather than several versions of the same template.

For each example, briefly tell us:

1. What type of deck it was and who the intended audience was.
2. Which portions of the design you personally created.
3. Whether you created the infographics/data visualizations yourself.
4. What tools you used.

**Important:** Please do not apply without presentation-specific portfolio examples. General graphic design, website design, or branding portfolios without slide deck examples will not be sufficient. Please do NOT submit AI-generated samples.

title: Amazon PPC Campaign Management Expert Needed
description:
We are a pet care company based in US, seeking an experienced professional to manage our Amazon PPC campaigns. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of keyword research, bid management, and ad optimization to drive traffic and conversions. You will be responsible for creating and monitoring campaigns, analyzing performance metrics, and implementing strategies to improve ROI. Strong communication skills and the ability to provide regular updates are essential. If you have a proven track record in managing pet products' Amazon PPC campaigns, we would love to hear from you!

Our biggest struggle at the moment: ACOS is insanely high. at 70%-80%+ (used to be 50%+), and TACOS 50%+.  our previous agency partner fails to bring it down after 3 months. The most important step for us at the moment is to bring down the ACOS. We would love to have a creative thinker to find ways to generate sales profitably.

Payment: First 2 weeks will be a trial period, your payment will be 3-5% off of ad sales, so how much you can make is up to you. We need to see your proven ACOS reduction strategy. Once we see your good work we can proceed with standard monthly payment.

Requirement:
1. Fast turnaround
2. Good communication
3. Mandatory weekly meeting on PPC audits + optimization summary
4. You need to be versatile and constantly looking for strategies to sell profitably. pet care on amazon is tough with expensive CPC. we need outside of the box thinkers!

title: Shopify/Replo Landing Page Designer — DTC Supplement Brand
description:
Lunée Health is a DTC supplement brand for women dealing with PCOS-related hair loss and thinning. We're looking for a Replo expert to build out a high-converting product landing page.

Style reference: We love the layout, structure, and visual polish of takesalis.com/products/sea-moss-gummies — hero section with price up front, problem/mechanism breakdown, ingredient callouts, comparison table, timeline, before/afters, tiered pricing, FAQ. We want that same caliber of design and information architecture, fully rebuilt with Lunée's own branding, product, copy, and imagery — not a direct copy.

Scope of work:

Build the page directly in Replo (we have an active Replo account/workspace)
Structure: hero, problem/mechanism section, ingredient/comparison breakdown, timeline or "what to expect," before/after or testimonial section, 3-tier pricing block, FAQ, trust/purity badges, final CTA
Use our brand colors, fonts, and product photography (we'll provide brand assets, or you can help source/create supporting graphics as needed)
Fully responsive (mobile-first — most of our traffic is mobile)
Clean, editable Replo components so our internal team can swap copy, images, colors, and font sizing ourselves after handoff without breaking the layout
Optimize for page speed and conversion best practices (clear CTA, minimal above-the-fold friction, price visibility)

Nice to have:

Experience with DTC supplement or beauty/wellness brands
Familiarity with Shopify + Replo integration
Copywriting or CRO background

Deliverable: A fully built, editable Replo page/template ready to publish.

title: Meta Ads Agency
description:
**Job Title: Meta Ads Agency (or freelancer) Needed for Ongoing E-Commerce Campaign Management — $450/Month**

We are looking for an experienced **Meta Ads agency** to manage and optimize paid advertising for our luxury fragrance brand.

This is an ongoing engagement with a fixed management fee of **$450 per month**. Our expected advertising spend will be approximately **$6,000 per month**, with the potential to scale based on performance.

**Responsibilities:**

* Create, launch, and manage campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager
* Develop campaign structures for prospecting, retargeting, and customer retention
* Monitor and optimize campaigns to improve ROAS, CAC, conversion rate, and overall profitability
* Test audiences, placements, offers, creative concepts, and ad copy
* Identify underperforming campaigns and make timely adjustments
* Review tracking accuracy, including the Meta Pixel and Conversions API
* Provide clear weekly performance updates and actionable recommendations
* Work with our internal team to communicate which creative assets and angles are needed
* Help us develop a scalable advertising strategy as the brand grows

**Requirements:**

* You must be an established agency—not an individual freelancer
* Demonstrated experience managing Meta Ads for e-commerce brands
* Strong understanding of campaign structure, attribution, creative testing, and performance optimization
* Experience managing accounts with at least $5,000 in monthly ad spend
* Ability to show real case studies, campaign results, or Ads Manager screenshots
* Clear communication and consistent account monitoring
* Experience with fragrance, beauty, fashion, or other premium consumer brands is preferred

Additional capabilities such as creative strategy, ad copywriting, landing-page recommendations, tracking support, or conversion-rate optimization are a major plus.

**Compensation:**

$450 fixed price per month, structured through recurring monthly milestones. Advertising spend is separate and will be paid directly through our Meta ad account.

**To Apply:**

Please include:

1. A brief introduction to your agency and the team members who would manage our account
2. Two or three relevant e-commerce case studies with actual performance metrics
3. The typical monthly ad spend you currently manage
4. Your approach to testing and scaling an account spending approximately $6,000 per month
5. The additional services included within your $450 monthly fee

title: Automotive Instrument Cluster Warranty Triage Specialist (Electronics Experience Required)
description:
Description:
Looking for someone with real experience working on instrument cluster electronics to help handle warranty claims for ISS Automotive (www.issautomotive.com).

What you’ll do:

Talk to customers about failed instrument clusters
Dig into the symptoms and figure out if it’s actually a cluster problem or something else in the vehicle (battery, grounds, sensors, wiring, water damage, etc.)
Decide whether we should repair it under warranty, refund, or tell the customer it’s a vehicle-side issue
Document clear reasoning so decisions stay consistent
Over time, help build simple technical guides and train others on how to triage these calls

Must-have:

Hands-on experience with instrument cluster electronics / gauge clusters (repair, diagnostics, or related work)
Ability to ask good diagnostic questions and make solid judgment calls
Clear, calm communication with customers
Comfortable saying “this isn’t a cluster problem” when that’s the reality

Nice to have:

Experience with GM, Ford, or truck clusters
Any background creating troubleshooting guides or training people

This is a mix of customer calls + technical decision-making. Not a basic customer service role - we need someone who actually understands cluster electronics and can tell the difference between a real failure and a vehicle problem. If you’ve worked on instrument clusters and can think through warranty issues logically, send over a short note about your experience.

title: Full-Stack Embedded Hardware Engineer: High-Efficiency ESP32 Power System & Display
description:
We are seeking an expert Full-Stack Embedded Hardware Engineer to design a high-performance, ultra-compact portable power supply device featuring an integrated color digital display screen. This project requires combining advanced power regulation electronics, battery safety management, and custom firmware into a unified, high-density layout optimized for a restricted cylindrical enclosure.
The physical form factor and mechanical connection constraints are pre-defined via existing .step 3D CAD models. This project requires advanced power optimization, dynamic motor regulation, and precise battery management to eliminate standby drain and handle high-torque motor loads while outputting real-time diagnostic telemetry.
Scope of Work:
Circuit Design & Power Architecture: Schematic capture and multi-layer PCB layout optimization for high-current delivery (up to 3A continuous, 6A peak) within a highly restricted physical footprint. Must utilize a monolithic synchronous buck-boost charging topology to maximize thermal efficiency and maintain absolute voltage stability under varying motor loads.
Battery Management System (BMS): Integrate a dedicated Texas Instruments (TI) BMS IC featuring integrated Power Path management (allowing concurrent device operation and charging via USB-C) and programmable Ship Mode functionality. The system is designed around a user-replaceable, high-drain industrial 18350 lithium-ion cylindrical cell.
Standby Optimization: Implementation of a nano-amp idle/standby state utilizing a dedicated electronic power path cutoff to completely mitigate native ESP32 deep-sleep current trickle.
Motor Control & Sensing: Implement an analog feedback loop to monitor motor Back-EMF. The firmware must dynamically compensate for voltage sag under mechanical load to maintain flat, consistent RPM output. Include configurable startup profiles (Programmable Jumpstart) to kick over high-resistance mechanical loads.
Real-Time Telemetry Data: Integrate an inline low-side current-sense resistor and an ADC monitoring circuit. The firmware must calculate and render real-time operational diagnostics on the display, including active Amperage draw, Back-EMF calculated RPM, and a dynamic relative Torque/Load percentage bar.
Firmware Development: Writing embedded C source code compiled strictly within the native ESP-IDF framework and utilizing FreeRTOS for real-time task scheduling and dual-core isolation. Core 0 will handle high-frequency power tracking, sensing loops, and safety monitoring; Core 1 will handle the user interface, session analytics (active run-time tracking), and display rendering.
Interface Integration: Designing the high-speed SPI bus with Direct Memory Access (DMA) to drive a 240x240 color TFT/IPS display module (ST7789 driver) and physical tactile input buttons, ensuring fluid rendering (30+ FPS) without CPU bottlenecks.
Manufacturing Preparation: Delivering production-ready, turnkey manufacturing files including Gerber, Bill of Materials (BOM) with exact manufacturer part numbers, and CPL coordinate files optimized for automated assembly lines (JLCPCB/PCBWay compatibility).
Required Qualifications:
Proven history of designing lithium battery management systems (BMS) and DC-DC power converter layout paths.
Expertise in high-density multi-layer PCB routing using Altium Designer or KiCad.
Deep experience writing firmware for microcontrollers strictly under native vendor SDKs (ESP-IDF), rather than Arduino frameworks, to manage SPI displays, graphics rendering, and ADC calculations.
A portfolio demonstrating completed hardware products that successfully transitioned from prototype to automated factory assembly floors.
Project Terms:
This is a milestone-based project. Selected candidates will be required to sign a Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) prior to interviewing or receiving detailed physical constraints, CAD data, and target application profiles.

title: Improve conversational quality of a real-time AI voice roleplay bot (Claude + Deepgram, ASP.NET)
description:
We run a sales-training web app where our reps practice sales calls by speaking, in real time, with an AI that plays a small-business owner. It works end to end today — speech in, AI reply out, graded report card at the end — but the conversation doesn't yet feel like talking to a person. We're hiring someone to debug and enhance the conversational layer.

Payment: Flat rate of $300

The stack you'd be working in:

ASP.NET WebForms / .NET Framework 4.8 backend (C#), with a streaming HTTP endpoint driving the conversation
Anthropic Claude API (Sonnet) for the roleplay brain, with a knowledge-base-driven system prompt
Deepgram streaming speech-to-text (endpointing/utterance tuning)
Resemble.ai text-to-speech, with browser TTS fallback
Vanilla JavaScript front end (no framework), half-duplex mic gating

What "more conversational" means to us — the concrete problems:

Turn-taking. The bot occasionally cuts the rep off mid-sentence, or pauses too long before replying. We've tuned Deepgram endpointing and added content-aware wait times; it's better but not human.
First-response latency. The opening reply is slower than mid-conversation replies. We want the gap to be imperceptible.
Persona consistency. Under a long conversation the AI can drift out of character (e.g., forgetting its assigned business, or slipping out of the "prospect" role). We use fixed persona facts in the prompt; it still drifts occasionally.
Naturalness. Replies can feel scripted. We want disfluencies, acknowledgments, interruptions handled gracefully — the texture of a real phone call.

Scope: debug the issues above, propose and implement improvements, and prove them with before/after measurements (latency numbers, and recorded test conversations). We have a closed-loop test rig that can inject scripted turns, which you'd use and can extend.

What we're NOT looking for: a rebuild on a new framework, a switch to a different LLM vendor, or an off-the-shelf chatbot platform. This is surgical improvement of a working system.

Constraints you should be comfortable with:

Parts of the codebase compile on the server with the legacy C# 5 compiler (no string interpolation, no null-conditional operators). We'll tell you exactly which files.
You'll work on a feature branch with PR review — never directly on production. We deploy; you don't need server access.
API keys stay ours; you'll develop against a test configuration we provide.

To apply, please answer:

Describe a real-time voice agent (STT → LLM → TTS) you've personally built or tuned. What was your end-to-end latency, and what got it there?
How would you approach barge-in (the user starting to talk while the bot is speaking) in a browser where echo cancellation can't see the TTS audio?
What's your experience with prompt design for persona stability over 20+ turn conversations?

Applications that don't answer these three questions will not be considered.

Engagement: hourly, starting with a paid diagnostic milestone (~5–10 hours: reproduce the issues, deliver a written findings-and-plan doc). Strong plan → we proceed to implementation.

title: Meta and TikTok Ads Creative Strategist [Ad Creative Manager]
description:
Luxford is hiring a Creative Strategist to own the entire paid social creative engine for Meta and TikTok, from first concept to finished ad. You will lead strategy and execution for both static and video creative, with full accountability for what gets made and how it performs. The output target is 50- 100 new creative assets per month, produced on a consistent weekly cadence. You will develop the concepts, write the copy, and build the briefs for every asset. You will source your own creators through Insense and similar UGC platforms, negotiate the engagements, and manage those relationships directly. Once creators are booked, you will brief them, direct them, and hold the footage to your standard before it moves forward. You will then hand approved footage to editors and oversee the edit through final delivery, ensuring every ad matches the concept it came from. This role reports directly to the CEO and has a dedicated video editor and graphic designer to execute production.

This is for experienced creative strategists only. 

You must have a link to your creative portfolio for both static ads and video ads. Do not apply if you do not have a portfolio. 

This role is 20-30 hours/week for now but will have opportunity to go full time (40+ hours/wk) plus monthly bonuses for good performance. Real earning potential for the right person.

This role reports directly to the CEO and has a dedicated video editor and graphic designer to execute production.

This is for experienced creative strategists only. 

You must have a link to your creative portfolio for both static ads and video ads. Do not apply if you do not have a portfolio. 

This role is 20-30 hours/week for now but will have opportunity to go full time (40+ hours/week) plus monthly bonuses for good performance. Real earning potential for the right person.

title: Organic social from zero — home services (HVAC + plumbing), multiple markets
description:
We're a home services company running HVAC and plumbing in a few U.S. markets. Paid is already covered — we have a specialist on Google and Meta. Organic is the part nobody has owned, and you can tell. The accounts are close to empty.

That's the job. Build it from nothing and make it bring in work.

Here's what you'd actually be walking into. Our techs are good at their jobs and have zero interest in being on camera. The office managers are busy. Nobody here thinks in hooks or captions or posting cadence. So if your system depends on everyone caring about marketing as much as you do, it dies in week two. The person who wins this role is the one who can hand a tech a card that says "film this, twenty seconds, hold the phone sideways" and actually get the clip back on Tuesday.

What you'd own

Facebook and Instagram for the residential side. LinkedIn for commercial, where the buyer is a property manager or a facility director and the content looks more like case studies than tips. Email campaigns that line up with whatever we're pushing that month. A weekly calendar that stays a week ahead instead of a day. And the SOPs that make all of it repeatable by people who don't work in marketing.

You'd report to someone on our management team. Everything runs in ClickUp.

Non-negotiable: Nano Banana 2

You need to be genuinely good with Nano Banana 2 — Google's image model. Not "I've watched a demo." Good. A lot of what we need is graphics and image work turned out fast and on brand, and I'm not interested in waiting two weeks for one post. If you've already built a workflow around it, say so. That moves you to the top of the pile.

Alongside that: you've grown multiple social accounts before, ideally for a service business — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, restoration, anything close. Residential and commercial both. If your whole portfolio is e-commerce or SaaS, this probably isn't the right fit.

What you get

Real autonomy. You own the channel, you're not executing someone else's plan. We decide fast — no committee, no six-week approval cycle. Bring an idea Monday, run it Wednesday. Contract to start, and if it's working I'd rather keep someone long term than rebuild this every six months.

Rate is open. Hourly or monthly, whichever you prefer — tell me what you need and we'll talk.

What 90 days looks like

First week, you bring us a 90-day plan. By day 90, content is going out consistently across every account, it looks good enough that I'd be happy sending a customer to the page, and there's real engagement behind it. Comments, saves, DMs, calls. Not bought followers.

To apply

Three things. Skip the cover letter.

Links to accounts you've grown. Tell me where they started and where they ended up.
Two or three pieces you made with Nano Banana 2, plus a sentence on how you made them.
Your rate and how many hours a week you can commit.

No test project, no spec work. Just show me what you've already done.

title: Short-Form Video Editor for Home Remodeling Content (Ongoing)
description:
We're a bathroom and kitchen remodeling company based in the Washington state. We're building a personal brand/content presence for our owner on Instagram (other platforms to follow) — raw job-site footage, before/after content, and straight-talk videos about how remodeling actually works.

We need an editor who can take unedited phone footage and turn it into polished, hook-driven short-form video (Reels/TikTok style) — without needing heavy direction each time.

What you'll be working with:

Raw vertical phone footage from active job sites (walk-and-talk narration, before/during/after shots, candid problem-solving moments)
Occasional talking-head clips recorded separately from job sites

Responsibilities:

Edit raw clips into finished short-form videos (15-60 sec) with captions, pacing, and a strong opening hook
Add on-brand captions/text overlays (style guide will be provided)
Turn around a batch of videos on a consistent weekly schedule
Flag when raw footage is too thin or unusable so we can adjust what we send

Requirements:

Proven experience editing short-form content for Instagram Reels/TikTok — please include links to work you've personally edited, ideally in home services, trades, or a similar "real work, real footage" niche

Strong sense for hooks and pacing — the first 2 seconds need to earn the rest of the watch
Comfortable working from raw, imperfect phone footage (not polished B-roll)
Reliable weekly turnaround

How to apply:

Send 2-3 links to short-form videos you've edited (not shot — edited). If selected, we'll send 2-3 raw clips and ask for a short paid test edit before any ongoing commitment.

Budget: $20-40/video for the first month to test fit, then move to a weekly rate once you find someone consistent.

title: AutoCAD Drafter – Residential, ADU & Septic-to-Sewer Plans
description:
AutoCAD Drafter – Residential, ADU & Septic-to-Sewer Plans

English

I am looking for a reliable AutoCAD drafter to provide drafting support for residential and civil-related projects on an as-needed basis.

Projects may include:

* Existing conditions and demolition plans
* Proposed residential floor plans
* Single-family residential projects and remodels
* Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs)
* Site plans
* Septic-to-public-sewer conversion plans
* Sewer connection and utility plans
* Septic tank abandonment, removal, or modification plans
* Sections, details, dimensions, notes, and permit drawings

I will typically provide field measurements, photographs, sketches, markups, existing plans, and project information.

Depending on the project, engineering requirements or redlines may also be provided for incorporation into the drawings.

The ideal candidate should have strong AutoCAD drafting skills and experience with residential or civil/site drawings.

Experience with U.S. residential permitting, ADUs, septic systems, sewer connections, utility plans, or septic-to-sewer conversions is highly preferred.

I am interested in establishing an ongoing working relationship with a reliable drafter for future projects.

Please include samples of relevant AutoCAD work, especially residential plans, site plans, ADUs, utility plans, or sewer-related projects.

Final deliverables may include DWG and PDF files.

---

Español

Busco un dibujante de AutoCAD confiable para brindar apoyo en proyectos residenciales y proyectos relacionados con infraestructura civil, según sea necesario.

Los proyectos pueden incluir:

* Planos de condiciones existentes y demolición

What makes this project different from most animation briefs:

• The storyboard is already finished. 27 shots across 8 acts, 2 minutes 57 seconds, with timings, camera directions, on-screen text and voice-over written. You are not starting from a blank page.
• A high-quality 3D model of the product already exists and will be supplied. Only the environment and supporting assets need modelling.
• Voice-over and music are out of scope — we handle those.

The quality bar is roughly 70% photorealistic and 30% engineering visualisation. The hardest part is the underwater work: believable bubble-plume dynamics, CFD-style streamlines and volumetric particles. That is the part we will judge quotes on.

If this interests you, please send:

1. Portfolio links to 3D product or mechanism animation, pointing to the specific shots closest to this brief
2. A fixed price, broken down by phase
3. Timeline and number of revision rounds included
4. Your approach to the bubble-plume and flow simulation
5. Software and render pipeline, and which model formats you can work with

I recently acquired a small service-based marketing company and am looking for an experienced QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor/bookkeeper to properly set up and clean up our QuickBooks account.

Our bank accounts and business credit cards are already connected to QuickBooks. The business has approximately 30–50 incoming client payments per month and roughly 100 expense transactions per month. There is no inventory.

What I'm looking for:
Review and properly structure our Chart of Accounts
Review and categorize existing transactions
Make sure bank and credit-card accounts are properly connected and reconciled
Set up bank rules/automation for recurring transactions and vendors
Make sure client revenue is being categorized properly
Review how payroll and other recurring expenses are being recorded
Bring the books completely current and reconciled
Verify that the P&L and Balance Sheet are accurate
Recommend any improvements to our QuickBooks setup
Provide a training/walkthrough session with me and my CEO so we can handle the routine monthly bookkeeping ourselves going forward

This is primarily a one-time setup/cleanup and training project, not an ongoing monthly bookkeeping engagement. However, I would potentially be interested in having the same person perform a quarterly review of our books after the initial project.

I'd prefer someone who is QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certified and has experience setting up and cleaning up books for small service-based businesses.

Please provide your fixed-price quote, estimated turnaround time, and a brief description of similar QuickBooks cleanup/setup projects you've handled.

title: B2B Market Researcher – OTC Drug Brand Owners & Manufacturers
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented B2B market researcher to identify and qualify potential clients for a U.S. FDA regulatory consulting firm.

You will be trained to research OTC drug brand owners and contract manufacturers that may need support with FDA establishment registration, drug listing, or labeling compliance. This is specialized regulatory research—not mass email marketing, cold calling, or generic lead-list building.

Your work will include:

* Identifying OTC products and their associated brand owners and/or contract manufacturers.
* Researching company websites, product pages, Amazon, other online marketplaces, and public databases.
* Recording supporting evidence links and providing a concise explanation of the potential regulatory opportunity.
* Identifying publicly available business contact information.
* Preparing a short, personalized outreach email based on your research.

Skill Requirements:

* Strong online and company research skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow a specific research process.
* Clear, professional written English.
* Ability to work with Google Sheets or Excel.
* Experience with B2B lead research, Amazon/product research, FDA databases, regulatory affairs, or compliance research is a plus. Full training on our research process will be provided.

This engagement will begin with a paid, fixed-price test project. Successful performance may lead to ongoing research assignments.

When applying, please answer the following:

1. Briefly describe your experience with B2B/company research or prospect qualification.
2. Which sources would you use to identify OTC brand owners and contract manufacturers?
3. In 3–5 sentences, explain how you would evaluate whether an OTC product may present a U.S. FDA registration or drug-listing opportunity.
4. Please attach an anonymized example of similar research, if available.

title: Instagram Reel edits
description:
Short-Form Video Editor for Viral Street Magic / POV Instagram Content

I’m looking for a creative short-form video editor to edit POV street magic videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and potentially YouTube Shorts.

The raw footage will primarily be POV interactions of me performing street magic for strangers. Your job is to turn that footage into fast-paced, entertaining content that keeps people watching.

What I’m Looking For

I don’t want someone who just cuts clips together and adds captions.

I’m looking for an editor who understands short-form retention, internet culture, memes, comedic timing, sound design, and storytelling.

You’ll be expected to:

* Edit POV street magic footage into engaging short-form videos
* Find and remove boring/dead moments
* Create strong hooks within the first 1–3 seconds
* Add memes, reaction clips, images, zooms, sound effects, and trending sounds where appropriate
* Use captions strategically without making the screen feel cluttered
* Highlight funny/awkward reactions from people
* Build anticipation before the magic reveal
* Make the final reveal/reaction hit harder through pacing and sound design
* Study reference creators I provide and replicate the editing principles, pacing, humor, and energy while still developing our own recognizable style
* Optimize videos for Instagram Reels/TikTok/Shorts

Editing Style

Think:

POV street magic + fast-paced storytelling + internet humor + meme culture.

The editing should enhance my personality and the reactions rather than feel over-edited for no reason.

Retention matters more than flashy effects.

Ideal Editor

You should:

* Have experience editing Reels, TikToks, or YouTube Shorts
* Understand what makes people stop scrolling
* Have a strong sense of humor/comedic timing
* Know current memes and internet culture
* Be comfortable finding relevant meme clips, sounds, and creative assets
* Be able to take inspiration from reference videos and recreate the editing approach
* Communicate well and handle feedback quickly
* Be interested in working together consistently if the content performs well

To Apply

Please send:

1. 3 examples of short-form videos you’ve personally edited
2. Your price per finished video
3. Your typical turnaround time
4. The editing software you use
5. A brief explanation of what you would do to make a 30–60 second POV street magic video more engaging

Important: Start your application with the word MAGIC so I know you actually read the post.

Paid Test

I’ll likely select a few promising editors for a paid test edit using the same raw footage.

The editor who best understands the pacing, humor, retention, and overall vision will have the opportunity for consistent ongoing work.

title: AI Evaluation Specialist — Video Sourcing & Adversarial Q&A
description:
We’re looking for someone experienced in AI model evaluation, red teaming, or multimodal annotation to source videos and create precise question-answer pairs designed to stump and challenge AI models.

What You’ll Do
Source videos that meet specific criteria
Analyze video content closely
Create precise question-answer pairs based only on what is shown
Design difficult questions that test the model’s reasoning and attention to detail
Identify edge cases or details that models are likely to miss
Make sure every answer is accurate, clear, and objectively supported by the video
Follow detailed guidelines and maintain consistent quality
What We’re Looking For
Experience with AI evaluation, red teaming, RLHF, benchmarking, or data annotation
Experience working with video or multimodal AI tasks
Strong reasoning and attention to detail
Ability to create challenging but fair questions
Excellent written English
Ability to follow precise instructions and quality standards
To Apply

Please share:

Your experience evaluating or testing AI models
Examples of video-based or multimodal annotation work
Any experience creating adversarial or difficult Q&A designed to expose model weaknesses
Relevant projects or companies you’ve worked with
Samples of previous work, if available

Please do not apply if your experience is limited to basic data entry or general virtual assistant work. We are specifically looking for someone who understands how to create challenging evaluation tasks for AI models.

title: Professional Short-Form Video Editor for Reels, TikTok & Business Social Media Content
description:
I’m looking for a skilled and creative video editor to work with me on an ongoing basis editing social media content for different businesses.

I will handle the filming and provide all raw footage. This may include:
- Restaurant and food content
- Product/service videos
- Business promotional content
- Skits
- Behind-the-scenes footage
- Talking-head videos
- Lifestyle content

Other short-form videos depending on the client
Your responsibility will be to take the raw footage and turn it into professional, engaging, polished social media videos that are ready to post.

The goal is not simply to cut clips together. I need someone who understands what makes short-form content visually appealing, engaging, and suitable for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms.

Responsibilities:
- Review raw footage and select the strongest shots
- Create a strong flow or story from the available footage
- Edit primarily vertical 9:16 short-form videos
- Create attention-grabbing openings and hooks
- Use professional cuts and strong pacing
- Add smooth and creative transitions where appropriate
- Use speed ramps and dynamic editing when suitable
- Handle professional colour correction and colour grading
- Make food footage look rich, vibrant, appetizing, and premium while still looking natural
- Enhance lighting, exposure, and overall image quality when necessary
- Stabilize or reframe footage where needed
- Add professional captions and subtitles when appropriate
- Use clean typography and caption animations
- Add tasteful motion graphics when they improve the video
- Handle sound design, including impacts, transitions, ambience, cooking sounds, and other effects
- Select suitable music that matches the energy and style of the content
- Sync cuts, transitions, and important moments to the music
- Clean and balance dialogue/audio when needed
- Create seamless transitions between different scenes
- Add subtle effects where they improve the content without making it look over-edited
- Maintain each business’s branding and visual style
- Export videos properly for social media
- Make revisions based on feedback

For restaurant content specifically, I want the editing to make viewers crave the food. Strong close-ups, rich colours, sizzling sounds, flames, steam, texture, good pacing, and dramatic moments are important, but the food should still look authentic and not fake or heavily altered.

For skits and entertainment content, the editor should understand comedic timing, pacing, captions, sound effects, zooms, reaction cuts, and retention-focused editing.

What I’m Looking For:
- Strong experience editing short-form social media content
- A good understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts
- Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, and viewer retention
- Excellent colour correction and colour grading skills
- Ability to make average raw footage look significantly more polished
- Good judgment around when to use effects and when to keep things clean
- Strong taste in music, sound effects, typography, and transitions
- Ability to adapt the editing style depending on the business and type of content
- Reliable communication
- Consistent turnaround times
- Ability to handle ongoing work as more client content comes in
- Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or similar professional editing software
- Experience with AI video tools or AI-assisted editing is a bonus, but the final videos should still feel natural, premium, and professionally edited rather than obviously AI-generated

This is an ongoing opportunity.
I’m looking to build a relationship with one reliable editor rather than constantly hiring different people. The amount of work will increase as I take on more businesses, so there is potential for consistent ongoing projects for the right person.

To apply, please include:
- A short introduction about your video editing experience
3–5 examples of your best short-form social media edits
- At least one restaurant or food editing example if available
- Examples of skits, business content, or high-retention Reels/TikToks if available
- The software you primarily use
- Your typical turnaround time for a 15–60 second video
- Your rate per video or preferred pricing structure
- How many short-form videos you can realistically edit per week
- Please do not send a generic portfolio with long-form videos only. I specifically want to see strong short-form social media editing.

I’m looking for someone with a strong creative eye who can take raw footage and consistently turn it into content that looks like it belongs on a professionally managed social media page.

title: AI Automation Specialist — Build Lead-to-Appointment Automation
description:
# AI Automation Specialist — Build Lead-to-Appointment Automation

## Project Overview

I own a growing service business and am looking for an experienced AI automation specialist to build a simple, reliable lead-to-appointment automation system.

I am not a programmer, so I need someone who can build the system AND explain it to me in plain English.

I am looking for someone experienced with Make.com or Zapier, webhooks, OpenAI/API integrations, and CRM automation, preferably HubSpot.

## Initial Automation

The first workflow should be able to:

1. Receive a new lead from a website/form or webhook.
2. Capture the lead's contact information and business information.
3. Add/update the lead in HubSpot.
4. Use AI to categorize or qualify the lead based on information provided.
5. Send an appropriate initial follow-up.
6. Notify me when a lead meets specific qualification criteria.
7. Assist with moving qualified leads toward scheduling an appointment.
8. Track the lead's status.
9. Provide a clear way for me to see what happened if an automation fails.

## Important Requirements

I do NOT want a complicated system built unnecessarily.

The system should be:

* Simple
* Reliable
* Easy for a non-technical business owner to understand
* Easy to modify later
* Properly documented
* Built using my accounts and credentials
* Designed so I am not dependent on the freelancer forever

## Project Structure

I want this project completed in milestones.

### Milestone 1

Review my current process and create a workflow diagram showing exactly what will be automated.

### Milestone 2

Build and test the basic lead capture → CRM workflow.

### Milestone 3

Add AI qualification and automated follow-up.

### Milestone 4

Testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and a walkthrough showing me how everything works.

## When Applying, Please Answer:

1. What AI automations have you personally built?
2. Have you built Make.com or Zapier workflows involving webhooks?
3. Have you integrated HubSpot with AI tools?
4. Have you worked with OpenAI APIs?
5. Please provide 2–3 examples of similar projects.
6. What would you recommend using for this project: Make.com or Zapier, and why?
7. What would you estimate each milestone will cost?
8. What information/access would you need from me?
9. How would you make sure I can understand and maintain the system after you finish?

## Important

Please do not propose building the entire system immediately.

I want to start with a small, clearly defined automation, test it, and expand from there if the work is successful.

I am looking for someone who can act as both a technical builder and a teacher.

Thank you.

description:
Who we are
We’re a Danish performance marketing agency running Google Ads and Meta Ads for e-commerce and lead gen clients across Europe. Our positioning is profit-first: we optimize for POAS (profit on ad spend), not vanity metrics like ROAS or clicks.
Why we’re hiring:
 I want someone who does lead gen on Meta every day to take this off my plate and build a campaign that actually books meetings.
This is not a client account. You’re working directly for me, on my own lead generation.
The objective
Book qualified sales meetings with e-commerce and lead gen businesses

What you’ll do
1. Strategy and setup
Campaign structure, audience strategy, budget allocation, bidding, and conversion tracking (Pixel + CAPI). Tell me what you need from me to get it right.
2. Creative direction — this is a big part of the role
I don’t want you to just run whatever creative I hand you. I want you to tell me what creative we need and why.
	•	Video: Write clear content briefs I can hand to a creator — hook, script/talking points, shot list, format, length
	•	Static: If you can produce static creatives yourself, that’s a strong plus. If not, deliver briefs with copy, angle, and layout direction, and I’ll have them produced
	•	Plan a proper testing structure — angles, hooks, formats
3. Ongoing management
Launch, monitor, optimize. Weekly short update: what you did, what the numbers say, what you recommend next. If something isn’t working, tell me early — I’d much rather hear “this angle is dead, let’s kill it” than watch spend disappear quietly.

title: Traffic Engineer for Residential Development Access Microsimulation
description:
Seeking a traffic engineer to support a residential development project with 1,008 apartments. The work includes reviewing existing conditions, analyzing access points, and developing a microsimulation model to evaluate traffic impacts. You will assess current traffic patterns, identify potential bottlenecks, and recommend improvements to ensure safe and efficient access. Experience with residential development traffic studies and microsimulation modeling is important. This is a part-time project with a fixed budget, and the ideal freelancer can deliver a clear analysis and actionable recommendations for the project team. 
The residential development consisting of seven apartment buildings, with 144 apartments per building, for a total of 1,008 residential units.
The development currently has only one primary vehicular entrance and exit. Due to the size of the project, we need to evaluate whether this access can adequately accommodate the expected traffic demand, particularly during peak hours and at full project occupancy.
The purpose of this assignment is to develop a technically supported traffic simulation, identify potential congestion and operational risks, and evaluate alternatives to improve access and internal circulation.
This project requires an engineering-based traffic microsimulation, not only a visual animation.

INFORMATION TO INCLUDE IN YOUR PROPOSAL

Please provide:
A brief description of your relevant traffic-engineering experience.
Examples of similar residential developments or access simulations.
The software you propose to use.
The methodology you would use to estimate traffic demand for 1,008 apartments.
A description of the scenarios included in your proposal.
Confirmation that you will provide the editable native simulation model.
Identification of the information you require from us.
Your proposed fixed fee.
Your estimated turnaround time.
The number of revisions included.

title: Architectural Design for Five-Villa Development
description:
PROJECT BACKGROUND

The property does not directly border the beach; however, it has private and direct access to it.

The development will consist of five identical detached villas. Each villa must operate independently and provide a strong sense of privacy from the other units. The villas will be offered as short-term vacation rentals through Airbnb or similar platforms.

The selected architect will be responsible for designing:

One repeatable villa model.
The master plan for the complete five-villa development.
Parking, circulation, landscaping, private outdoor areas, and the connection to the private beach access.

The objective is to create an attractive, distinctive, comfortable, and operationally efficient development that performs well as a vacation-rental property and responds appropriately to the climate and architectural character of Yucatán.

title: Marketing Manager / Campaign Reviewer Facebook
description:
Marketing Manager / Social Media Campaign Reviewer

Job Title
Marketing Manager & Social Media Campaign Reviewer — Strategy, Quality Control, Optimization & Performance

Project Overview
We are looking for an experienced Marketing Manager / Social Media Campaign Reviewer to oversee, review, improve, and optimize our company’s marketing and social media campaigns.

Social Media Campaign Review
Review planned and active campaigns across platforms such as:
* Facebook
* Instagram

You will evaluate:
* Campaign concept
* Messaging
* Hook
* Headline
* Caption
* Call-to-action
* Creative quality
* Graphic design
* Video quality
* Target audience
* Offer
* Brand consistency
* Posting schedule
* Funnel alignment

Content Quality Control
Before content goes live, you should be able to answer:
* Is this worth posting?
* Will the target audience care?
* Is the hook strong enough?
* Is the message clear?
* Does the creative look professional?
* Does it match the company brand?
* Is the CTA strong?
* Is there a better way to position the offer?
* Could the content generate leads, engagement, or sales?
* What should be changed before publication?
You will provide clear revision instructions when something needs improvement.

Marketing Strategy
Help us create and continuously improve marketing strategies around:
* Brand awareness
* Lead generation
* Customer acquisition
* Organic growth
* Paid advertising
* Retargeting
* Social media growth
* Email marketing
* Content marketing
* SEO-related content
* Promotions
* Offers
* Product launches
* Sales funnels
* Landing pages
* Conversion optimization

Campaign Planning
Help develop structured campaigns with:
* Campaign objective
* Target audience
* Core offer
* Messaging angle
* Content pillars
* Platform strategy
* Posting frequency
* Creative requirements
* CTA strategy
* Lead funnel
* KPIs
* Testing plan
* Reporting process

You should also identify missing content opportunities.

title: Textile / Pattern Designer Needed for 3 Premium Silk-Style Scarf Design
description:
About Us:
We are an emerging premium private-label fashion accessory brand. Our focus is on high-quality materials, sophisticated aesthetics, and compelling brand storytelling. We are currently developing our inaugural collection and are looking for a talented and experienced Textile/Print Designer to bring our vision to life.
The Project:
We are looking for an expert designer to create 3 unique, engineered designs for square scarves. The final physical product will measure 90x90 cm and will be printed on high-end fabrics (such as silk, Tencel, or silk-microfiber blends).
The specific themes, motifs, and overall design direction will be discussed in detail with the selected candidates. We have specific concepts and moodboards ready to share and discuss during the interview phase.
We are NOT looking for simple, repeating seamless patterns. We need "engineered" scarf designs, meaning each design must be thoughtfully composed for the 90x90cm square canvas (incorporating borders, centerpieces, and balanced corner details).
Scope of Work & Deliverables:
 3 Distinct Scarf Designs: Tailored to the 90x90 cm format (plus necessary bleed for printing and hemming).
 Print-Ready Files: High-resolution files (300 DPI minimum) in TIFF, PSD, or AI formats, optimized for digital textile printing.
 Source Files: Fully layered and editable source files, with clean color separation in case adjustments are needed by the manufacturer.
 Concept & Revisions: Initial rough sketches/concepts for approval before moving to final rendering, with up to 2 rounds of revisions per design.
Requirements:
 Proven experience in textile, print, or fashion design (specifically scarves or large-scale square prints).
 Strong understanding of how designs translate onto premium fabrics and knowledge of textile printing requirements (CMYK, bleed, color profiling).
 An exceptional eye for color harmony, composition, and high-end fashion aesthetics.
 Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop.
How to Apply:
To be considered for this project, please provide:
1. A link to your portfolio, specifically highlighting any previous scarf designs or engineered prints.
2. A brief description of your design process (from concept to print-ready file).
3. Your estimated timeline for completing 3 unique designs.
4. Your proposed rate (fixed price for the total project of 3 designs).
We look forward to seeing your creative work and potentially establishing a long-term partnership as our brand expands!

title: Uiux
description:
# Senior UI/UX Designer — Full Product Flows, UX Enhancement and Ongoing Product Design

We are looking for a senior UI/UX Product Designer to work on an existing digital platform and take ownership of the complete user experience across the product.

The platform already has an established design direction and visual identity. We are not looking for someone to redesign everything from scratch. We need someone who can understand the existing product, strengthen it, make the experience consistent, and design every flow professionally from beginning to end.

This will be an ongoing product design role, not a one-time website design project.

## What You Will Do

You will be responsible for:

* Designing the complete end-to-end user experience for every major product flow.
* Reviewing existing screens and identifying UX problems, friction points, missing states, and inconsistencies.
* Enhancing the current UI while maintaining the existing brand and design direction.
* Creating clear user journeys before designing individual screens.
* Designing complete flows including onboarding, dashboards, profiles, search, discovery, messaging, subscriptions, settings, notifications, forms, and other platform experiences.
* Designing empty states, error states, loading states, success states, confirmation states, and responsive behavior.
* Thinking through what happens before, during, and after every user action.
* Improving usability without unnecessarily adding complexity to the interface.
* Maintaining consistency across the entire platform.
* Building and maintaining reusable components and a scalable design system.
* Preparing developer-ready Figma files with clear components, states, spacing, behavior, and documentation.
* Working closely with the product and development team.

## New Features

Whenever we introduce a new feature, you will not simply design a new screen.

You will be expected to understand why the feature exists, who uses it, where they discover it, how they use it, how it connects with the rest of the platform, and what happens after they use it.

You will then design the complete UX flow and experience around that feature before handing it to development.

We want someone who thinks like a Product Designer, not only a UI designer.

## Our Product

The product is eChampz, a gaming and esports ecosystem platform serving different users including:

* Gamers
* Clans and esports teams
* Gaming studios and publishers
* Recruiters and talent scouts
* Brands and companies

Because these users interact with each other inside one ecosystem, the designer must be comfortable working on multi-sided platforms, dashboards, profiles, discovery systems, social features, SaaS functionality, and marketplace-style experiences.

## Design Direction

Our existing design is already solid.

The goal is to enhance it, structure it, standardize it, and make the UX world-class.

We prefer:

* Clean and modern UI
* Premium product design
* Minimal interfaces
* Strong visual hierarchy
* Clear navigation
* Excellent usability
* Consistency across all experiences
* Professional product thinking
* Scalable design decisions

We do not want overly complicated gaming interfaces, unnecessary neon effects, excessive animations, or visually noisy designs.

The direction should feel like a world-class technology product combined with a premium gaming and esports brand.

## Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone with strong experience in:

* Figma
* Product Design
* UX Design
* UI Design
* User flows
* Wireframing
* Interactive prototypes
* Design systems
* Responsive design
* SaaS platforms
* Dashboards
* Social and community platforms
* Complex multi-user products

Experience designing gaming, esports, social networks, marketplaces, recruitment platforms, or ecosystem products is a major advantage.

## Important

Please do not apply if your process is mainly receiving requirements and immediately designing a screen.

We need someone who can challenge requirements, identify missing experiences, suggest improvements, and think through the complete journey.

For example, if we ask you to design a Clan Tryouts feature, we expect you to think about:

Who creates the tryout?

Who can see it?

How does a gamer discover it?

How does a gamer apply?

What information is required?

What does the clan see?

How are applicants reviewed and compared?

What notifications are triggered?

What happens when someone is accepted or rejected?

How does the feature connect to the gamer profile and clan profile?

What happens after the tryout is completed?

Then you design the complete experience from beginning to end.

## When Applying

Please include:

1. Your strongest Figma product design portfolio.
2. Examples of complete UX flows you personally designed.
3. Examples of SaaS, social, marketplace, gaming, or complex platform products.
4. A short explanation of your UX process when receiving a new feature.
5. Your availability for ongoing work.

We are looking for someone who can become the long-term UI/UX Product Designer for eChampz and continuously improve the platform as existing experiences are enhanced and new features are developed.

We need someone who can understand the existing product, strengthen it, make the experience consistent, and design every flow professionally from beginning to end.

This will be an ongoing product design role, not a one-time website design project.

## What You Will Do

You will be responsible for:

* Designing the complete end-to-end user experience for every major product flow.
* Reviewing existing screens and identifying UX problems, friction points, missing states, and inconsistencies.
* Enhancing the current UI while maintaining the existing brand and design direction.
* Creating clear user journeys before designing individual screens.
* Designing complete flows including onboarding, dashboards, profiles, search, discovery, messaging, subscriptions, settings, notifications, forms, and other platform experiences.
* Designing empty states, error states, loading states, success states, confirmation states, and responsive behavior.
* Thinking through what happens before, during, and after every user action.
* Improving usability without unnecessarily adding complexity to the interface.
* Maintaining consistency across the entire platform.
* Building and maintaining reusable components and a scalable design system.
* Preparing developer-ready Figma files with clear components, states, spacing, behavior, and documentation.
* Working closely with the product and development team.

## New Features

Whenever we introduce a new feature, you will not simply design a new screen.

You will be expected to understand why the feature exists, who uses it, where they discover it, how they use it, how it connects with the rest of the platform, and what happens after they use it.

You will then design the complete UX flow and experience around that feature before handing it to development.

We want someone who thinks like a Product Designer, not only a UI designer.

## Our Product

The product is eChampz, a gaming and esports ecosystem platform serving different users including:

* Gamers
* Clans and esports teams
* Gaming studios and publishers
* Recruiters and talent scouts
* Brands and companies

Because these users interact with each other inside one ecosystem, the designer must be comfortable working on multi-sided platforms, dashboards, profiles, discovery systems, social features, SaaS functionality, and marketplace-style experiences.

## Design Direction

Our existing design is already solid.

The goal is to enhance it, structure it, standardize it, and make the UX world-class.

We prefer:

* Clean and modern UI
* Premium product design
* Minimal interfaces
* Strong visual hierarchy
* Clear navigation
* Excellent usability
* Consistency across all experiences
* Professional product thinking
* Scalable design decisions

We do not want overly complicated gaming interfaces, unnecessary neon effects, excessive animations, or visually noisy designs.

The direction should feel like a world-class technology product combined with a premium gaming and esports brand.

## Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone with strong experience in:

* Figma
* Product Design
* UX Design
* UI Design
* User flows
* Wireframing
* Interactive prototypes
* Design systems
* Responsive design
* SaaS platforms
* Dashboards
* Social and community platforms
* Complex multi-user products

Experience designing gaming, esports, social networks, marketplaces, recruitment platforms, or ecosystem products is a major advantage.

## Important

Please do not apply if your process is mainly receiving requirements and immediately designing a screen.

We need someone who can challenge requirements, identify missing experiences, suggest improvements, and think through the complete journey.

For example, if we ask you to design a Clan Tryouts feature, we expect you to think about:

Who creates the tryout?

Who can see it?

How does a gamer discover it?

How does a gamer apply?

What information is required?

What does the clan see?

How are applicants reviewed and compared?

What notifications are triggered?

What happens when someone is accepted or rejected?

How does the feature connect to the gamer profile and clan profile?

What happens after the tryout is completed?

- Add subtle zooms or cursor emphasis only where needed

3. “Get real-world dimensions in seconds”

- One reasonable revision round included

When applying, please send:
- One example of a software screen-recording, Loom edit, tutorial, or SaaS demo you personally edited
- What editing software you use
- Confirmation that you can deliver within 2–3 days

title: Feature Screenwriter Needed to Develop Original Commercial Thriller From Source Material
description:
I am looking for an experienced feature screenwriter to develop an original commercial genre feature screenplay from a collection of original story material.

This is not a traditional screenplay-from-a-blank-page assignment.

I have a substantial archive of original scenes, character moments, situations, and story fragments. The goal is to identify the strongest feature film hidden inside the material and develop it into a compelling screenplay.

The strongest direction may fall within:
- Romantic thriller
- Crime thriller
- Psychological thriller
- Sci-fi-adjacent thriller (including social/speculative concepts)

I am open to the writer’s perspective on which genre best serves the material.

The ideal writer enjoys story discovery and development and is someone who can analyze raw material, identify the strongest commercial concept, and build a professional feature around it.

Responsibilities:
- Review source material and identify the strongest feature concept
- Develop the protagonist, emotional engine, central conflict, and structure
- Transform fragmented ideas into a cohesive cinematic screenplay
- Make strong creative decisions around genre, pacing, tone, and audience appeal
- Deliver a polished feature screenplay draft

The source material explores themes including:
- identity, self-image, and reinvention
- loneliness, connection, and belonging
- relationships, attraction, trust, and uncertainty
- ambition, desperation, and personal consequences
- money, status, and the pressure to survive
- technology, systems, and how modern life shapes identity
- secrets, deception, suspense, and escalating conflict

The goal is not to preserve every individual scene or detail exactly. The goal is to discover and create the strongest possible movie while maintaining the creative DNA of the source material.

Ideal Candidate:
- Has experience writing feature-length screenplays
- Understands commercial genre storytelling
- Has strong instincts for character, structure, pacing, and audience engagement
- Can develop stories from incomplete or fragmented source material
- Is comfortable making creative choices rather than simply following notes

Rights & Ownership:
- This is a work-for-hire development project. A written agreement covering ownership, confidentiality, and rights transfer will be provided before work begins.
- Upon payment, all screenplay rights and original work product created specifically for this project will be assigned to the client.
