title: 3D AI Avatar Model + GLB/VRM + Character Blueprint
description:
3D AI Avatar Model + GLB/VRM + Character Blueprint

Job Title
3D Character Artist Needed — Production-Ready AI Avatar, Rigged GLB/VRM + Character Blueprint

Project Overview
We are looking for an experienced 3D character artist / avatar developer to create a high-quality, production-ready 3D AI avatar** that will be used inside an interactive AI software platform.

We already have the visual concept/design for the character. Your job will be to transform the reference artwork into a professional fully modeled, textured, rigged, and animation-ready 3D avatar.

The avatar must be suitable for real-time AI interaction, including facial expressions, lip-sync, body animation, and future integration into web, desktop, and mobile applications.

This is not just a static 3D character. We need a technically correct avatar that can eventually speak, animate, react, and interact with users.

Required Deliverables

1. Complete 3D Avatar

Create the complete character based on our supplied references, including:
* Full body
* Head and face
* Hair
* Eyes
* Skin
* Clothing
* Shoes/accessories
* High-quality materials and textures
* Accurate proportions matching the reference design

The model should look polished both up close and at normal application viewing distance.

2. Rigged Character
The avatar must include a professional humanoid rig suitable for:
* Walking
* Standing
* Sitting
* Hand gestures
* Head movement
* Body animation
* AI-generated animation
* Motion capture compatibility where possible

Preferred compatibility with standard humanoid skeleton systems.

3. Facial Rig / Expressions
The character needs facial animation capabilities for an AI assistant.

This should include:
* Eye blinking
* Eye movement
* Eyebrow movement
* Smiling
* Frowning
* Jaw movement
* Mouth movement
* Cheek movement
* Basic emotional expressions
Facial blendshapes / morph targets are strongly preferred.

4. AI Lip-Sync / Visemes
The avatar must be capable of being connected to real-time speech and AI-generated voice.

Please include appropriate **visemes / mouth shapes** for speech animation.

Ideally compatible with systems such as:
* ARKit-style facial blendshapes
* Oculus/Meta visemes
* NVIDIA Audio2Face
* Unity lip-sync systems
* Unreal Engine facial animation
* Custom AI speech systems

Please explain what facial system you recommend.

Required File Formats
Final delivery must include:
GLB / GLTF
VRM
Original editable/source file, preferably:
  * `.BLEND`
  * Maya file if applicable
  * FBX where useful

The GLB and VRM files are mandatory

All textures, materials, rigs, blendshapes, and dependencies must be properly included or supplied.
Avatar Blueprint / Character Documentation

We also want a professional character blueprint / model sheet documenting the final avatar.

This should include:
* Front view
* Back view
* Left-side view
* Right-side view
* 3/4 view
* Face close-up
* Body proportions
* Character height/proportion reference
* Clothing breakdown
* Material/texture references
* Hair details
* Color palette
* Facial expression examples
* Rigging overview
* Facial blendshape / viseme list
* File structure
* Polygon count
* Texture resolutions
* Technical specifications

The purpose of this blueprint is to allow our development team to recreate, modify, expand, or produce additional versions of the avatar later.

## Real-Time Optimization
The character will eventually be used inside a software application, so the model should be optimized for real-time rendering.

Please consider:
* Reasonable polygon count
* Clean topology
* Efficient UV mapping
* PBR materials
* Optimized textures
* LOD-ready topology where appropriate
* Efficient hair solution
* Optimized facial geometry
* Mobile/Web/Desktop performance considerations
We want excellent visual quality without making the model unnecessarily heavy.

Preferred Technical Compatibility
Experience with any of the following is a major advantage:
* Blender
* Unity
* Unreal Engine
* VRM
* Ready Player Me
* NVIDIA Audio2Face
* MetaHuman workflows
* ARKit blendshapes
* Three.js / WebGL
* GLTF / GLB
* Mixamo
* Motion capture
* AI avatars
* Real-time conversational characters

Quality Level
We are looking for something closer to a **premium game-quality / cinematic real-time AI character**, not a basic low-poly avatar.

The character should feel professional enough to become a primary face and personality of our AI platform.

Ownership We require:
* Full commercial usage rights
* Full ownership of the completed custom character
* Original source files
* Permission to modify the character
* Permission to animate the character
* Permission to use the character commercially
* Permission to create future clothing, skins, hairstyles, and variations

Any third-party assets must be disclosed before use.

Potential Long-Term Work

This could become an ongoing relationship.

Future work may include:
* Male avatar version
* Additional characters
* Different hairstyles
* Clothing packs
* Executive outfits
* Casual outfits
* Futuristic outfits
* Seasonal skins
* Facial expressions
* Animation libraries
* AI behaviors
* Avatar environments
* Avatar customization systems

When Applying Please send:
1. Examples of 3D human characters you have created
2. Examples of GLB or VRM avatars
3. Examples of facial rigs / blendshapes
4. Examples of characters capable of lip-sync
5. What software you use
6. Whether you can provide both **GLB and VRM**
7. Whether you can provide the original editable source files
8. What facial blendshape/viseme system you recommend for a real-time AI avatar
9. Estimated polygon count you recommend
10. Your experience integrating avatars with Unity, Unreal, WebGL, or AI systems

title: Amazon OA Product Sourcing — Ongoing Hourly Researcher — $5/hr + Bonuses (20 leads/week quota)
description:
Buy Criteria (every lead must meet ALL of these)

	•	Minimum 40% ROI (net, after Amazon fees, inbound shipping, and prep)
	•	Minimum $3.50 net profit per unit
	•	30+ sales per month, verified in Keepa (BSR/sales-rank history) — not SellerAmp’s estimate
	•	BSR of 150,000 or lower (current BSR must be ≤ 150k)
	•	Stable Keepa graph (consistent BSR, no single-seller/one-off spikes)
	•	In stock and buyable now at the source, at the price you list
	•	Priced using the lowest FBA offer (not the Buy Box) for the profit math
	•	2+ FBA sellers on the listing (private-label alert acceptable only if 2+ FBA sellers exist)

Exclusions (do not submit)

	•	Meltables
	•	“For [Brand]”–style / compatible-accessory listings (e.g. “for Ryobi”)
	•	IP-risky or frequently-gated brands where ungating is unrealistic
	•	Anything I already have (see “New products only”)

Required Data Per Product (Google Sheet, one row each)

	•	ASIN
	•	Product title
	•	Source retailer/distributor + direct product URL
	•	Source/buy cost per unit (landed — include shipping)
	•	Amazon sell price used (lowest FBA)
	•	Net profit per unit
	•	ROI %
	•	Monthly sales (Keepa-verified) + current BSR
	•	Number of FBA sellers
	•	Gating/ungating status — note whether the ASIN is open, or a 10-unit ungate, 100-unit ungate, etc., and any invoice requirement
	•	Notes (variation, pack size, any risk flags)

Blank or “N/A” cells in required columns = incomplete lead, not counted toward the weekly quota.

Requirements to Apply

	•	Proven OA sourcing experience — this is for a professional product researcher, not a beginner. Share past results or a redacted sample sheet.
	•	You own or subscribe to the tools you’ll use — e.g. Keepa, SellerAmp, RevSeller (or equivalent). I do not provide logins.
	•	Strong Google Sheets skills (clean, formula-driven, well-organized).
	•	Access to Google Chrome browsing from within the United States (US retailer/distributor pricing, availability, and shipping must reflect a US buyer). A reliable US connection required.
	•	Fluent English — able to read the criteria precisely and communicate clearly in writing.
	•	Responsive communication — checks messages regularly and replies promptly.
	•	Reliable high-speed internet — stable connection for continuous browsing, research, and file sharing.

Every lead must be one I haven’t already sourced. Before we start I’ll share an exclusion list / master ASIN list; any duplicate against it doesn’t count toward the quota. Padding the sheet with duplicates or leads that fail the criteria on spot-check is grounds for not continuing the role.

Payment & Bonuses

	•	$5.00/hour, paid hourly, ongoing.
	•	Weekly quota: 20 compliant leads.
	•	Bonus for 70%+ ROI products: $3 extra per qualifying 70%+ ROI lead, $5 extra per qualifying 100%+ ROI lead, and/or a $20 bonus at 15+ such 70/100% leads.
	•	I’ll spot-check a random sample (~10–15 leads) against Keepa and live source pricing. Leads that don’t verify are replaced or deducted.

Ongoing role: This is a long-term hourly position, not a one-off. Consistent, clean, verifying leads that hit the weekly quota mean steady ongoing work.

To Apply, Include

	•	Your OA sourcing experience + a short sample (5–10 example leads or a redacted sheet).
	•	Which tools you own/subscribe to.
	•	Your sourcing method(s).
	•	Confirmation of US-based Chrome browsing access.
	•	Roughly how many compliant leads you can produce per hour (so we can gauge the weekly quota against your hours).

title: Reverse Recruiter / Job Search Assistant – Electrical Engineer Government & Utility Jobs
description:
Reverse Recruiter / Job Search Assistant – Government & Utility Jobs
About the Role
I’m looking for a detail-oriented Reverse Recruiter / Job Search Assistant to help manage and organize a personalized job search, with a particular focus on California government, public-sector, utility, and related positions.

This is not a generic “apply to jobs” role. I will provide guidance on the specific job sites, career portals, types of positions, and resume versions to use. Your responsibility will be to help execute the search carefully, consistently, and in an organized manner.

What You’ll Do
Search for relevant job openings based on my specific criteria and instructions.
Navigate government, utility, and other employer career portals.
Review job descriptions and identify positions that match my background and requirements.
Help tailor and prepare different versions of my CV/resume for specific job categories.
Complete online job applications using information and materials I provide.
Track applications, deadlines, job status, links, requirements, and follow-ups.
Maintain an organized Excel/Google Sheets job-search tracker.

Record important details such as:
Employer/agency
Position title
Job ID
Application deadline
Salary range, when available
Location
Application URL
Resume version used
Application date
Current status
Follow-up date
Notes
Flag positions that require additional information, questionnaires, assessments, or documents.
Help identify recurring job categories and opportunities that fit my target profile.
Follow my instructions carefully regarding which positions to prioritize and which resume to use.

Personalized Job Search
I will guide you on:

Which job websites and portals to use
Which government agencies, utilities, and employers to prioritize
Which types of positions to search for
Different resume/CV versions for different positions
Application strategies and preferences
What information should or should not be included in applications
You should be comfortable following detailed instructions and adapting the search as my priorities change.

Expected Workload & Duration
This is intended to be a longer-term but relatively low-hours engagement.

The initial setup may require more time to understand my background, target positions, resumes, job portals, and tracking system. Once the workflow is established, the ongoing work should generally require only a limited number of hours, depending on the availability of relevant positions and application deadlines.

The engagement may continue for approximately 3–6 months, and potentially longer if the process works well.

This is therefore a good opportunity for someone who is looking for a flexible, ongoing part-time project rather than a high-hours weekly commitment. I value consistency and attention to detail more than the number of hours worked.

Ideal Candidate
You should have:

Experience with job searching, recruiting, recruiting coordination, or administrative support
Strong internet research skills
Excellent attention to detail
Experience using Excel or Google Sheets
Strong written English
Ability to navigate unfamiliar government and corporate career portals
Ability to follow instructions precisely
Good organizational and time-management skills
Familiarity with U.S. and preferably California government/public-sector hiring is a strong plus
Experience with resume/CV tailoring is a plus
Work Style

I’m looking for someone who is:
Reliable and consistent
Detail-oriented
Proactive but willing to follow my specific instructions
Comfortable doing repetitive application and tracking work
Good at spotting relevant opportunities without applying blindly
Careful with confidential personal and employment information
Quality is more important than the number of applications submitted. I want relevant, well-organized applications rather than mass applications.

Initial Work
The first stage will be to understand my job-search goals, resume versions, target positions, and preferred websites/portals. From there, we can establish a repeatable workflow for finding, evaluating, preparing, and tracking applications.

To Apply
Please briefly describe:

Your experience with job searching or recruiting support.
Your experience with Excel/Google Sheets.
Whether you have worked with government or public-sector job portals.
Whether you have experience tailoring resumes to different job descriptions.
Your availability and preferred hourly rate.
Whether you are comfortable with a low-hours but potentially 3–6 month engagement.
Please also provide one example of a job-search or research task you have completed that demonstrates your attention to detail.

I’m looking for someone who can become a reliable partner in managing this process over several months.

Main entry door

Bathrooms

Living Room
TV mounted on wall per notated location on 2D plan
General furnishing appropriate to an upscale student housing common area (sofa, coffee table, etc. — use good design judgment to match the overall finish level)
Balcony

Railing: black metal railing with black metal spindles
Door to balcony: single-swing inward glass panel door (not sliding, not French double doors)

Job Description:
Job description:

Location: Remote
Job Type: Commission-Based / Independent Consultant
Compensation: Commission Only – Up to 3% per Successful Investment

About The Club Lagos LA

The Club Lagos LA is developing a premium hospitality, nightlife, entertainment, and lifestyle brand that celebrates African culture while connecting it with global experiences. We are looking for driven professionals who can help us build meaningful relationships with qualified investors and support the company's expansion.

Position Overview

The Club Lagos LA is seeking ambitious, well-connected, and results-driven Executive Investment Consultants to help introduce qualified investors to our growing premium hospitality, nightlife, entertainment, and lifestyle brand.

In this commission-based role, you will identify and connect with potential investors, build strong professional relationships, and facilitate introductions between qualified prospects and the company's management team. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals with strong networking, sales, business development, fundraising, or investor relations experience who are motivated by uncapped earning potential.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and source qualified potential investors through professional networks, referrals, and business development activities.
* Build and maintain relationships with entrepreneurs, business leaders, executives, and high-net-worth individuals.
* Network within relevant professional and business communities to generate investment opportunities.
* Introduce qualified prospects to the company's management team.
* Present and communicate investment opportunities professionally and accurately.
* Coordinate investor meetings and facilitate communication between prospects and management.
* Follow up with prospective investors throughout the engagement process.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, prospects, and activities within the CRM.
* Handle all investor and business information with professionalism and strict confidentiality.
* Represent The Club Lagos LA professionally when engaging with potential investors and business partners.

Requirements

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.
* Professional appearance and executive presence.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented.
* Comfortable communicating with senior executives, entrepreneurs, and business leaders.
* Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* An existing professional or business network is an advantage.
* Previous experience in sales, business development, fundraising, investment consulting, or investor relations is preferred.

High-performing consultants may be considered for future leadership opportunities within the team.

If you are confident, well-connected, commercially driven, and motivated by high earning potential, we would love to hear from you.

title: NJ surplus funds county land records scraper
description:
i am trying to build is essentially a New Jersey sheriff-sale surplus funds  lead qualification and discovery system that works county by county and relies on the actual recorded deed images as the source of truth. ( note for image scraping i do not want to pay  anything using a  third party source ) 

There are two separate workflows you want the system to handle.

1. Qualify your existing ATTOM leads in a csv file

i already have CSV file containing potential leads, generally with the former owner's name and other property information. with i think around 70,000 names and a lot being duplicates

For each person/property on that list, the system should:

Determine the appropriate New Jersey county.
Open that county's land-records website.
Search the former owner's name.
Find the corresponding Sheriff Deed / SHER DEED.
Open the actual scanned deed.
Read the deed and extract:
Previous owner / defendant
Property address
Sheriff sale date
Final sale/purchase price
Foreclosure debt/judgment amount
Purchaser/new owner
Instrument/document number where useful
Calculate:

Estimated surplus = Final sale price − debt

Determine whether the purchaser is an acceptable third-party bidder.
Mark the ATTOM record as either Qualified or Not Qualified.

A record qualifies only when both of these are true:

Sale price − debt ≥ $35,000
The purchaser is a third party, meaning it is not the foreclosing bank, mortgage lender, mortgage servicer, or creditor.

Individuals, investors, and ordinary/non-lender LLCs can qualify.

Importantly, the qualification information needs to come from the actual recorded deed/document images, rather than relying on ATTOM, an index search result, or the land-record metadata.



part 2 of this system is different 
. Generate completely new/raw leads from county records

This is separate from my ATTOM list.

Instead of searching an owner's name, the system searches the county database itself for Sheriff Deeds, starting from approximately 2019 through the present.

For Camden County ( https://camden.newvisionsystems.com/SearchAnywhere) , for example, searching the deed type can produce tens of thousands of records. The system would need to process those records in batches, open the underlying documents, and apply the exact same qualification rules.

So the pipeline would essentially be:

County records → Sheriff deeds → Open document → Extract values → Calculate surplus → Check purchaser → Export qualifying lead

Because Camden showed 95,744 results and only the first 1,000 are displayed, the automation cannot simply run one unrestricted search. It would need to divide the search into smaller ranges, most logically by recording/sale date, and process the results batch by batch so that no records are lost because of the site's 1,000-result display limit.

Exact qualification rule

A lead is:

QUALIFIED

Final sale price − stated foreclosure debt ≥ $35,000

AND

Purchaser is a third party

real Example camden county land records 

name, ( finley, richard ) 
Sale price: $194,000
Debt: $117,923.14
Difference: $76,076.86
Buyer: DJM Properties
Buyer is not shown as the foreclosing lender
QUALIFIED

That is exactly what your Richard Finley / Camden County example demonstrates.

The recorded sheriff deed identifies the purchaser as DJM Properties, and the deed gives a true consideration of $194,000. The writ/deed materials state approximately $117,923.14 as the amount to be satisfied.

Therefore:

$194,000 − $117,923.14 = $76,076.86

That exceeds your $35,000 threshold by a substantial amount.

NOT QUALIFIED

For example:

Sale: $180,000
Debt: $160,000
Difference: $20,000
Not qualified, even if an investor purchased it.

Or:

Sale: $250,000
Debt: $150,000
Difference: $100,000
Buyer: Bank of America
Not qualified, because the creditor/lender acquired the property.

What should be exported

For every qualified record, I would make the final dataset contain at least:

Field	Purpose
County	Camden, Essex, etc.
Previous Owner	Person potentially entitled to surplus
Property Address	Foreclosed property
Sale Date	Actual sheriff sale date
Recording Date	Useful separately from sale date
Final Sale Price	Amount property sold for
Debt Amount	Amount stated in recorded foreclosure documents
Calculated Difference	Sale − debt
Purchaser	Winning bidder/new owner
Purchaser Type	Individual / LLC / lender / etc.
Third-Party Buyer?	Yes/No
Qualified?	Yes/No
Instrument Number	Allows deed to be found again
Book/Page	If available
Document Link/ID	Allows manual verification
Source County	County record system
Review Status	Automated / manually reviewed

One thing I would specifically keep separate is sale date versus recording date. For example, Camden's index may show when the sheriff deed was recorded, but you want the actual sheriff-sale date contained in the document whenever it is available.

What the automation actually needs to do

Conceptually, the system has five components:

County website automation → document retrieval → document reading/OCR → qualification logic → CSV/database export

The difficult part isn't the $35,000 calculation. That is straightforward. The more complicated part is reliably navigating the different county websites and correctly interpreting the scanned deeds.

For each county, the automation will need its own configuration because New Jersey counties don't necessarily use identical land-record systems. Some will be public without authentication, while others may require credentials that you provide.

It should also recognize that wording varies. For example, the sale amount might appear as:

"true consideration for this conveyance ... is $194,000.00"

while the debt might appear as:

"the sum of $117,923.14 being the principal, interest and advances..."

The scraper therefore shouldn't depend on one exact phrase.

title: B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – Automotive & Diesel Repair Industry
description:
We are seeking an experienced, articulate B2B Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to contact independent automotive, diesel, and commercial repair businesses from an existing lead list.

Leads will be provided. You will not be responsible for researching or generating leads.

Responsibilities
Make outbound calls to businesses from a provided lead list
Speak with owners, managers, or other decision-makers
Briefly explain our service in a natural, conversational way
Ask a few qualifying questions to determine whether the shop has abandoned, unclaimed, or long-term customer vehicles/equipment on the property
Identify interested prospects
Schedule follow-up calls or appointments when appropriate
Record accurate call notes and outcomes
Follow up with leads when instructed
Who I’m Looking For

I need someone who:

Has previous B2B cold-calling experience
Sounds professional, calm, and confident on the phone
Can have a conversation instead of sounding like they are reading a script
Is persistent without being aggressive or pushy
Is comfortable speaking with automotive, diesel, trucking, or other blue-collar business owners
Can handle objections professionally
Is dependable and organized
Communicates clearly in English

Experience calling automotive shops, diesel repair facilities, trucking companies, fleet businesses, or similar industries is a strong plus.

Schedule

Approximately 5–10 hours per week to start, with the possibility of additional hours based on performance.

This may become an ongoing position for the right person.

When Applying

Please include:

Your B2B cold-calling experience
Industries you have called previously
Your typical number of calls per hour
Your availability
Your hourly rate
A short voice sample or introduction, if available

I am looking for someone who can start quickly. The goal is not high-pressure selling. I need someone who can open the conversation, identify potential need, and get qualified prospects interested in speaking with me.

title: Lead Blockchain Full-Stack Engineer – High-Frequency Crypto Betting Infrastructure
description:
Engagement Type: Full-time (40 hrs/week) / Long-term Retainer
Budget: $80 – $150 / hr (commensurate with proven track record)

The Context
We are engineering a high-performance, non-custodial crypto-betting protocol that operates at the intersection of traditional sportsbook mechanics and DeFi primitives. The platform handles real-time odds streaming, automated market-making for liquidity pools, and on-chain settlement of multi-million dollar wagering volumes.
We are not building a "casino dApp." We are building a low-latency financial trading engine where the asset class is sporting events. title: Kajabi Funnel & Marketing Specialist for Mental Health Expert/Consultant
description:
Kajabi Funnel & Marketing Specialist for Mental Health Education & Consulting

Rate: Up to $15/hour
Hours: Up to 10 hours/week
Position Type: Part-Time Freelance / Ongoing
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Kajabi Funnel & Marketing Specialist to help build, organize, and optimize the online education side of a growing mental health consulting and training business.

You will work directly with a mental health expert, educator, and consultant who creates professional educational content, trainings, consultation programs, digital resources, and continuing education opportunities for mental health professionals.

We already have expertise, intellectual property, and content. We need someone who can help us turn that content into well-organized Kajabi products and effective marketing funnels that generate leads and sales.

This is not primarily a content-writing position. We are looking for someone who understands the technical and strategic side of Kajabi, funnels, email automation, landing pages, and digital-product marketing.

Responsibilities

You may assist with:

- Building and optimizing Kajabi landing pages and sales pages
- Creating funnels for courses, trainings, consultation programs, webinars, and digital products
- Setting up lead magnets and opt-in funnels
- Building Kajabi email sequences and automations
- Creating nurture sequences that move subscribers toward paid offerings
- Setting up offers, checkout pages, coupons, bundles, and upsells
- Organizing Kajabi products and course content
- Uploading and formatting educational materials
- Creating webinar or training registration funnels
- Connecting forms, tags, pipelines, and automations
- Testing funnels to make sure the customer experience works correctly
- Reviewing existing Kajabi systems and recommending improvements
- Helping repurpose existing educational content into lead-generation opportunities
- Tracking basic funnel performance and identifying areas for improvement
- Documenting systems so they can be easily maintained as the business grows

What We're Looking For

Required:

- Demonstrated experience working in Kajabi
- Experience building sales and lead-generation funnels
- Experience with email marketing and automated nurture sequences
- Understanding of customer journeys from lead → nurture → offer → purchase
- Ability to independently build from an outline or direction rather than requiring detailed step-by-step instructions
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
- Ability to communicate clearly and provide regular progress updates
- Comfortable working with educational and professional-service content

Strongly Preferred:

- Experience working with coaches, consultants, educators, therapists, or other subject-matter experts
- Experience marketing online courses, professional trainings, webinars, memberships, or digital products
- Understanding of ethical marketing for mental health or healthcare-related businesses
- Canva experience
- Basic copywriting or sales-page experience
- Experience integrating Kajabi with other platforms or automation tools

Important

Although this business operates within the mental health education and consulting space, you will not be working with client or patient information. Confidentiality and professionalism are extremely important.

We are looking for someone interested in developing an ongoing working relationship, not simply completing one funnel and leaving.

Initially, projects will be assigned in smaller pieces so we can establish a workflow together. As trust and familiarity with the business grow, there may be opportunities to take greater ownership of our Kajabi systems and digital marketing funnels.

Hours & Compensation

- Up to 10 hours per week
- Maximum budget: $15/hour
- Remote
- Flexible schedule, with agreed-upon deadlines and regular communication

To Apply

Please include:

1. A brief description of your experience with Kajabi.
2. Examples of Kajabi funnels, landing pages, courses, or email sequences you have built.
3. Your experience working with consultants, educators, coaches, or professional-service businesses.
4. A short explanation of how you would approach this example:

We have a free educational resource for mental health professionals and ultimately want to convert some of those subscribers into purchasers of a paid professional training. What would you build in Kajabi to accomplish this?

5. Please begin your proposal with the words “KAJABI FUNNEL” so we know you read the full posting.

We are particularly interested in finding someone who can combine Kajabi technical skills with an understanding of marketing strategy and help us build systems that can grow with the business.

title: QuickBooks Online Plus Setup & Optimization
description:
I’m looking for an experienced QuickBooks Online Plus specialist to help me properly set up, clean up, and optimize my QuickBooks account so I can use the platform as effectively as possible.

I already have QuickBooks connected to my business bank account, and some transactions are syncing, but I need someone to make sure everything is structured correctly from the beginning.

What I need

* Review and clean up my current Chart of Accounts
* Make sure my business bank account is fully and correctly synced
* Review existing imported transactions and fix any incorrect categorizations
* Set up the correct accounts for income, expenses, inventory, liabilities, equity, and owner/shareholder activity
* Set up and properly track Cost of Goods Sold
* Set up and properly track inventory
* Set up business loans and repayment tracking
* Set up shareholder/owner loans correctly
* Make sure transfers are not being incorrectly recorded as income or expenses
* Help structure budgeting/cash-allocation categories correctly without confusing them with accounting categories
* Set up bank rules and automations where useful
* Make sure duplicate transactions are avoided
* Reconcile the books to the actual bank account
* Review QuickBooks reporting and make sure the reports are useful and accurate
* Set up the account so I can clearly understand:
    * how much money the business is making
    * where money is being spent
    * outstanding liabilities
    * inventory value/cost
    * profitability
    * cash flow
* Show me how to maintain the system myself after setup

I want someone who can look at my entire QuickBooks setup and identify anything I am not currently using that would make the system more useful or efficient.

The goal is not just basic bookkeeping. I want QuickBooks Online Plus set up in a way that takes advantage of its features and gives me a clear, accurate picture of the business.

Ideal experience

* Strong experience with QuickBooks Online Plus
* Small-business bookkeeping
* Bank feeds and reconciliation
* Inventory and Cost of Goods Sold
* Business loans/liabilities
* Owner/shareholder transactions
* Chart of Accounts setup and cleanup
* QuickBooks reporting
* Bank rules and transaction automation
* Ability to explain the system clearly to someone who is not an accountant

This will initially be a setup, cleanup, and optimization project, with the possibility of ongoing bookkeeping work afterward.

title: Psychology Ghostwriter Needed for Research-Based Parent Resources
description:
# Psychology Ghostwriter Needed for Research-Based Parent Resources

I’m looking for an experienced psychology ghostwriter to translate my academic research publications into clear, practical, accessible resources.

This is a paid, milestone-based project involving 14 resource packs in total. Each resource pack will include:

* A practical resource for parents or professionals
* Final written copy for the resource
* A short website blog post of approximately 300 words
* A LinkedIn carousel promoting the resource

The primary audience is parents, although some resources will be aimed at teachers, psychologists, and neurodivergent practitioners.

I will provide the academic papers, brand guidance, existing templates, and a clear brief for each resource.

## Essential experience

You must have experience ghostwriting in psychology, mental health, child development, parenting, education, neurodiversity, or a closely related field.

You should be able to:

* Translate academic psychology research into useful public-facing content
* Write in a warm, credible, and informed voice on behalf of another person or brand
* Maintain the accuracy, nuance, and limitations of research findings
* Make complex ideas easy for a broad audience to understand without oversimplifying them
* Write practical resources, concise blog posts, and engaging LinkedIn carousel copy
* Write sensitively for parents, teachers, psychologists, and neurodivergent audiences

The content should be clear, practical, inclusive, and neurodiversity-affirming where relevant. It should avoid unnecessary jargon while remaining faithful to the supplied research. Please do not make claims that go beyond the evidence in the academic papers.

## Canva requirements

Canva is a secondary skill for this role. You do not need advanced graphic-design experience, but you should have basic-to-intermediate confidence using Canva.

You will need to be able to:

* Adapt and populate pre-existing Canva templates
* Present written information in a clean, readable, engaging format
* Create LinkedIn carousels using supplied templates
* Maintain consistency with existing brand colours, fonts, and style guidance

## How the project will work

The work will be completed one milestone at a time, allowing me to review each stage and provide feedback before the next resource is started.

The first milestone involves reviewing the supplied research papers and adding proposals for each resource into a spreadsheet I provide. This will include suggested resource titles, intended audiences, formats, outlines, blog-post angles, and LinkedIn carousel structures.

The following milestones will each cover one completed resource pack. You will be asked to write the content, add it to the supplied Canva templates, write the approximately 300-word blog post, and create the accompanying LinkedIn carousel.

## Please include in your application

* Examples of psychology, parenting, neurodiversity, mental-health, or education ghostwriting
* Examples of research translation or evidence-based public-facing writing
* A brief explanation of how you ensure content is both accurate and accessible
* Examples of practical resources, blog posts, or LinkedIn carousels, if available
* Your level of Canva experience and examples of relevant Canva work, if available
* Your fixed-price quote for the planning milestone and price per completed resource pack
* Your typical turnaround time for one resource pack

I’m looking for someone thoughtful, reliable, detail-oriented, and confident working collaboratively through feedback.

title: AI/LLM Engineer for RAG-Based SaaS Platform with React, Python & AWS
description:
We have an existing React-based SaaS platform where users upload internal documents and need to ask questions against that content. Our current OpenAI integration works for basic prompts, but retrieval becomes unreliable as the document set grows—responses occasionally miss relevant context, pull from the wrong documents, and take too long to return.

We need an AI/LLM engineer to fix this by building a proper Python/FastAPI RAG pipeline. The immediate work is to handle document parsing/chunking, embeddings, vector retrieval with tenant/document-level filtering, and grounded OpenAI responses with source references. The RAG service then needs to be connected cleanly to our existing React application.

The final piece is production deployment on AWS using Docker, including secure API access, error handling, logging, and retrieval/latency optimization. The goal is specific: users should be able to upload their company knowledge and receive fast, accurate answers based only on the content they are authorized to access.

title: Head of Customer Support — DTC Brand Doing $3-5M/Month | Zendesk Build-Out + Team of 4
description:
About us

We're a US-focused DTC ecommerce brand doing $3M–$5M per month. We ship thousands of orders a day, and our customer support has not kept up with our growth.

Right now there are no real processes, no documented SOPs, no proper helpdesk, and no reporting. Tickets get answered, but nothing is structured. That's the problem we're hiring you to solve.

The role

You are taking over customer support completely, and rebuilding it from zero.

You'll have 4 people working under you from day one. Your job is not to do everything yourself it's to build the system, run the team, and make sure the numbers hit.

What you'll own

Rebuild the entire CS operation from scratch processes, workflows, escalation paths
Write all SOPs and documentation from the ground up: macros, response templates, refund and return policies, escalation rules
Set up and configure Zendesk or other platform end to end views, triggers, automations, macros, tags, reporting
Manage a team of 4: schedules, coverage, workload distribution, onboarding, training
Own the KPIs and report on them: first response time, resolution time, CSAT, tickets per agent per day, backlog
Handle tickets yourself as well — this is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one. You should be comfortable being in the queue when volume spikes
Identify recurring issues and feed them back to the product, fulfillment and marketing teams

Requirements — please read carefully

Impeccable written and spoken English. This is non-negotiable. You'll be writing customer-facing copy and all internal documentation
Proven experience with US ecommerce brands doing at least $1M–$2M per month. Please name them in your application
You have managed people before — real direct reports, not just "coordinated with a team"
Hands-on Zendesk experience, ideally having set it up or restructured it yourself
Available 6 days a week, full-time, and able to work US business hours
Extremely organized. You build systems and documentation without being asked twice
Please start your application with the word banana so we know you read the full posting
Comfortable owning numbers and being held to them

Nice to have

Experience with Shopify, Gorgias, Teams, Whatsapp, Slack, Google Sheet or similar DTC tooling
Experience managing chargebacks and payment disputes
Experience hiring and training support agents

Details

Full-time, long-term. This is not a short project
US timezone coverage required
6 days per week
You'll report directly to the founder

How to apply

Send us a proposal that answers these four questions directly. Generic applications will be ignored.

Which brands have you worked with, and what was their monthly revenue at the time?
How many people have you directly managed, and for how long?
Have you built or rebuilt a Zendesk instance from scratch? Describe what you did.

We're looking for someone serious who wants to own this long term. If that's you, tell us why.

title: Python geospatial engineer: roof DSM to CAD line work (Google Solar → DXF)
description:
1)  The Problem:

We have a working Python pipeline that turns a US street address into roof measurements, a map overlay, and an AutoCAD-ready DXF. The pipeline runs. The line work is not good enough: facets are over-segmented or merged wrong, and ridge / hip / valley / eave / rake lines do not look like a real roof takeoff.

This is a geometry quality job, not a UI job. We are not looking for Flutter, React, or generic full-stack.

2) What already exists (you will extend this, not rewrite from scratch)

Python FastAPI service
Google Solar only for this pilot: buildingInsights + DSM / RGB / mask GeoTIFFs (no Nearmap or EagleView APIs)
DSM plane segmentation seeded by Solar roof segments, then merge (~8°)
Line classification: outline, ridge, hip, valley, eave, rake
Obstruction blobs from DSM residual; optional Claude labels
DXF via ezdxf, local feet, layers ROOF-OUTLINE, ROOF-FACET, ROOF-RIDGE, ROOF-HIP, ROOF-VALLEY, ROOF-EAVE, ROOF-RAKE, plus obstructions / setbacks / panels
Sanitized title block (lot token, no street address)
Unit tests on a synthetic gable (no Google / GDAL required)
Flutter overlay only consumes the JSON you produce — treat UI as out of scope unless you need it to verify

3) Your job (2-week)

Improve vectorization so a CAD user can open the DXF and recognize the roof without redrawing it.
Diagnose why current planes and classified lines are wrong (over-segmentation, bad merge, shared-edge topology, CRS / origin, contour artifacts).
Fix segment_planes / classify_lines (and only neighboring code if required). Keep the existing JSON + DXF contract.
Run two residential addresses with HIGH Google Solar imagery:
Address A: simple gable
Address B: hip / complex
Compare against a Nearmap screenshot and/or an existing EagleView PDF we provide. Do not call Nearmap or EagleView APIs.
Fill in our scorecard (facet count, area ±5–10%, linear ft by type, obstructions, “usable in AutoCAD without redraw”).
Leave tests green and add coverage for the failure modes you fix. This is a first-pass overlay and CAD draft.

4) Must-have skills

Python
GDAL / rasterio, GeoTIFF, CRS, GSD, pixel ↔ lat/lng
NumPy, SciPy, Shapely (scikit-image or OpenCV fine)
DSM / DEM plane fitting (normals, region growing, RANSAC or equivalent)
DXF / CAD hygiene (layers, local coordinates in feet, AutoCAD-openable files)
Google Solar or similar building/roof APIs

5) Nice to have

Roofing or solar takeoff experience
ezdxf
FastAPI
Prior work vs EagleView / Hover / Nearmap-style reports

6)Do not apply if

Your plan is to restyle the Flutter overlay
Your CV work is only photo classifiers / YOLO
You are an AutoCAD drafter who does not write Python
Your approach is “prompt an LLM to generate the DXF”

7) Expectations:
We will work together on verifying the outputs for 5 addresses before we pass the code

title: Beginner Pottery Course Creation
description:
**Beginner Pottery Course – 30 Minutes**

I’m looking for a pottery instructor to create an original, beginner-friendly pottery course for me.

The course should be around **30 minutes** and focus on the basic foundations of pottery for complete beginners, including:

* Basic pottery tools and materials
* Choosing and preparing clay
* Basic hand-building techniques
* Creating simple functional pottery pieces step by step
* Drying, firing and finishing
* Common beginner mistakes and useful tips

The course should focus on simple beginner pottery, such as cups, bowls, plates, or similar basic pieces.

**Please do NOT include animal sculptures, figurines, characters, statues, or complex decorative sculptures.**

### Filming Requirements

**The instructor must NOT appear on camera.** No face or full body should be shown. The videos should focus on the hands, clay, tools, and pottery-making process.

If any part of the instructor’s clothing or body is visible, **modest clothing is required**. No revealing clothing.

### Rights

The content must be **original and created specifically for this project** and must not be copied from an existing course.

I need **full commercial rights** to use, edit, reproduce, translate, and resell the videos as a digital course.

### Budget

**$16 total.**

**Please only submit an offer if you are willing to complete the entire project within this $16 budget. If your rate is higher than $16, please do not submit an offer.**

Please send examples of your previous pottery teaching videos and confirm that you can provide the required **commercial and resale rights**.

description:
Senior QA Engineer / QA Automation Engineer

We are currently building the platform and are looking for an experienced **Senior QA Engineer / QA Automation Engineer** to take ownership of quality assurance across the product as it develops towards launch.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on QA Engineer with strong experience in both automated and manual testing.

The successful candidate will establish and maintain the Platform's QA framework, build automated test coverage, manage regression testing and work closely with developers to ensure new functionality is tested thoroughly before release.

This is not a purely manual testing role. Strong experience creating and maintaining automated end-to-end tests is essential.

Key Responsibilities

QA Strategy & Test Management

* Develop and maintain the overall QA strategy for Mellowly.
* Create and maintain a master test-case library.
* Map test cases against the platform's screens, routes and user journeys.
* Establish appropriate smoke, regression, integration and end-to-end testing processes.
* Maintain pre-release and production release checklists.
* Identify gaps in test coverage as the platform develops.
* Prioritise testing based on business, technical, privacy and user risk.

Automated Testing

* Build and maintain automated end-to-end tests using Playwright
* Expand the existing Playwright test framework.
* Create reusable testing utilities and fixtures.
* Implement automated regression tests for critical user journeys.
* Maintain visual regression testing.
* Ensure automated tests can run reliably within GitHub Actions / CI pipelines.
* Investigate failed CI tests and distinguish genuine defects from unstable tests.
* Reduce flaky automated tests and improve test reliability over time.

Functional Testing

Test functionality across areas including:

* Public website
* Account creation
* Login and authentication
* Password reset
* Session management
* Member Dashboard
* Clinician portal
* Creator portal
* Admin portal
* Therapy journeys
* ADHD and autism assessment journeys
* Wellbeing content
* Booking workflows
* Payments and subscriptions when implemented
* Notifications
* Profile management
* Forms and questionnaires
* Search and filtering
* Document/report workflows when introduced

Form & Validation Testing

* Test required fields.
* Test validation rules.
* Test incorrect and unexpected inputs.
* Test error messages.
* Test loading, empty, success and failure states.
* Test interrupted and incomplete user journeys.
* Test save-and-resume functionality where applicable.

Authentication & Permission Testing

Work closely with developers to test:

* Supabase authentication.
* User registration and login.
* Logout.
* Password reset.
* Session expiry.
* Role-based access control.
* Member permissions.
* Clinician permissions.
* Creator permissions.
* Administrator permissions.
* Unauthorised access attempts.

The QA Engineer should verify that users cannot access records, screens or functionality belonging to another user or role.

For example:

* Member A must not be able to access Member B's information.
* Clinicians must only be able to access information they are authorised to view.
* Creator accounts must not have access to clinical or member administration functions.
* Administrative permissions must operate according to the defined access model.

Database & Backend Integration Testing

As the frontend is progressively connected to Supabase:

* Test frontend-to-database integrations.
* Validate correct data retrieval.
* Validate correct data creation and updates.
* Test failed database requests.
* Test API and server-side error handling.
* Test data consistency across related screens.
* Verify permission behaviour from an end-user testing perspective.
* Support testing of Supabase Row Level Security implementation.

The QA Engineer should actively identify permission and data-access issues during testing.

Responsive & Cross-Browser Testing

Test the platform across:

* Desktop
* Tablet
* Mobile

And across major browsers including:

* Chrome
* Microsoft Edge
* Firefox
* Safari where available

Identify layout, usability and functional differences between devices and browsers.

Accessibility Testing

Accessibility is an important part.

Responsibilities will include:

* Automated accessibility testing using **axe-core**.
* Lighthouse accessibility checks.
* Keyboard-navigation testing.
* Focus-state testing.
* Basic screen-reader testing.
* Text-resizing testing.
* Colour-contrast checks.
* Reduced-motion testing.

Test the Platform's accessibility functionality including:

* Calm Mode
* Reading Mode
* Focus Mode
* Reduce Motion
* Text Size
* Language controls

Accessibility issues should be logged, prioritised and regression-tested after fixes.

Clinical & Safety-Critical Journey Testing

The platform includes mental health and assessment pathways. Approved clinical and safety requirements must therefore be implemented consistently.

The QA Engineer will test that approved workflows operate correctly, including areas such as:

* Assessment questionnaires.
* Consent flows.
* Assessment progression.
* Appropriate clinician routing.
* Urgent-support messaging.
* Crisis-support routes.
* Safeguarding-related functionality.
* Clinical workflow permissions.
* Required notices and disclaimers.

The QA Engineer will not make clinical decisions or determine clinical policy..

Defect Management

For identified defects:

* Clearly document the issue.
* Provide reproduction steps.
* Record expected versus actual behaviour.
* Attach screenshots or recordings where appropriate.
* Assign severity and priority.
* Retest fixes.
* Perform appropriate regression testing.
* Confirm whether defects can be closed.

Critical privacy, security, clinical-safety or data-access issues must be escalated immediately.

Example Critical User Journeys

The QA Engineer will progressively automate important end-to-end journeys such as:

Member Journey

Account creation → login → dashboard → recommendation → wellbeing content → support/appointment → follow-up.

Therapy Journey

Search → therapist profile → selection → booking → payment → appointment → follow-up.

Assessment Journey

Registration → consent → questionnaire → save progress → submission → clinician review → appointment → report/outcome.

Clinician Journey

Login → authorised caseload → member/assessment information → workflow actions → notes/results → logout.

Creator Journey

Login → creator dashboard → content management → analytics → engagement → earnings/payment information.

Permissions Journey

Attempt to access another user's resources or restricted functionality and verify access is correctly denied.

Required Skills & Experience

Candidates should have strong experience with:

* Software QA and testing.
* Automated end-to-end testing.
* Playwright.
* JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
* Web application testing.
* Functional testing.
* Regression testing.
* API/integration testing.
* Responsive testing.
* Cross-browser testing.
* Git.
* GitHub.
* CI/CD testing.
* GitHub Actions or similar CI systems.
* Browser developer tools.
* Defect management and test documentation.

## Desirable Experience

Experience with any of the following would be beneficial:

* Supabase.
* PostgreSQL.
* React.
* Next.js.
* Accessibility testing.
* axe-core.
* Lighthouse.
* Visual regression testing.
* Authentication testing.
* Role-based access control.
* SaaS platforms.
* Healthcare technology.
* Mental health technology.
* HealthTech.
* FinTech or other regulated digital products.
* Mobile application testing.

Personal Qualities

We are looking for someone who:

* Is highly detail-oriented.
* Thinks beyond the obvious "happy path".
* Actively looks for edge cases.
* Can work independently.
* Communicates defects clearly.
* Can challenge implementation constructively.
* Understands that quality includes privacy, accessibility and usability — not simply whether a button works.
* Is comfortable working in a fast-moving product environment.
* Can prioritise critical risks rather than treating every defect equally.
* Takes ownership of the QA function.

Initial Priorities

The successful candidate's initial responsibilities are expected to include:

1. Review the existing application and QA setup.
2. Review the existing Playwright tests.
3. Review GitHub Actions and current CI testing.
4. Establish a master QA test plan.
5. Create a master test-case library.
6. Map tests against the existing screens and routes.
7. Identify critical user journeys requiring immediate automation.
8. Expand Playwright end-to-end coverage.
9. Implement or improve visual regression testing.
10. Expand accessibility testing using axe-core.
11. Test current responsive layouts and browsers.
12. Establish defect-reporting standards.
13. Establish smoke and regression test suites.
14. Progressively add tests as new Supabase-backed functionality is introduced.

Working Arrangement

This is initially expected to be a short term contract position, with hours increasing as Mellowly approaches major testing and release milestones.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate practical examples of Playwright automation frameworks or test suites they have personally built.

Application Requirements

Applicants should provide:

* A short summary of relevant QA experience.
* Years of software testing experience.
* Experience with Playwright.
* Experience with TypeScript/JavaScript.
* Experience with GitHub Actions or CI/CD.
* Experience with accessibility testing.
* Experience testing authentication and role-based permissions.
* Examples of automated testing frameworks or projects they have worked on.
* Current availability.
* Hourly rate.

- Apply through Upwork only. Calls, emails, LinkedIn messages, or contact through any other social media or channel will result in immediate disqualification.

ABOUT THE PROJECT

MDR Strategy Group is a Canadian advisory firm that works primarily with regulators and organizations serving the public interest. As our firm expands into new sectors and markets, we are ready to significantly strengthen the organic visibility of MDRstrategy.ca.

Historically, we made a deliberate decision not to aggressively optimize our website for search, as we were managing growth within a highly specialized market. That is changing.

We are seeking an experienced SEO specialist to develop and help implement a comprehensive SEO framework that positions MDR for sustainable organic growth as we broaden our services, audiences, and geographic reach.

SCOPE OF WORK

The successful freelancer will:

- Conduct a comprehensive SEO audit of MDRstrategy.ca.
- Assess our current search visibility, rankings, site structure, and technical SEO.
- Conduct keyword and search-intent research aligned with our services and target audiences.
- Identify opportunities beyond our traditional regulatory-sector market.
- Develop a clear keyword architecture and mapping strategy for existing and future pages.
- Recommend improvements to page titles, metadata, headings, URLs, internal linking, and on-page content.
- Review site architecture and recommend changes to improve search performance and discoverability.
- Identify technical SEO issues affecting indexing, crawling, site performance, or rankings.
- Develop an approach to local, national, and broader geographic search visibility where appropriate.
- Establish an SEO framework that our communications and web teams can follow when creating new content and service pages.
- Identify priority content gaps and opportunities.
- Recommend meaningful KPIs and a practical approach for monitoring SEO performance.
- Provide a prioritized implementation roadmap separating immediate fixes, short-term opportunities, and longer-term initiatives.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This is not simply a keyword research assignment. We are looking for someone who can think strategically about SEO in the context of a professional services firm entering its next stage of growth.

You should have:

- Demonstrated experience developing SEO strategies and frameworks for established websites.
- Strong technical and on-page SEO expertise.
- Experience with professional services, consulting, B2B, or similarly complex organizations.
- Strong understanding of search intent, content architecture, and competitive positioning.
- Experience working with Google Search Console, GA4, and leading SEO research/audit tools.
- The ability to translate SEO findings into clear, practical recommendations for non-SEO professionals.
- Excellent written English and exceptional attention to detail.

TO APPLY

Please include:

- A brief explanation of how you would approach this project.
- Examples of websites for which you personally developed or implemented an SEO strategy.
- Evidence of measurable results from comparable work.
- The SEO tools you typically use.
- Your proposed fee or hourly rate and estimated timeframe.

Generic or AI-generated proposals that do not demonstrate an understanding of the assignment will not be considered.

- We are looking for a strategic SEO professional who can build the foundation correctly now, allowing MDR Strategy Group to increase its visibility thoughtfully and sustainably as the firm expands.

title: 3D Product Designer Needed to Redesign Modular Rotating Sticker Display
description:
I’m looking for someone with experience in **product design, 3D modeling, and display/fixture design** to improve my current sticker display that I use at vendor events and conventions.

Current Display

My current setup consists of:

• A wooden circular base with a Lazy Susan underneath so the display can rotate on a table
• 3D printed shelving/display sections attached above the base
• The shelving can be disassembled for transportation to events
• Individual dividers are manually inserted between each sticker design

The display works well, but I would like to redesign it so it is **lighter, faster to assemble, easier to transport, and more efficient to use at events.**

What I’m Looking For

I would like a redesigned system that:

• Can be **quickly disassembled and reassembled** without having to deal with too many individual pieces
• Uses a simple connection system such as snap together, slide in, locking tabs, magnets, or another reliable modular solution
• Has a **lighter rotating base** than my current wooden Lazy Susan setup
• Can smoothly rotate while sitting on top of a vendor table
• Is structurally sound and stable enough that customers rotating or touching it will not easily knock it over
• Remains reasonably lightweight for transporting to conventions and vendor events
• Can preferably be manufactured using 3D printing or a combination of lightweight materials
• Makes setup and breakdown at events significantly faster

Sticker Size

The stickers displayed are approximately:

**2.5 inches tall**
**Up to 2 inches wide**

There are multiple sticker designs displayed next to each other, so I currently use individual dividers between each design. I would also like to explore a better divider system that is **easy to add, remove, reposition, or integrate into the shelving design.**

 Important Design Considerations

The finished design needs to balance:

**Portability**
**Fast assembly**
**Low weight**
**Stability**
**Durability**
**Smooth rotation**
**Easy manufacturing or 3D printing**

Ideally, I would like the designer to look at my existing display and improve the overall engineering rather than simply recreate it.

Deliverables

I would like:

• A redesigned concept for the complete display
• 3D models/CAD files suitable for manufacturing or 3D printing
• A solution for the rotating base
• A modular connection system for quick assembly and breakdown
• An improved adjustable divider system
• Recommendations for materials and hardware, if needed
• Dimensions and assembly instructions for the final design

title: LinkedIn Marketing & Technical Posts
description:
We are looking for a long term Marketing and LinkedIn Growth Partner to work closely with the Founder of The Data Guyz, a Sydney based Data and AI consulting company.

We are not looking for someone who simply schedules generic social media posts.

We want someone who can help us build a strong presence in the Data, AI and Technology space and grow meaningful relationships with the right people.

 About The Data Guyz

The Data Guyz is a Sydney based Data and AI consultancy and a Google Cloud Partner and Snowflake Registered Partner.

We work across:

Data Engineering
Data Analytics
Data Quality
Data Governance
Data Architecture
Business Intelligence
Cloud Data Platforms
AI Enablement
Data Strategy

We work with organisations that have real data problems to solve.

Our founder has more than 16 years of hands on experience in data and technology.

 What we need help with

We are looking for someone who can become a long term growth partner and help us with:

 1. LinkedIn Content Creation

Create engaging LinkedIn content for our Founder and potentially our company page.

The content should cover topics such as:

 Data Engineering
 Data Quality
 Data Governance
 AI and Data
 Cloud and Modern Data Platforms
 Snowflake
 Google Cloud
 Consulting lessons
 Stakeholder management
 Startup and founder journey
 Hiring and team building
 Mentoring graduates and junior engineers
 Real world lessons from delivering data projects

You do not need to be the world's best Data Engineer.

But you must be comfortable understanding technical concepts and turning them into interesting, simple and engaging content.

Generic AI generated posts will not work for us.

We want posts that sound like they were written by someone who actually works in the industry.

Strong hooks. Stories. Opinions. Lessons. Humour when appropriate.

 2. LinkedIn Network Growth

Help grow the Founder's LinkedIn network with relevant people.

This includes identifying and connecting with people such as:

 CIOs
 CTOs
 Heads of Data
 Data Managers
 Analytics Leaders
 AI Leaders
 Technology Leaders
 Former Big 4 Partners and Directors
 Data and Technology Consultants
 Potential clients
 Potential partners
 Relevant recruiters and industry professionals

This is about quality relationships, not randomly sending hundreds of connection requests.

 3. Outreach and Relationship Building

Help draft personalised outreach messages and follow ups on behalf of the Founder.

Potential activities include:

 Identifying relevant prospects
 Researching companies and people
 Drafting personalised connection messages
 Helping start relevant conversations
 Following up professionally
 Identifying partnership opportunities
 Supporting outreach to potential clients

Absolutely no spammy copy and paste sales messages.

We believe relationships come before sales pitches.

 4. Content Strategy

Help us maintain a consistent content strategy.

We would ideally publish approximately 2 to 3 quality posts per week.

You should also bring ideas based on:

 Trends in Data and AI
 Industry conversations
 Common business problems
 Technical lessons
 Founder experiences
 Consulting stories
 Market opportunities

 The ideal person

You will be a great fit if you have experience in some of the following:

 LinkedIn personal branding
 B2B marketing
 Technical content writing
 Technology marketing
 Data or AI industry knowledge
 Founder branding
 Lead generation
 LinkedIn outreach
 Social selling
 Copywriting
 Content strategy

Experience writing about Data, AI, Cloud, Analytics, Software or Technology will be strongly preferred.

If you have previously worked with a technology consultancy, SaaS company, Data company, AI company or technical founder, please mention this.

 Important: This is not a generic social media role

Please do not apply if your approach is:

"Create 30 AI generated posts and schedule them."

That is exactly what we do not want.

We are looking for someone who can learn our business, understand our voice and work with us over the long term.

We want someone who can eventually understand:

What The Data Guyz does.

Who we want to reach.

What problems our clients face.

What makes us different.

And how to turn our real experiences into content and conversations that attract the right people.

 What to include in your application

Please send us:

1. Examples of LinkedIn posts you have written, preferably in Technology, Data, AI, SaaS or B2B.
2. Examples of founders or businesses you have helped grow on LinkedIn.
3. Your experience with LinkedIn network growth and outreach.
4. How you would approach building a technical founder's LinkedIn presence.
5. Your proposed monthly or hourly pricing.
6. Please write one short LinkedIn post based on this topic:

"Everyone wants AI until they discover their customer data exists in six different systems."

We will be looking closely at the quality and authenticity of your writing.

This is intended to be a long term engagement for the right person.

title: Card Game Illustration + Graphic Design for a Satirical Party Card Game (Animal Cast)
description:
I'm developing a satirical party card game planned for a Kickstarter launch in late 2027, published by my company, CatNap, LLC. I'm gathering rates from illustrators and graphic designers for the full visual production, which needs to be complete by the end of the year. The game is unannounced, so please keep the details confidential.

One thing up front, since "political" can give people pause: the game is APOLITICAL. It's political in setting only. There is no partisanship, no side taken, no real politicians, no live policy debates. The satire targets corruption itself, in a fictional government, and it lands on everyone in power equally. At the table it's a party game about bluffing your friends.

The tone: this is satire in the Animal Farm tradition. The entire cast is animals, and animals are inherently endearing, which is the point. The vibe to nail is ENDEARING YET CORRUPT, and the split matters: the characters themselves stay endearing (endearing, not cute), while the corruption lives in the art around them: small hints in the settings, props, and background details that you only notice when you look twice. Charming at a glance, crooked on the second look. Think of a used car salesman: charismatic, fun, enjoyable company, and absolutely trying to screw you.

This is character work, but not in the roleplaying sense. The cast is animal ARCHETYPES: each species embodies a political disposition and a cultural role in how politics works. One example: the pig is the business class. What needs continuity is the archetype: every pig, on every card a pig appears on, should read as the same kind of creature. Only one character in the game is a named individual with a consistent on-model design; other names appear in card text but are not tied to specific character illustrations.

The scope below is split so you can quote only the parts you do; illustration and graphic design may go to different people.

ILLUSTRATION. The base game is 190 cards, but the work is NOT 190 paintings. It splits into three kinds:

1. Key illustrations (full-card art): 4 standard-suit cards, one per suit; the 64 standard cards in the deck reuse these four with only the number changing. Plus 1 wildcard face and 4 card backs.
2. Spot illustrations: 32 unique small in-card pictures, one on each of the 17 action cards and 15 event cards. Each is unique, and the recurring archetypes appear across them.
3. Template faces with variants: 30 secret-objective cards share one face design with three variants (a small distinguishing detail marks easy/medium/hard; otherwise only text changes). The penalty cards (17) and reward cards (15) work the same way: shared face designs, slight detail differences, mostly text changes.

Expansions:
- Expansion A: 22 cards, ~21 unique faces, plus packaging art (a "classified dossier" envelope exterior).
- Expansion B: 20-25 cards, ~20 unique faces, plus a small tuck box.
- Expansion C: one box of ~32 cards: 17 built on the penalty-card template (text plus a slight design variation; minimal new illustration) and ~15 action-type cards needing ~10 spot illustrations. One tuck box for the whole thing.
- Premium edition: NO new illustration. Same 190 cards with slight production variations (foil accents over existing back art); at most some production-file prep.

GRAPHIC DESIGN:
- Card frame/template system (one per deck type), suit iconography, typography
- Rulebook: a single-sheet fold-out, 16 panels, ~365 x 275 mm open. Note: its cover panel doubles as the premium edition's box art (visible through a window lid), so the cover carries extra weight.
- Rules inserts for the expansions (small booklets)
- Boxes: the base game box (magnetic flip-top, ~141 x 103 x 55 mm) plus the expansion packaging above. The premium edition's box is NOT in scope; it's wooden and handled separately.

On AI, read this before quoting: how you work is your business, and AI is fine in your process. Reference collages, mood boards, ideation, whatever gets you to the drawing. The finished art is a different matter: no generated imagery in the final work, no AI painting, coloring, or cleanup in the final files, and nothing that reads as AI-generated. If I wanted art that looks generated, I could make it myself. The finals must be human-drawn and look it; this will be contractual, and I review layered source files.

Other requirements:
- Process work is part of the deliverable. Keep your sketches, drafts, and iterations (a sketchbook, physical or digital); I want WIP delivered alongside finals, with rights to use it in marketing and campaign updates. Price that in.
- Full rights assignment on finals and process work (work made for hire). Please quote on that basis, not licensing.
- Print-ready finals: 63 x 88 mm plus bleed, CMYK, layered source files included.

In your proposal, please include:
1. Your rate structure: per illustration (with complexity tiers if you use them), day rate, or a project estimate for the phases you'd take
2. Portfolio links: anything related to this kind of project, especially character art; animal characters are a big plus
3. Revision rounds included per piece, and the rate for additional rounds
4. Availability and realistic throughput in pieces per month, given the end-of-year completion target
5. Whether you'd take a small paid test assignment (2-3 cards) first. I expect to start there with anyone.

Happy to share the fuller brief and references under a short mutual NDA if this interests you.

title: Branded 2D Site Map Illustration for Apartment Community (Vector, Over Supplied Linework)
description:
We need our property site map redrawn accurately to scale and illustrated in our brand style. The map is used for wayfinding signage and leasing materials.

THE JOB HAS THREE PARTS:

PART 1 - ACCURATE LINEWORK: Trace our site survey into a clean, to-scale vector linework base: property boundary, building footprints, parking stripes, drives, and walkways. Dimensions must match the survey we supply. We will also supply architectural drawings for tracing the building's unit layouts.

PART 2 - BRANDED ILLUSTRATION: Over your own linework, produce a polished, branded 2D site plan illustration in a clean flat style: landscaping, trees, pool and amenity areas, hardscape, parking, etc. Buildings are illustrated as their own layer group on top, within the building footprints defined in the base.

PART 3 - OVERLAY LAYERS: Two label/icon layer groups on top of the map, each as its own separately named layer group (NOT baked into the base) so we can toggle them per use case:
* Amenity locations (for leasing materials): pool, spa, gym, clubhouse, pickleball, dog parks, etc.
* Resident essentials (for resident materials): mailboxes, package room, dumpsters, guest parking, pet areas, leasing office, etc. We supply the full list and locations for both; you design a clean, brand-matched icon/label set and place them.

TIMELINE (FIRM - please only apply if you can commit):
* To-scale linework base within 5 days
* Full illustrated base map within 7 days of linework approval (a quick style test on one small area is required for sign-off at the start of this milestone)
* Building layers within 3 days of base map approval
* Overlay layers + final files within 18 days of start, total

WE PROVIDE:

* Site survey PDF
* Current site map (.ai) for content and unit-layout reference
* Architectural drawings for all 4 buildings
* Overhead drone photography as ground-truth reference, where available
* Brand kit (palette, fonts, logo)
* Complete list + locations for amenity and resident-essential overlays

YOU DELIVER:
* To-scale vector linework base matched to the survey
* Fully illustrated, branded base map drawn over it
* Building layers illustrated within the defined footprints
* Amenity and resident-essentials overlay layers (icons + labels), each as a separate named layer group
* Layered .ai source with named layers + SVG export
* 100% vector, no embedded raster
* Print-ready and web-ready exports
* Multiple revision rounds, to be discussed

MILESTONES:
* To-scale linework base traced from survey - $150
* Full illustrated base map (grounds: landscaping, hardscape, parking, amenities) - $175
* Building layers added within the base footprints - $100
* Overlay layers (amenities + resident essentials) + revisions + final files (.ai, SVG, exports) - $75
We will fund each milestone as the prior one is approved.

WHEN SUBMITTING PROPOSAL: 
* Please share 1-2 examples of comparable map, campus, resort, or site plan illustration
* Confirm you can deliver a layered .ai source file plus SVG, fully vector.
* Confirm you can meet the 18-day timeline above, and state your actual expected turnaround.

title: Short-Form Content Specialist & Documentary Creator
description:
Short-Form Video Editor for Music Project Focusing on TikTok & Instagram Reels

We are looking for a creative short-form video editor to help turn our existing footage into engaging TikTok and Instagram Reels content.

We are a band called Honess Jones and The Tough Love. We make songs of Life, Loss and Perseverance, exploring themes including depression, grief, perseverance and not giving up on your dreams.

We have a substantial amount of existing footage, including:
 - Live/gig footage, filmed professionally and on VHS
- Documentary/interview footage of our frontman talking about his creative process, influences and the inspirations behind our singles
- Behind-the-scenes footage from studio sessions and shows
- Professional performance footage

We are looking for someone who understands both storytelling and short-form content and can look through our existing footage to identify what makes an interesting and engaging piece of social content.
We don't want someone who simply edits clips we have already selected. We want someone who can look through the footage and develop videos for short-form content.

We have a clear brand identity and want the social content to feel:
Authentic
Cinematic
Documentary-led
Human and emotionally connected

We do not want excessive transitions, flashy effects, memes, emojis, generic TikTok templates or trend-led editing unless there is a genuine creative reason for using them.

At the same time, we want someone who is algorithmically savvy and understands what makes people stop scrolling, continue watching and engage with short-form content,  particularly hooks, retention, pacing, curiosity and payoff.

For the initial project, we would like to commission 3–5 short-form videos around the release of our song Pleasures.

Pleasures is a song about perseverance and not giving up on your dreams. We have a mixture of performance footage, documentary material, behind-the-scenes footage and older material that can be used to tell the story around the song.

We would like you to:
Review the relevant footage
Develop short-form concepts and hooks
Edit the videos for TikTok/Reels
Add captions where needed
Use music and audio effectively
Deliver finished videos ready to upload

If the initial project works well, we would be interested in developing an ongoing relationship and regular batches of content.

Please include:
Examples of your short-form work, particularly TikTok/Reels
Examples of music, documentary, artist or storytelling work if you have them
A brief explanation of how you approach creating a hook and retaining attention in short-form video
Your price/rate for approximately 3–5 videos
Your usual turnaround time
Whether you are comfortable working from a large archive of raw footage and making creative decisions about what to use

Thanks!
