title: Organic Social Media Manager — Premium Fitness Brand (German-speaking, DACH)
description:
⚠️ READ THE FULL POST. There's a specific instruction at the end. Applications that don't follow it will be instantly rejected.

Who We Are

Kraftathlet is a premium B2B fitness & Pilates equipment distributor dominating the DACH market. We sell €3,000–€6,000 reformers and high-end studio projects to professionals. This is NOT a consumer fitness brand. Our buyers are studio owners, physiotherapists, and gym architects making five-six figures purchasing decisions. If you've only grown accounts selling protein powder or leggings, this isn't for you.

What We Need

Someone who treats organic social like a revenue channel, not a vanity metric. We don't care about follower count. We care about DMs from studio owners asking for quotes. We care about inbound leads that close at €10k+. You will own everything: strategy, content creation, community, and funnel architecture, all organic.


You'll Have a Massive Head Start

Our suppliers provide us with a ridiculous library of professional product videos, studio shots, lifestyle content, and B-roll. You're not starting from zero. You're starting with a vault of premium visual assets and your job is to turn them into scroll-stopping, lead-generating content machines across Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Pinterest.


What You'll Actually Do

Build and execute an organic content strategy designed to generate qualified B2B leads
Create reels, carousels, stories, and short-form video from our existing asset library + original content
Design and deploy organic lead magnets and DM funnels (think: studio planning guides, equipment checklists, exclusive previews)
Build a community of studio owners and fitness professionals who see us as THE authority
Engage daily: comments, DMs, UGC, collaborations, lives
Track what converts, kill what doesn't, scale what works

Non-Negotiable Requirements

Native German 
speaker (C2 minimum, no exceptions, our entire audience is DACH)
You can show us at least 2 accounts you personally grew organically past 10k with measurable business impact (not just followers)
You understand that B2B social is a different game and you've played it
You can create content yourself: editing reels, designing carousels, writing copy that doesn't sound like ChatGPT
You bring a strategy in week 1, not ask us "what should I post?"
Based in EU timezone


This Is NOT For You If:

You've never worked with a premium or B2B brand
Your portfolio is full of dance trends and meme pages
You need someone to tell you what to do every day
You can't show direct attribution between your social work and actual revenue/leads


Details

15–25 hrs/week to start, grows with results
Remote, flexible schedule (EU timezone required)
Long-term: we want a partner, not a freelancer who disappears in 3 months
Compensation: competitive hourly + performance bonus tied to qualified lead generation


🚨 APPLICATION INSTRUCTION (mandatory):

Start your proposal with the words "Ich bin dein Social-Kreativer" followed by one specific tactic you'd deploy in the first 14 days for a premium Pilates equipment brand targeting studio owners. If your proposal doesn't start with this exact phrase + a concrete tactic, it goes straight to trash. No exceptions. title: WordPress Developer Needed for 3-Page Restaurant Website
description:
I’m looking for an experienced *WordPress + Elementor developer* to build a simple, modern, and user-friendly *3-page website for my restaurant business*.

The goal is to create a professional website that looks attractive, works smoothly on all devices, and makes it easy for customers to learn about the restaurant, explore the menu, and get in touch.

The website will include *3 main pages: Home, Menu, and Contact/Location*. The Home page should have an engaging hero section, restaurant introduction, featured dishes, and clear calls-to-action. The Menu page should present food and drinks in a clean, organized, and easy-to-read format with categories, descriptions, and prices. The Contact page should include contact information, opening hours, location, Google Maps, social media links, and a contact form.

### Requirements:

* WordPress and Elementor development
* Modern and visually appealing design
* Fully responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop
* Fast-loading and well-structured pages
* Easy navigation and user-friendly layout
* Contact form and Google Maps integration
* Basic SEO-friendly structure
* Easy for the restaurant owner to edit later

Please share *2-3 relevant WordPress/Elementor websites* you have built, especially restaurant, food, or local business websites.

title: Website build, research org — non-technical owner, need scope advice
description:
I'm building the website for an independent research and publishing
organisation. I'm the only person running it — no developer on
retainer after launch, no technical background. I need to publish
content, edit pages, manage submissions, and manage the intern
pipeline myself, in a browser, without touching code. Two or three
other people will also need limited logins for parts of this (see
below) — none of us can code.

Not fixed on any platform — recommend what actually fits the brief
and your honest read of my budget, and say why.

WHAT IT DOES
Publishes written pieces in three lengths: long pieces with a PDF,
medium pieces with a PDF, and short pieces published frequently as
plain text (a running newsletter-style feed). Content sits in subject
categories, each with its own page that auto-lists everything filed
under it. I need to add a new category myself later, no code.

It also runs a small internship programme, end to end — application,
document verification, certificate issuance, and public verification
of those certificates.

COMPONENTS I NEED

PUBLIC SITE
- Homepage with a featured piece and recent publications
- Filterable publications list (by category, by piece type)
- Individual publication page: title, clickable author names, a
  visible abstract (not just inside a PDF), keywords, embedded PDF
  with download
- Category pages that auto-list their own content
- An author page per person, auto-generated, listing everything
  they've published — every co-author gets one, not just the lead
- A frequent short-article / newsletter section, with email signup
  and sending to subscribers
- Careers/Internships page listing open roles, with an application
  form (file upload for CV) that emails me on submission
- Standard static pages, and a contact form that emails me

SUBMISSION AND REVIEW SYSTEM
- A logged-in area where someone submits a piece on-site: title,
  category, type, multiple author fields (add/remove), and a
  rich-text editor for the full text
- On submit, status is "Pending Review" and I get an email
- An admin view listing pending submissions with three actions each:
  Accept (publishes live, authors become linked), Request Revision
  (I add a note, author edits and resubmits), Reject (short reason).
  Each action emails the author automatically.
- A dashboard for submitters showing their own pieces and status

INTERN PIPELINE AND CERTIFICATES
- Applicants apply through a form; I approve or decline
- Approved applicants log in and submit onboarding details plus
  document uploads (ID, signed agreement, etc.)
- A small number of people (2–3, not me) log in with limited access
  to review and verify those documents — they should not see or
  touch anything else on the site
- On verification, the system auto-generates a joining letter as a
  PDF, assigns the intern a unique ID, and emails it to them
- Interns can be grouped into teams; a team lead can see their team's
  members and mark progress against milestones in a simple dashboard
- Interns submit periodic progress updates through a form
- At the end of the internship, interns fill a completion form —
  I need to be able to change the questions on this form myself,
  without code
- Submitting that form auto-generates a completion certificate as a
  PDF and emails it; if the intern published something, a separate
  publication certificate is generated the same way
- Every certificate carries the intern's unique ID and nothing else
  administrative (no registration numbers, no personal document
  details printed on it)
- Interns can log back in any time with their ID to download their
  own certificates again
- A separate public page where anyone (an employer, a university)
  enters an ID and a surname and gets a yes/no confirmation the
  certificate is genuine, with no document download — this page must
  work indefinitely, even years later
- 2–3 admin-level logins (including mine) that can see and manage the
  whole intern pipeline from the website alone

THE CONSTRAINT THAT MATTERS MOST
I maintain this alone, zero coding ability, indefinitely, and the 2–3
other people with limited logins have no technical background either.
If part of this can't be built that way inside a realistic budget,
tell me plainly rather than taking the job and leaving me stuck after.

IN YOUR PROPOSAL, TELL ME:
1. Platform/stack you'd use, and why it suits non-technical users
   running this solo and in small teams
2. Your honest opinion — given the full scope above and my budget,
   what would you build first, and what would you sequence for
   later? I want your recommendation, not a guess at what I want to
   hear.
3. Fixed price and timeline for what you'd propose building first,
   plus a rough estimate for the rest
4. Support window after handover, and your rate beyond it
5. A site you've built with a similar document/certificate workflow,
   or one a non-technical person still maintains today
6. internship form submission and HR login can be excluded from V1, as will grow we will build that in next phase, opinion? (to keep things in budget)

I'd rather hire someone who tells me straight what my budget buys
than someone who agrees to everything and disappears after launch.

title: U.S.-Based Technical Consultant - Client-Facing Software Role
description:
About the Opportunity

We're a growing software startup expanding into the U.S. market, and we're looking for an experienced U.S.-based software professional to work with us as a long-term technical partner.

This is a client-facing role for someone with a strong software development background who enjoys talking with clients, understanding their technical needs, and working closely with an experienced development team.

You do not need to write code for this role. Our development team handles implementation. Your role is to help us build strong relationships with U.S. clients and make sure their technical requirements are clearly understood and communicated to our development team.

 What You'll Do

- Join meetings and calls with U.S. clients
- Understand their business and technical requirements
- Ask the right technical questions and identify important details
- Explain technical concepts clearly to clients
- Discuss software architecture, APIs, databases, cloud technologies, and integrations when appropriate
- Communicate client requirements clearly to our development team
- Help ensure everyone is aligned on project goals, technical requirements, and expectations
- Build and maintain long-term professional relationships with clients

 Who We're Looking For

You may be a great fit if you are:

- Currently based in the U.S.
- An experienced software developer, engineer, architect, technical consultant, solutions architect, or similar professional
- Comfortable discussing software architecture, development, APIs, databases, cloud technologies, and related technical topics
- A strong English communicator
- Comfortable leading or participating in client meetings
- Able to understand both business needs and technical requirements
- Professional, reliable, and comfortable working independently
- Comfortable communicating technical requirements between clients and an offshore or distributed development team

 Why Join Us?

- $100-$200/hour, depending on experience
- Part-time and flexible
- No coding required - focus on technical communication and client relationships
- Work directly with U.S. clients
- Opportunity to use your technical experience in a more client-facing role
- Potential for a long-term engagement as we expand our U.S. client relationships
- Work alongside an established software development team

 Time Commitment

Part-time

The exact schedule will depend on client needs and your availability.

There is potential for an ongoing, long-term engagement based on client needs and performance.

 Interested?

If you have a strong software background and enjoy talking with clients, understanding their problems, and turning technical conversations into clear requirements, we'd love to hear from you.

Please tell us briefly about your software development experience and your experience working directly with clients. If possible, please also describe the types of software, technologies, or technical environments you have worked with.

title: Klaviyo Email Marketing Specialist
description:
About the Brand

CAN'T BE LABELLED (CBL) is a UK-based premium streetwear label built on limited-edition drops and a no-label philosophy. Every product is a one-time production run — no restocks, no mass market. We're building a collector community around scarcity, quality, and identity.

We're not looking for generic email marketing. We need someone who understands brand voice, drop culture, and how to keep an audience warm and hungry between launches.



What We Have Already

Klaviyo account fully set up with active flows
1,300+ email subscribers and an SMS list
Automated post-purchase flows running (currently up to 30 days)
Established brand aesthetic — minimalist, premium, no hype



The Gap We Need You to Fill

After the first 30 days, our subscribers hear nothing from us unless we launch a new drop or send a one-off campaign. We need someone to build and manage the ongoing email strategy that keeps our audience engaged, warm, and ready to buy when we drop.



What You'll Be Doing

Audit existing Klaviyo flows and extend post-purchase sequence to 90 days
Build a win-back flow for customers inactive 60+ days
Create and send one monthly brand content email (no hard sell — culture, story, what's coming)
Build pre-drop hype sequences (2–3 emails per drop, 2–3 weeks out)
Manage and grow SMS flows alongside email
Report monthly on open rates, click rates, and revenue attributed to email



What We're Looking For

Proven Klaviyo experience — please share examples of flows and campaigns you've built
Experience with fashion, streetwear, or lifestyle brands specifically
Strong copywriting skills — you need to write in a premium, minimal tone. No fluff, no filler
Someone who can work independently and take ownership, not just execute instructions
UK timezone preferred but not essential



Scope & Budget

Part-time freelance — approximately 10–15 hours per month
Budget: £400–500/month retainer
Starting with a 30-day trial period with clear deliverables



To Apply

Please include:

2–3 examples of email campaigns or flows you've built for fashion or lifestyle brands
A brief note on how you'd approach keeping a drop-model brand's list warm between launches
Your availability and time zone

title: Sales representative - US Maintenance company
description:
We are looking for an experienced Sales Representative for a US home services company.
Previous sales experience in the US construction, home repair, handyman, painting, renovation or property maintenance industry is required.
This is an inbound sales position — not cold calling.
Responsibilities:
- Respond to incoming leads immediately
- Call customers who request estimates
- Understand the scope of work
- Ask for photos and project details when required
- Prepare/provide estimates using our pricing system
- Follow up on open estimates
- Handle objections and negotiate where appropriate
- Close deals and book jobs
- Keep leads and customer information updated
We are looking for a closer, not a customer service representative.
You must:
- Have proven experience selling construction, repair, maintenance or home services in the US
- Speak excellent English
- Be confident on the phone with American customers
- Understand how US homeowners describe repair and construction jobs
- Be able to work US hours
- Respond to new leads quickly
- Be comfortable discussing pricing and closing deals
Compensation: Base salary + commission on closed sales.
We have active inbound lead flow and are looking for someone who can start immediately.
When applying, briefly describe:
1. Which US construction/home-service company or industry you worked in
2. What services you sold
3. How long you worked with US customers
4. Your sales/closing experience
5. Your availability during US business hours
Applications without previous US construction / repair / maintenance sales experience will not be considered.

title: Build an Automated AI Lead Generation Pipeline (Web Scraper + Zapier/Make)
description:
I am looking for a specialized data automation freelancer or boutique agency to build a proprietary, ongoing property-damage lead extraction pipeline for my business. I handle all sales execution independently and only require a clean, continuous technical data system built.
The budget for this project is a flat, fixed rate of $1000 total. We will use Upwork Escrow divided into three strict performance milestones.
System Architecture Required:
1. Data Acquisition (Milestone 1): Build a custom web scraper/data connection to extract daily accident records from public/state registries and data portals in Texas and Georgia. For Florida, construct an inbound API webhook stream tied to a multi-step qualification form to bypass the 60-day privacy restriction.
2. AI Filtration (Milestone 2): Connect the raw text feeds into Make.com or Zapier. Route the data to the OpenAI API (using GPT-4o mini) to read and evaluate the crash narratives against 6 strict quality rules.
3. Data Enrichment & Delivery (Milestone 3): For passing leads, connect a skip-tracing API to automatically look up the vehicle owner's active mobile phone number based on their name and address. Deliver the completed lead instantly into a locked Google Sheet.

The 6 Strict Quality Rules the AI Must Enforce:
1. Fault System: Modified Comparative Fault logic. Approve the lead as long as the target driver is NOT the primary cause of the accident (the narrative must indicate their fault is clearly under 50%).
2. Vehicle Year: Must be a 2021 model or newer.
3. Mileage: Vehicle must have 55,000 miles or less at the time of the accident.
4. Ownership Status: Cannot be leased. (Program the AI to exclude corporate owner names containing: Leasing, Trust, Financial, Credit, Bank, etc.).
5. Damage Minimum: Estimated repair cost must be at least $2,000 (or contain heavy structural narrative keywords like towed due to disabling damage or airbag deployment).
6. Not Totaled: The vehicle cannot be a total loss. (Exclude records explicitly flagged as Total Loss, Inoperable, or where damage clearly exceeds 75% of clean retail value).
Project Deliverables & Contract Terms:
* Fixed-Price Only: No hourly quotes or monthly retainers will be entertained.
* Modular Architecture: The system must be built cleanly in make.com so that I can easily pay a flat fee to plug in additional states later down the road.
* Full Ownership Handoff: The developer must transfer 100% master administrative ownership of the code, scripts, and automation accounts upon project completion.
* Live Validation: A live 15-minute screen-share demonstration showing a mock accident record successfully clearing all AI filters, pulling a phone number, and landing on my Google Sheet is required before the final milestone release.
Please provide a brief explanation of how you intend to route the data for these three specific states, and examples of similar automation pipelines you have successfully built.

title: PDF Sewing Pattern Designer & Grader for Adult Fabric House Slippers
description:
We are looking for an experienced home-sewing pattern designer to adapt our original reversible baby slipper pattern into an adult fabric house slipper pattern. We will provide the existing baby pattern and instructions as a construction and visual reference.

The finished pattern should include 9 graded adult sizes labeled by measured foot length, approximately 22–30 cm, covering roughly EU 35–46. Actual measured foot length must be the primary method for selecting a size. Approximate US Women, US Men, EU, and UK size conversions should also be included.

The pattern should support two construction options using the same main pattern pieces:

- A fully reversible fabric slipper.
- A non-reversible padded version with the option to use non-slip sole fabric.

A regular unisex fit is required. A brief adjustment note for wider feet or a high instep would be preferred.

This is a PDF home-sewing pattern, not a factory footwear tech pack. We will sew and test the samples ourselves; the freelancer does not need to produce or ship physical samples.

Deliverables:

Professionally drafted and graded pattern pieces with included seam allowances, notches, labels, grainlines, cutting quantities, and test squares.
Layered US Letter and A4 PDF files.
A clear size chart and materials list.
Complete English sewing instructions for both construction options.
Simple technical illustrations or a detailed photo shot list with clearly marked photo placeholders.
Editable source files.
One reasonable revision round after we test-sew selected sizes.

All work must be original. Copying or adapting another commercial sewing pattern is not acceptable. Final source files and exclusive commercial rights must be transferred to us upon completion and payment.

Please review the attached reference images and briefly explain what structural changes you would make when adapting this design for adult feet.

title: Setter / Inside Sales
description:
Summary
Appointment Setter / Inside Sales – Coaching & Consulting Business (LinkedIn + CRM Nurture)


About Us

My Coach Path helps experienced executive and leadership coaches (mostly 45+, US-based) turn their expertise into a clear positioning, a strong offer, real visibility on LinkedIn, and a repeatable way to win clients. We believe in "Honest Marketing" — real expertise, personality, and relationships instead of aggressive funnels or growth hacks.

We're not looking for a script-reader. We want someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people and can nurture warm relationships into booked calls.

The Role

We have a warm pipeline that needs consistent, personal attention: a CRM Hotlist and Nurture list (~50–100 contacts), two LinkedIn Sales Navigator accounts (cold outreach plus hundreds of stalled chats to reactivate), an Instantly.ai account, and an Airtable database of ~15,000 prospects.

You'll reach out proactively, share value (recorded community calls, process docs, resources), rebuild trust in stalled conversations, and move people to book a call. You're not closing — founder Tom closes. You set the table.

What You'll Be Booking Calls For
Six-Week Intensive (~$5,000): positioning, offer, personal brand, LinkedIn visibility, client acquisition
Growth Partner (from $2,000/month): ongoing coaching/consulting
Community ($250/month): weekly calls, peer group
LinkedIn Profile Rebuild (~$300): 1-hour session with our expert
What You'll Do
Work the Hotlist/Nurture list daily with personal, non-spammy touchpoints
Reactivate stalled LinkedIn conversations across both accounts
Qualify interest and book appointments onto the calendar
Keep the CRM clean and up to date
Weekly report on outreach, conversations, and bookings
Target

3–6 booked appointments per week.

Tools You'll Get

You'll be equipped with a Slack account (our main communication channel), access to our Claude team account (incl. our AI agents and knowledge base), and Notion, where our processes, docs, and resources live.

What We're Looking For
Real experience as an appointment setter, SDR, or inside sales rep, ideally for coaching/consulting or high-ticket services
Excellent written English, warm and human tone
Comfortable in LinkedIn/Sales Navigator and disciplined in a CRM
Self-starter, low hand-holding needed
Compensation

Base rate plus 10% commission on closed deals from your booked appointments. Details discussed in the interview.

How to Apply

Send us a short Loom video (2–3 minutes) telling us about a time you reactivated a cold or stalled lead and turned it into a real conversation, plus your experience with LinkedIn outreach and CRM nurture.

title: Google Ads Campaign Manager - White Label Agency. UK Based
description:
We are a fast-growing UK-based client acquisition agency delivering done-for-you client acquisition systems for founder-led service businesses across cold email, Meta ads, Google ads and LinkedIn outreach.

As we scale and bring on more clients we are proactively building our delivery team ahead of demand, so when the work comes in we are ready to move immediately without delays.

We are currently looking to connect with an experienced Google ads campaign manager on an exploratory basis. There is no live project right now but we are in active conversations with several potential clients and expect to need support very soon.

If you are the right person we want to establish the relationship now so we can bring you in immediately when the time comes.

Here is exactly how the split works:

We provide everything on the strategy and creative side:

Cold traffic offer — the positioning and angle
Ad copy — written, tested and ready to use
Landing page or high converting funnel — built and live
White label CRM — set up and connected to the campaign
Nurture automations — built and ready
Full client brief — ICP, geography, keywords, negative keywords, targeting parameters
You handle everything on the execution side:

Full Google Search campaign setup inside Google Ads Manager
Keyword research and keyword list build — exact, phrase and broad match
Negative keyword list build and ongoing management
Ad copy testing — minimum 3 variants per ad group
Conversion tracking setup — Google Tag Manager, GA4 integration
Call tracking setup if required
Daily budget management and spend pacing
Bid strategy management — manual CPC to Target CPA progression
A/B testing ad groups, match types and landing page variants
Local Service Ads setup where applicable
Weekly performance report — spend, impressions, CTR, CPL, cost per booked call
Scaling recommendations when campaigns are profitable
Flagging issues and recommending changes proactively
What we are looking for:

Proven Google ads results for UK service businesses — show me cost per lead and cost per booked call, not just CTR and impressions
Strong understanding of search intent and cold traffic funnels — not just brand campaigns or retargeting
Experience with Google Tag Manager and GA4 conversion tracking — not just basic Ads conversion tracking
Comfortable working under our agency brand — all client communication goes through us, you will not have direct contact with clients
Reliable communicator — responds within 24 hours
Available for ongoing work as our client base grows
KPIs you will be measured on:

Cost per lead — target under £30 for service businesses
Cost per booked call — target under £75
Click through rate — target 5%+ on search campaigns
Conversion rate from click to lead — target 10%+
Weekly reporting delivered every Monday morning
This is an initial exploratory conversation with a view to building a long-term working relationship. As we grow so does your workload with us. We are looking for someone who wants to grow alongside a fast-moving agency rather than just pick up one-off jobs.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing agency with a strong pipeline of clients coming through. The right person becomes our go-to Google ads operator across all client accounts.

Please include in your application:

Google ads campaigns you have managed for UK service businesses
Cost per lead and cost per booked call results achieved
Your campaign setup process from receiving assets to going live
Tools you use — Google Ads Manager, Google Tag Manager, GA4, any reporting tools
Your turnaround time from receiving the client brief to campaign live

title: Webflow to Shopify Migration
description:
We have a new website that is fully designed and built within Webflow. It consists of static pages along with a dynamic CMS collection containing 150 items. The site is not live yet, so there are no existing SEO or URL redirect implications to worry about. We are looking for an experienced Shopify Developer to migrate this layout and data over to a custom Shopify theme before we launch: https://nooods.webflow.io/

Your job will be to take the Webflow HTML/CSS export and map it cleanly into Shopify’s template architecture so that the site looks identical but runs completely on Shopify. The 150 CMS items need to be converted into Shopify pages (using a custom template) or Shopify blog posts, depending on the architecture you recommend for our content.

Project Scope:
‣ Convert Webflow’s exported HTML/CSS into a clean, custom Shopify Liquid theme (theme.liquid, custom page templates, and sections).

‣ Properly route all Webflow asset folders (images, styles, scripts) into Shopify’s /assets folder using Liquid asset tags.

‣ Bulk import and format the 150 Webflow CMS items into Shopify static templates (preserving layouts and formatting perfectly).

‣ Ensure total responsive layout consistency across mobile, tablet, and desktop views.

Requirements (Strictly Enforced):
‣ Proven Experience: You must have a demonstrated track record of converting Webflow exports or static sites into custom Shopify themes.

‣ Portfolio Proof: You must provide live links or case studies of previous Webflow-to-Shopify migrations you have completed. Applications without examples will be declined.

‣ Technical Skills: Expert knowledge of Shopify Liquid, HTML5, CSS3, and bulk data importing (e.g., using CSVs or tools like Matrixify).

‣ Communication: Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills are essential. You must be able to provide clear status updates.

To Apply:
Please start your proposal with the word "LIQUID" so we know you read the full description. Include a brief summary of how you plan to handle the 150 CMS items in bulk, along with links to your relevant migration portfolio examples.

Thank you, and we look forward to working with you!

title: Marketing Campaign for Brand New Economic Development Platform (Email, Ads, and/or Social Campaign)
description:
The Opportunity 

We are launching a brand-new, first-of-its-kind SaaS platform built specifically for the commercial economic development sector.

Right now, economic development professionals (City Managers, Chamber CEOs, Economic Development Directors) spend upwards of 40 hours manually pulling data from dozens of public sources to respond to RFIs (Requests for Information) and RFPs. Our AI-powered platform automates this entire process. It pulls data from over 50 public sources (Census, USDA, DOE, etc.) and generates a professional, export-ready proposal in minutes with features like site selection and real-time site renderings included.

The platform is fully functional, the website is built and SEO-optimized, and we are ready to scale. We are looking for an experienced, driven freelance marketer to hit the ground running and design a holistic campaign to drive user subscriptions.

While our current niche is strictly commercial economic development, development is already underway to expand into the residential sector. If you can deliver the expected results during this initial trial period (1-3 months), this will transition into a large-scale, full-time opportunity with the company.

The Role & Expectations

We are not looking for someone to just execute a checklist—we want a strategic partner. You will be given the creative freedom to design and run the campaign based on your expertise and what you know works best.

We expect a general outline of your plan before execution, but we need someone who can move quickly and start driving results right away.

Core Responsibilities:

• Targeted Email Marketing (Required): Design and execute high-converting email sequences targeting senior economic development professionals.

• Paid Ads Campaigns (Required): Develop and manage highly targeted ad campaigns (LinkedIn Ads are highly likely given our B2B audience). Ad spend budget is flexible and will be determined based on the campaign strategy we agree upon.

• Social Media Marketing/Management (Bonus): Organic social media strategy and management is a strong bonus, though not the primary focus of this initial engagement.

Our Tech Stack:
We currently use GoHighLevel to support the brand and would prefer the campaign runs within that infrastructure. However, this is not a hard-and-fast requirement—if you have a better solution or preferred stack that can deliver results, we are open to it.

Success Metrics

Success for this role is clearly defined: User Signups.

After giving the campaigns proper time to develop and optimize, our target is to achieve 60–100 new user signups per month.

Who You Are

• Experienced in B2B SaaS marketing, particularly with niche, high-value professional audiences.

• A strategic thinker who can outline a clear plan but is also a "doer" who can execute quickly.

• Comfortable taking creative ownership and making data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns.

• Familiar with GoHighLevel (preferred) or able to articulate why a different toolset will achieve better results for this specific campaign.

If you know how to reach decision-makers, craft compelling B2B narratives, and drive measurable subscription growth, we want to talk to you. Please include a brief overview of how you would approach this challenge in your proposal as well as successful B2B campaigns you have executed in the past. Company name and website will be shared once we have vetted candidates and selected our list of finalists.

title: Wix Studio Designer for Ongoing Website Projects
description:
// About the Role //

I’m looking for an experienced Wix Studio designer to support me with ongoing client website projects.

I run a marketing, messaging and website business in Canada. I handle the strategy, messaging, copywriting, website structure and overall creative direction for my clients.

I’m looking for someone who can take that direction and turn it into a polished, professional, responsive Wix Studio website.

This is primarily an execution and production role. I’m not looking to outsource client strategy or copywriting. I need someone who is excellent at building.

For the right person, there is potential for consistent, ongoing project work.


// What You’ll Be Doing //

Depending on the project, your responsibilities may include:
* Building website pages in Wix Studio
* Translating creative direction into finished pages
* Creating clean, professional page layouts
* Ensuring excellent desktop, tablet and mobile responsiveness
* Setting up global styles and reusable sections/components
* Adding and formatting provided copy and imagery
* Creating tasteful animations and interactions where appropriate
* Setting up forms and other standard Wix functionality
* Making design revisions based on feedback
* Keeping builds organized and easy to maintain
* Creating meta descriptions, alt text, and other SEO functionality


// What I’m Looking For //

You should:
* Have strong experience specifically with Wix Studio
* Have an excellent eye for layout, spacing, typography and visual hierarchy
* Be extremely detail-oriented
* Be able to accurately follow established creative direction
* Understand responsive web design, not just desktop design
* Work efficiently without sacrificing quality
* Communicate clearly
* Be dependable with deadlines
* Be comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions
* Be able to work independently without needing detailed instructions for every small decision

A strong portfolio of real Wix Studio websites you’ve personally built is required.


// Important: Paid Test Project //

I plan to select a small number of candidates for a paid test project before choosing someone for ongoing work.

You’ll be provided with the same page/design brief and asked to build it in Wix Studio.

I’ll be evaluating:
* Accuracy to the creative direction
* Overall design quality
* Attention to detail
* Desktop and mobile responsiveness
* Wix Studio build quality
* Speed and efficiency
* Communication
* Ability to make good decisions without excessive direction

This is a paid test. I do not expect candidates to complete free design work as part of the application.


// To Apply //

Please include:
1. A short introduction about your Wix Studio experience.
2. 3–5 Wix Studio websites you personally designed/built. Please specify exactly what you were responsible for on each project.
3. Your typical hourly rate.
4. Approximately how many hours per week you currently have available for ongoing freelance work.
5. Your typical turnaround time for building a 5 page website when the copy, content and creative direction are provided.
6. Tell me whether you primarily work in Wix Studio or the classic Wix Editor.
7. Start your application with the words “Wix Studio” so I know you’ve read the full posting.

Please do not send a generic agency proposal. I’m specifically interested in hearing from individual designers who could become a reliable long-term part of my website production process.


// Potential for Ongoing Work // 

This is not intended to be a one-time project.

I’m looking for someone I can develop a reliable working relationship with and bring into future website projects as needed. If the paid test goes well, there is potential for regular work throughout the year.

title: Female Voice Acting & Singing Coach (Vtuber/Streamer experience required)
description:
I'm building a streaming persona and looking for an experienced female English-speaking voice coach to help me build a strong foundation in both voice acting and singing over an approximate 2-month program.

What I'm looking for:

-Professional coaching experience in voice acting and/or singing, comfortable teaching both.
-Prior streaming or VTuber experience strongly preferred as I'd value pointers from someone who has actually performed live to audiences of varying size, from a handful of viewers to a large crowd, and can speak to keeping energy and engagement consistent either way.
-Guidance on vocal health and avoiding strain, since I'll be using my voice regularly for streaming going forward.
Strong communication skills and a teaching style suited to a genuine beginner.
-Bonus: Help with improving accents

Goal: by the end of the program, I'd like my voice acting and singing to reach a solid, pleasant-sounding level. It doesn't have to be a ridiculously professional performance standard, but confident and consistent enough to use regularly on stream (like karaoke, voice acting, song covers, etc.).

Open to discussing session frequency and rate based on experience.

title: Wix Website Designer Needed to Polish Existing 4-Page Website
description:
I have an existing Wix website for a real estate consulting company that is approximately 90% complete. The website structure, written content, logo, pages, forms, and overall design are already in place.
I am not looking for a new website or a complete redesign. I am looking for an experienced Wix designer with a strong visual/design eye to professionally polish the existing site.
The site currently has four primary pages:
•	Home
•	About
•	Services
•	Contact
Scope of Work
I would like the designer to:
•	Correct alignment, spacing, margins, and sizing inconsistencies throughout the site.
•	Improve the overall visual balance and professional appearance.
•	Fix specific alignment issues on the Home page, including the contact/form area.
•	Review typography, font sizing, and visual hierarchy for consistency.
•	Improve the presentation of the founder photo and bio on the About page.
•	Review the current images and recommend or replace them with more appropriate professional imagery where needed.
•	Add a subtle amount of color or visual interest if appropriate while maintaining the site's professional appearance.
•	Make buttons, headings, forms, and sections visually consistent.
•	Remove unnecessary blank space.
•	Ensure the desktop and mobile versions are both properly formatted.
•	Perform a final visual review of the entire website.

title: SDR Team Needed for Warm Lead Follow-Up & Appointment Setting
description:
We are looking for an established call center or outsourced SDR company to work with our existing database of professional prospects in the United States and Canada.

We are not looking for an individual freelancer. We want a company with multiple trained representatives, management, quality control, and backup coverage if a caller leaves or is unavailable.

About Us

We operate a professional education and business-development community serving financial advisors, attorneys, CPAs, insurance professionals, and other professionals who work with high-net-worth clients.

We regularly host educational webinars. Hundreds of professionals register for and attend these events, and their information is stored in HubSpot.

We need a professional outbound team to follow up with these warm prospects.

Responsibilities

Your team will:

- Research each prospect before or during outreach
- Review company websites and LinkedIn profiles
- Verify and update contact information in HubSpot
- Call webinar registrants and attendees
- Have a natural, professional conversation about their interest
- Determine whether they may be a fit for our community
- Schedule qualified appointments directly on my calendar
- Leave professional voicemails
- Conduct follow-up calls when appropriate
- Maintain detailed notes in HubSpot
- Assign accurate lead statuses and dispositions
- Schedule future follow-up dates
- Keep our CRM database clean and current

This is not cold telemarketing.

The people being contacted have already registered for or attended one of our webinars, so they have some familiarity with our company.

English Requirements

This is extremely important.

Our prospects are sophisticated U.S. and Canadian business professionals.

Callers must have:

- C1/C2 or near-native English
- Clear, neutral pronunciation
- Natural conversational English
- Strong listening skills
- Excellent understanding of American business communication
- Ability to have an unscripted professional conversation

We are not looking for someone who simply reads a script.

We will personally interview and approve every caller assigned to our account before they begin making calls.

Experience We Prefer

Your team should have experience with:

- B2B appointment setting
- U.S. outbound sales
- Financial services
- Professional services
- Attorneys, CPAs, advisors, insurance professionals, or similar audiences
- HubSpot or comparable CRMs
- Lead qualification
- Warm lead reactivation
- Database research and cleanup

Staffing Requirements

We want a managed solution rather than dependence on one individual.

Ideally, you will provide:

- 1–2 primary callers
- A trained backup caller
- A team leader or account manager
- Call recording
- Quality assurance
- Ongoing coaching
- Replacement and retraining if a representative leaves
- Weekly reporting

Our scripts, training materials, CRM data, and call history must remain documented so that personnel changes do not require us to start over.

Technology

We use HubSpot.

Your team must be comfortable working directly inside our HubSpot account and keeping every record updated.

We also want call recordings available for quality-control purposes.

Initial Project

We would like to begin with a 60–90 day pilot program using an existing list of webinar registrants and attendees.

If the pilot is successful, this can become an ongoing relationship as we conduct new webinars every month.

When You Apply

Please include:

- Your company name and website
- Number of employees/callers
- Location
- Experience calling U.S. business professionals
- Experience with appointment setting
- Experience using HubSpot
- How you handle employee turnover and backup coverage
- Your management and quality-control process
- Your pricing structure
- Examples or voice samples of representatives who could potentially work on our account
- Two or three U.S.-based client references, if available
- Whether we can interview and approve the callers before they are assigned

Please start your response with the words “B2B SDR TEAM” so we know you have read the entire posting.

We are interested in building a long-term relationship with the right company. We value professionalism, excellent English communication, accurate CRM management, and quality conversations more than simply generating a high number of calls.

title: Lead Video Editor & Operations Manager
description:
ob description (Upwork)
Title: Lead Video Editor → Manager of Editors (Content Creation & Publishing)

Company: PAPS Studio
Type: Ongoing · Remote · Start as a contractor on Upwork
Language: [English / Spanish / both — fill in]
Hours: [fill in]
Pay: [fill in hourly or monthly. Do not invent a number.]

The job
We are not hiring a person for one video.

We are hiring the person who will run content creation and publishing as if the company is theirs.

You start as the main video editor. You do the work yourself first. That is how we learn, with real numbers, how many customers each editor under you can take care of. Only after that do you hire and manage the team.

Everything is created with AI and edited with AI. We service any industry.

The machine
2 pieces of content per day, per customer, 365 days a year.
Target to test: one editor owns 15 to 20 customer accounts in a month.
Your first job is to be that editor and tell us the true number (it may be 15 to 20, or not). Then you hire under you and teach them that number.
What you do
First (you are the main editor)

Cut and ship the daily pieces (AI create, AI edit).
Own a real set of customer accounts.
Measure how many accounts one person can actually hold without junk.
Then (you hire under you)

Hire video editors (and let go of people who do not ship).
Train them on our way: AI create, AI edit, any industry, high volume.
Make sure each editor knows their customer count and hits 2/day/account.
Build a simple daily rhythm: what gets made, what gets published, what is late.
Report to Ignacio what is live, what is stuck, and what you need.
Treat the company as yours: problems get solved, not forwarded as a ticket.
What this is not
Not a one-off Fiverr-style gig.
Not “send me a pretty reel and disappear.”
Not a desk job that only hires and never cuts.
Not a promise of ownership on day one. If you run it like yours, we talk about the next step. We do not sell fake shares in an Upwork post.
Who you are
You have edited a lot of short-form or social video (proof in a portfolio or Google Drive).
You have used AI tools to make or edit video (name the tools you actually used).
You can later run or train other editors. First you prove the volume with your own hands.
You are calm with volume. 2/day/account, every day, is normal here, not a panic.
You can work with any industry (gym, clinic, restaurant, coach, etc.) without needing a new personality every time.
You write and speak clearly in [language].
How we start
You send: 3 links of your work + 5 lines on how you would measure “accounts per editor.”
Paid trial on Upwork: you edit a real slice yourself.
If that works, you stay as lead editor. Hiring starts when you and Ignacio agree the number is real.
To apply
In your proposal, answer these three lines only:

How will you learn the true number of customers one editor can hold?
How do you keep 2 pieces/day/account from turning into trash?
Which AI create + AI edit tools have you actually shipped with?
No cover-letter novel. No agency pitch that hides the person.

Fill before you post: language, hours, pay.
Do not invent: equity %, tool names you did not lock, a salary number.

title: Data export
description:
I need a virtual assistant to manually transfer customer information from my Loopy Loyalty account into an Excel/Google Sheets spreadsheet.

I have a customer list in Loopy Loyalty. For each customer, you will click “Actions” to open their customer details. The customer’s full name is currently listed together under the Last Name field, so you will need to separate the First Name and Last Name and enter them into the correct, separate columns in my spreadsheet.

For example, if Loopy shows:
Last Name: Maria Rodriguez

The spreadsheet should have:
First Name: Maria | Last Name: Rodriguez

The name information is available inside the “Actions” section for each customer.

Accuracy is extremely important. Please double-check each customer’s information before moving to the next one. Do not change, delete, or modify any information in Loopy.

You will only enter information that is already available in Loopy. Do not guess, assume, or create missing information. If a name is unclear or cannot be accurately separated, please flag it for me rather than guessing.

This is a straightforward data-entry project. I will provide the spreadsheet and detailed instructions.

You must be comfortable working with customer information and keep all data strictly confidential.

title: DM Setter: LinkedIn & Instagram Outreach - White Label Agency UK Based
description:
We are a fast-growing UK-based client acquisition agency delivering done-for-you acquisition systems for founder-led service businesses across cold email, Meta ads, Google ads and LinkedIn outreach.

As we scale and bring on more clients we are proactively building our delivery team ahead of demand — so when the work comes in we are ready to move immediately without delays.

We are currently looking to connect with an experienced DM setter on an exploratory basis. There is no live account right now but we are in active conversations with several potential clients and expect to need support very soon.

If you are the right person we want to establish the relationship now so we can bring you in immediately when the time comes.

Here is exactly how the role works:

We handle everything on the strategy and systems side:

The outreach targets — we provide the list of prospects to contact
The Trojan Horse permission scripts — written and ready to use
The VSL and offer messaging — built and ready to send
The objection handling frameworks — you follow the system
The CRM pipeline — built and tracked in our white label system
Full training on our DM framework before you start
You handle everything on the conversation management side:

Sending Trojan Horse permission messages to new connections daily
Managing follow up sequences for prospects who have not yet responded
Sending the VSL or offer to prospects who give permission
Converting positive replies into booked calls using our proven framework
Managing the full follow up chain — up to 8 touchpoints per prospect
Morning and evening pipeline check — twice daily minimum
Moving prospects through the pipeline stages — initiated, engaged, Calendly'd, booked
Reporting daily numbers — messages sent, replies received, calls booked
Flagging not interested replies and removing from pipeline immediately
Platforms you will work across:

LinkedIn
Instagram
Facebook
Twitter / X if required
What we are looking for:

Proven DM setting experience — show me booked call results not just message volume
Strong written English — conversational, natural and non-salesy tone
Fast response time — prospects must be replied to within 5 minutes of a positive reply
Experience with CRM or pipeline tracking tools
Comfortable working under our agency brand — all communication goes through our accounts, you will not have direct contact with clients
Reliable and consistent — this is a daily role, morning and evening check minimum
Available to start within 1 to 2 weeks
KPIs you will be measured on:

Number of Trojan Horse messages sent daily
Positive reply rate
Conversion rate from positive reply to booked call — target 50%+
Number of calls booked per week
This is an initial exploratory conversation with a view to building a long-term working relationship. As we grow so does your workload with us. We are looking for someone who wants to grow alongside a fast-moving agency rather than just pick up one-off work.

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing agency with a strong pipeline of clients coming through. The right person becomes our go-to DM setter across all client accounts.

Please include in your application:

DM campaigns you have managed and calls booked as a result
Your average conversion rate from positive reply to booked call
Platforms you have worked across
Your typical daily message volume
Your availability and response time during working hours

title: English-Speaking UGC Creator — Video Ads (Multiple Characters, Indoor & Outdoor)
description:
We're looking for a versatile UGC (User-Generated Content) creator to produce short-form video ads for paid social campaigns (Meta/TikTok). You'll be filming a mix of talking-head, testimonial-style, and character-driven content, not polished brand videos, but authentic, high-converting UGC.

What You'll Do:
- Film UGC-style video ads based on scripts and hooks we provide
- Shoot in both indoor (home/office-style) and outdoor (real-world, lifestyle) settings
- Portray different characters/personas across videos, different "customer" types, tones, and energy levels. You're comfortable acting, not just reading lines to camera
- Deliver clean footage: good lighting, stable framing, and clear, crisp audio (no background noise, no wind, no echo)
- Turn around raw or lightly-edited clips within agreed timelines
- Take direction well and re-shoot/iterate quickly based on feedback

What We're Looking For:
- Native or fluent English speaker, neutral/US-friendly accent
- Proven UGC or acting/content creation experience — portfolio or reel required
- Range: able to switch between characters, tones, and delivery styles convincingly
- Access to solid equipment: phone or camera capable of 1080p/4K, tripod, decent lighting, external mic or a quiet, controlled shooting space
- Reliable, responsive, and consistent with deadlines
- Bonus: experience with direct-response / performance-marketing style ads (not just lifestyle/brand content)

Project Details:
- Volume: 10 short videos
- Scripts/hooks provided by us; some creative freedom encouraged within brand voice
- Compensation: $20 per video (open to discussing based on experience and quality)
- Long-term collaboration for the right fit

To Apply, Please Include:
- A short intro video of yourself (30-60 sec)
- 2-3 links to previous UGC or acting samples
- Your rate per video (or day rate)
- Your available equipment/shooting setup

description:

They made profits in 2025 that more than covered the losses from the prior two years.  The Operating Agreement allocates losses to partners with positive capital accounts.  Profits are allocated first to partners who incurred the losses and then to partners proportional to their ownership.  It is a mixed allocation of profits.  I need someone who knows exactly how this should be filed in CCH’s special allocations section.  Do not apply unless you specifically know the answer.  If you can solve the special allocation filing in under an hour, I will bonus an additional hour (2 hours total).

If you can handle this project with excellence and expertise, I have more returns you can handle.

title: Squarespace Designer for Author/Artist Website
description:
I’m an author and cartoonist looking to rebuild my existing personal website as a simple, highly visual Squarespace site. I currently have a WordPress site, but I’m NOT looking to recreate or redesign the existing site—I’d like to start fresh.

I’m looking for someone with a strong visual/design eye who can help me:

* Set up and design the basic framework for a new Squarespace site.
* Create a clean, minimal, image-forward design appropriate for an author/cartoonist/illustrator.
* Build the core pages and reusable layouts so I can easily add and replace artwork, books, projects, and other content myself.
* Use placeholder content where needed; I’m still developing some of the artwork and materials that will ultimately appear on the site.
* Make sure the site works well on desktop and mobile.
* Help me transition away from my existing WordPress setup and connect my existing domain/URL to the new Squarespace site. My current domain/hosting appears to be through IONOS, so I’d especially value someone comfortable helping me determine what needs to be transferred, connected, or eventually canceled.
* Provide a basic handoff, so I’m comfortable maintaining and updating the site myself.

I’m especially interested in someone who has designed websites for artists, illustrators, authors, photographers, or other creative professionals. Strong design sensibility is more important to me than technical complexity.

A few websites that represent the kind of simple, visual approach I’m drawn to (not sites I’m looking to copy):

* Jillian Tamaki — https://www.jilliantamaki.com/
* Sarah E. Shaw — https://www.saraheshaw.com/
* Rachel Jepsen — https://www.racheljepsen.com/
* Tillie Walden — https://www.tilliewalden.com/
* Bianca Xunise — https://www.biancaxunise.com/

When responding, please include a few examples of visually driven websites you’ve designed, particularly portfolio/artist sites if available. I’d also love to hear briefly how you’d approach this project based on the examples above.

I’ve listed a $500 estimated budget, but I’m open to proposals based on your recommended scope and approach. Please include your proposed fixed price and what you would include.

title: Content Repurposing Video Editor: Turn Long-Form YouTube Into High-Retention Shorts
description:
I create long form YouTube content about business, marketing, Meta ads, lead generation, sales, offers, systems, and scaling online businesses

I need a high quality content repurposing editor to turn each YouTube video into strong Instagram Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts

This is not a basic captions and zoom cuts role

You need strong editorial judgment

You must be able to watch a 20 to 60 minute video, find the best ideas, and turn them into standalone short form content people actually want to watch and share


WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Review long form YouTube videos and identify 10 to 20 strong clip opportunities with timestamps

• Select and edit 5 to 10 high quality short form videos per long form video

• Create a strong hook and first frame title for every clip

• Remove filler, repetition, pauses, and unnecessary context

• Build clips around useful business lessons, strong opinions, frameworks, proof, stories, or practical solutions

• Deliver clean 9:16 edits for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

• Organise final files in Google Drive

• Learn my content style, voice, audience, and business positioning over time


IMPORTANT

I do not want random sections cut out of YouTube videos

You must be able to pull a strong line from later in the video and use it as the opening hook

You may also need to stitch separate parts of the same video together to make the short form content clearer, tighter, and more interesting

The final product should feel intentionally made for short form, not like a random podcast clip


STYLE

Clean, premium, direct response business content

Use B roll, screen recordings, frameworks, proof, graphics, or simple overlays only where they make the content stronger

No excessive captions, animated text everywhere, irrelevant memes, or generic viral style editing


TO APPLY, SEND

1. Three examples of short form content you created from long form videos

2. The original long form source for each example, if available

3. Your exact role in the edit, including whether you selected the clip and created the hook

4. One example where you stitched multiple moments together into one short form video

5. Your monthly rate, estimated output, and turnaround time

6. A short Loom explaining why you are a fit


PAID TEST

Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid test using the same long form video

The test will involve selecting clip opportunities, explaining the hooks, creating 3 to 5 finished short form videos, and completing one revision round

Please do not apply if you only use automated clipping software or create generic caption heavy edits

I am looking for a long term editor who can eventually own the process of turning my YouTube videos into consistently strong short form content

title: B2B SaaS Growth Marketer to Recruit Beta Users
description:
We recently launched OmnaSense, a working B2B SaaS platform that monitors website marketing tracking and customer journeys and alerts teams when important tracking breaks or changes.

We're looking for a freelancer to help us find and recruit our first 3–5 external beta users.

Ideal beta users include digital marketing agencies, ecommerce/Shopify agencies, GA4 or Google Tag Manager consultants, analytics professionals, CRO agencies, and ecommerce businesses that rely on conversion tracking.

What you'll do
• Research and identify qualified potential beta users
• Find legitimate public business contact information
• Conduct personalized organic outreach
• Promote the beta in relevant communities where appropriate
• Follow up with interested prospects
• Help generate beta conversations/demos
• Track outreach and responses

This is an initial 2-week trial. We care much more about finding a few genuinely interested beta users than generating hundreds of low-quality leads.

No purchased lists, spam, fake accounts, or mass automated outreach.

To apply Please briefly answer:
1. How would you find the first 5 beta users for OmnaSense?
2. Which channels would you use first?
3. Have you done early-stage SaaS lead generation or beta recruitment before?
4. What could you realistically accomplish in 2 weeks?

Experience with B2B SaaS, MarTech, ecommerce, analytics, GA4, GTM, or Shopify is a plus.

If the trial goes well, there is potential for ongoing growth and customer acquisition work.

title: Real Estate SEO Implementation Specialist
description:
****REQUIRED*** Please share a short video explaining why you think you're a good fit for this role. 

SEO Implementation Specialist / Digital Marketing VA – Real Estate Investor

Revive Realty Group is seeking an experienced SEO specialist to implement a detailed SEO growth plan focused on generating motivated-seller leads throughout Metro Detroit.

This is not a general administrative or basic blog-writing position. We need someone who can execute local SEO, optimize WordPress websites, manage content production, improve our Google Business Profile, and track results.

Responsibilities

* Audit two websites using Google Search Console and SEO tools.
* Help determine which domain should be primary and prepare a URL-by-URL redirect map.
* Improve titles, headings, internal links, metadata, schema, indexing, and site structure.
* Optimize and publish pages covering probate, foreclosure, inherited houses, rental properties, and selling houses for cash.
* Create unique Michigan city and county pages without duplicated or generic content.
* Turn company case studies and voice notes into useful content.
* Manage Google Business Profile updates, reviews, photos, and citation cleanup.
* Research legitimate local backlinks and partnership opportunities.
* Provide weekly reporting on rankings, traffic, calls, forms, and qualified leads.
* Use AI for research and drafting while carefully checking accuracy and originality.

Required Experience

* Three or more years of hands-on SEO experience.
* Strong local SEO, WordPress, and on-page SEO skills.
* Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, Google Business Profile, Semrush or Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog.
* Experience with redirects, canonicals, indexing, internal linking, keyword research, and content optimization.
* Verifiable examples of improved rankings, organic traffic, or leads.
* Excellent written English and attention to detail.

Preferred Experience

* Real estate-investor or motivated-seller SEO.
* Previous work with Bateman Collective, Carrot, or a comparable real estate marketing agency.
* Follow Up Boss, call tracking, Looker Studio, Zapier, Make, or n8n.
* Website migrations and local lead-generation campaigns.

We do not allow spam backlinks, mass-produced AI articles, duplicate city pages, or guaranteed-ranking claims.

Schedule

Approximately 25 hours per week. Some Eastern Time availability is required.

To Apply

Please answer:

1. Describe two local SEO projects and the measurable results.
2. Have you worked with a real estate-investor marketing agency? What did you personally manage?
3. How would you evaluate and consolidate two websites targeting similar keywords?
4. Which parts can you implement yourself, and which require a developer?
5. What are your hourly rate and weekly availability?

Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid two-hour website assessment.

description:
** If you send me an automated ChatGPT response I will not respond.**

We are launching a new DTC cleaning company (think liquid death for cleaning) and need a packaging designer to help take our existing concepts across the finish line. Looking for someone who loves and lives in this world (Packaging, colors, typography, etc).

Our creative director has developed the brand direction and packaging mockups. We are ~70% complete and need someone to refine the designs and make them print-ready.

Scope:
- Finalize 3 SKUs (1 bottle + 2 jugs)
- Clean up artwork and prepare production files
- Make final design adjustments as needed

Looking for someone with:
- CPG packaging experience (Ideally in modern- clean brands)
- Strong label design + print production skills
- Experience with physical products (not just logos/branding)
Ability to move quickly (target: next week)

This is not a blank slate project — the creative direction is already established. We need someone who can execute and polish.

If we work well together, there will be ongoing opportunities as we continue building the brand.

Please send relevant packaging examples. Work will need to be completed this week!!

title: Lift medical healthcare data sharing restriction from Meta advertising
description:
PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE YOU RESPOND. We’ve been experiencing data issues with our pixel on Meta Ads for quite some time now. We sell electric breast pumps on our online store in the Netherlands, and Meta has imposed data restrictions on us because they believe we fall under the “Medical and Healthcare” category.

We previously found a solution by using mapping to continue tracking data. Now, our pixel and domain are completely blocked, and mapping no longer works either. 

Solution
- We need someone who can advise us on what to change on the website so that Meta no longer classifies us under that category.
- We need a new workaround that will allow us to track data.

title: Script Writer for Cartoon Channel
description:
I’m looking for a talented script writer to help me build a YouTube channel focused on fun, entertaining deep-dive videos about animated shows and cartoons.

The channel will cover shows like The Simpsons, SpongeBob, Family Guy, Rick & Morty, and more. The goal is to create engaging, story-driven videos that keep viewers interested from the opening hook to the end.

What you'll be doing:

* Researching interesting topics, controversies, hidden details, and lesser-known stories
* Writing scripts for ~20-minute YouTube videos
* Creating strong hooks and maintaining curiosity throughout
* Turning research into an entertaining story rather than simply listing facts
* Writing naturally for voiceover with strong pacing and transitions
* Fact-checking information and using reliable sources

What I’m looking for:

* Experience writing YouTube scripts
* Strong research and storytelling skills
* Understanding of viewer retention
* A conversational, entertaining writing style
* Experience with entertainment, commentary, or deep-dive content is a plus

To apply, please send:

* Examples of your previous work
* Your rate
* Typical turnaround time
* Your availability

Budget: $50 per 20 minute script to start, with the opportunity for higher rates based on quality and a successful long-term working relationship.

I’m looking for someone interested in working with me long-term as the channel grows.

title: French Proofreader for AI-Translated Reflective Book
description:
I’m looking for a native French speaker, or someone with an excellent command of French, to complete the final proofreading of the French version of my book.

The book is a collection of emotional and reflective texts about relationships, personal growth, family, grief, self-worth, boundaries, and everyday life. It contains approximately 26,000 words.

The French version has already been translated using AI. This is not a translation project: I only need a final human check to correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, unnatural expressions, and any sentences that may sound too literal or not fluent in French.

I’m Italian, so it would be a big plus if you also understand Italian. A full comparison with the Italian manuscript is not required, but if any French sentence is unclear, I can provide the original Italian text for clarification.

I would like to receive the PDF back with corrections marked directly on the file, using highlights and comments/annotations. The original text should remain visible, and the suggested correction should be written in the comment, so I can easily apply the changes to my final file.

**Budget:** €20 fixed price.

Please include:

• Your native language and level of French
• Your level of Italian, if applicable
• Relevant proofreading or editing experience
• Estimated delivery time
• Confirmation that you can return the PDF with comments/annotations directly on the file

I regularly publish books in different languages and I’m looking for a reliable person for future French proofreading projects as well.

title: Bilingual Executive Assistant GoHighLevel, AI & Social Media
description:
Bilingual Executive Assistant – GoHighLevel, AI & Social Media

English & Spanish | Remote | Long-Term Position | Monthly Retainer + Performance Bonuses

About the Position

We are looking for a highly motivated, organized, and tech-savvy Bilingual Executive Assistant to join our growing company.

This is not a traditional administrative assistant position.

We are looking for someone who can become a key member of our team and assist company leadership while also helping manage GoHighLevel, AI tools, social media marketing, content creation, lead follow-up, and day-to-day business operations.

The ideal candidate speaks English and Spanish fluently, communicates professionally, takes initiative, learns quickly, and is comfortable wearing multiple hats.

This is a long-term opportunity with a base salary plus performance bonuses for someone who wants to grow with the company.

Main Responsibilities

Executive & Administrative Assistance

* Assist company leadership with daily tasks and projects
* Organize priorities and follow up on assignments
* Conduct online research
* Organize documents and information
* Help coordinate appointments and schedules
* Communicate professionally with clients and prospects
* Make and receive occasional business calls
* Follow up with leads and customers
* Help ensure important tasks don't fall through the cracks

GoHighLevel & CRM

You should have experience with GoHighLevel or be highly capable of learning advanced features quickly.

Responsibilities may include:

* Managing contacts and opportunities
* Updating sales pipelines
* Creating and managing workflows
* SMS and email automation
* Email marketing campaigns
* Forms and surveys
* Calendars and appointment scheduling
* Lead nurturing campaigns
* Follow-up sequences
* CRM organization
* Social Planner
* Reporting
* AI Agents
* Monitoring and improving automations

AI & Automation

We want someone who is comfortable using AI as part of their daily work.

Experience with tools such as:

* ChatGPT
* GoHighLevel AI
* AI Agents
* Canva AI
* CapCut AI
* Zapier
* Make.com
* Other modern AI and automation tools

You should be willing to continuously learn new AI technologies as they become available.

Social Media Marketing

Help manage and grow our social media presence across platforms such as:

* Instagram
* Facebook
* TikTok
* LinkedIn
* YouTube

Responsibilities may include:

* Developing organic growth strategies
* Creating content calendars
* Scheduling and publishing content
* Writing captions
* Creating graphics
* Creating Reels and Shorts
* Basic video editing
* Community engagement
* Responding to comments and messages
* Repurposing existing content
* Researching trends and content ideas
* Tracking performance
* Turning social media attention into leads and appointments

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate has:

Fluent English and Spanish
* Excellent spoken English
* Professional phone communication
* GoHighLevel experience
* Social media management experience
* Canva experience
* Basic to intermediate video editing skills
* Experience with CapCut or similar software
* Strong knowledge of ChatGPT and AI tools
* CRM experience
* Excellent organization
* Attention to detail
* Strong written communication
* Reliable internet
* Quiet professional workspace
* Ability to work independently
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities

The Type of Person We Want

We're looking for someone who takes initiative.

We don't want someone who always waits to be told exactly what to do.

We want someone who can look at a situation and say:

I see an opportunity to improve this. Here's what I recommend we do.

You should be comfortable researching solutions, learning new technology, suggesting ideas, and helping us improve the company.

Social Media Growth Mindset

We're not looking for someone who simply posts content.

We want someone who understands:

CONTENT → ATTENTION → ENGAGEMENT → LEADS → FOLLOW-UP → APPOINTMENTS → SALES

Your goal will be to help turn our social media presence into measurable business growth.

Compensation

Base Salary + Performance Bonuses

This position includes a stable base salary with opportunities to earn additional bonuses based on performance, results, initiative, and contribution to company growth.

There is also an opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation as the company grows.

Schedule

This is a remote position.

Candidates must be able to work and communicate during agreed-upon hours that overlap with California / Pacific Time business hours.

To Apply

Please include the following:

1. Tell us about your experience as an Executive or Virtual Assistant.
2. Describe your GoHighLevel experience.
3. What can you currently do inside GoHighLevel without assistance?
4. Tell us about social media accounts you have managed.
5. Send examples of social media content or videos you personally created.
6. What experience do you have with Canva and CapCut?
7. Which AI tools do you currently use?
8. Are you comfortable making and receiving business calls in both English and Spanish?
9. What would you do to help a company grow organically on social media?
10. What hours are you available to work in Pacific Time?
11. What monthly base salary are you seeking?

Please begin your application with the words:

BILINGUAL GROWTH ASSISTANT

Applications that do not include this phrase may not be considered.

Long-Term Opportunity

We are looking for more than a freelancer who completes individual tasks.

We want someone who can become a trusted long-term member of our team, learn our business, help leadership stay organized, improve our systems, assist our clients, grow our social media presence, and take on greater responsibility as the company grows.

If you are bilingual, organized, proactive, comfortable with technology, experienced with GoHighLevel and social media, and excited about AI and business growth, we would like to hear from you.

title: Full-Cycle B2B Sales Representative | AI Startup
description:
SPYL is an Israeli technology startup that has developed a unique AI-powered real-time translation and communication platform for businesses and organizations.

Our technology helps organizations communicate instantly with customers who speak different languages. We are currently entering the market and beginning commercial pilots.

We are looking for a hungry, independent B2B salesperson to help us build our US customer base.

This is a full-cycle sales role. You will not simply receive leads or book meetings. You will own opportunities from prospecting through closing.

Your responsibilities:

• Research and identify potential B2B customers in the US
• Build prospect lists and find the right decision-makers
• Cold call, email and conduct outbound outreach
• Follow up consistently with prospects
• Schedule and conduct online product demonstrations
• Handle objections and negotiate with prospects
• Close pilots and paying customers
• Coordinate with our Operations team during onboarding and implementation
• Maintain the relationship with customers you bring in
• Keep the sales pipeline and activity properly documented

Compensation:

• $5/hour guaranteed base pay
• $30 bonus for each qualified pilot that is approved and actually starts
• 5% commission on payments received from every customer you successfully close, for the first 6 months of the customer relationship
• Uncapped commissions, the more business you generate, the more you earn

The hourly rate provides a guaranteed base, while the main earning potential comes from successfully converting opportunities into paying customers and building recurring business.

Because SPYL operates on a recurring B2B model, successful sales can continue generating commission for you for up to 6 months after closing.

What we're looking for:

• Excellent spoken and written English
• Previous B2B sales experience
• Strong cold calling and outbound prospecting ability
• Experience reaching business owners and decision-makers
• Confidence presenting products over Zoom/Google Meet
• Ability to handle the full sales cycle and close deals
• Self-motivated, persistent and comfortable working independently
• Experience selling technology, SaaS, hospitality or healthcare solutions is a strong advantage
• Previous experience selling into the US market is strongly preferred

Schedule:

• 5 days per week
• Approximately 40 hours per week
• Must be available during US business hours
• Fully remote

We will begin with a one-month paid trial. Strong performers will have the opportunity to continue long-term and take on greater responsibility as SPYL expands.
