description:
We’re looking for an experienced Meta Media Buyer to manage and optimize Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with lead generation, campaign optimization, creative testing, and scaling profitable campaigns.

Responsibilities

* Set up and manage Meta ad campaigns
* Monitor daily performance and optimize campaigns
* Test different audiences, creatives, copy, and offers
* Reduce CPL/CPA while maintaining lead quality
* Identify and pause underperforming ads and ad sets
* Scale winning campaigns strategically
* Monitor key metrics including CTR, CPC, CPM, CPL, CPA, and ROAS
* Analyze campaign data and provide actionable recommendations
* Ensure proper Pixel, CAPI, and conversion tracking
* Prepare regular performance reports

Requirements

* 2+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience
* Strong understanding of Facebook Ads Manager
* Experience with lead generation campaigns
* Proven experience with creative and audience testing
* Strong analytical and optimization skills
* Ability to manage campaigns independently
* Good communication and reporting skills

To apply: Please share examples of Meta campaigns you have managed, the industries you have worked with, and your approach to reducing CPL and scaling winning campaigns.

title: Freelance Illustrator Wanted - Children’s Picture Book
description:
About the Project
I’m a first-time children’s book author working on a read-aloud picture book for ages 3–6. The story follows an animal narrator guiding young readers through the exciting (and sometimes nerve-wracking) transition of starting Kindergarten or school — reimagined as an adventure through a vibrant fantasy kingdom. I’m looking for a talented freelance illustrator to bring this world to life.
The Book
	•	Audience: Ages 3–6, read-aloud format (parents/caregivers reading to child)
	•	Theme: Easing the transition to starting school, told through a gentle fantasy adventure
	•	Narrator: An animal character who guides the reader through the kingdom
	•	Setting: A whimsical fantasy kingdom
	•	Cast: Diverse, POC main and supporting characters
	•	Tone: Warm, reassuring, playful — comforting for a nervous child, engaging for a read-aloud
What I’m Looking For

title: Packaging Design Recreate From Image
description:
We are looking for a skilled *Packaging Designer* to recreate a professional food packaging design from a provided reference image. The goal is to accurately reproduce the overall visual style, layout, branding, typography, product imagery, colors, and packaging structure while maintaining a clean and realistic final appearance.

### Key Responsibilities

* Recreate the packaging design accurately from the provided reference image.
* Match the original *layout, colors, typography, branding, graphics, and visual hierarchy*.
* Recreate or enhance product images so they look realistic, attractive, and suitable for commercial packaging.
* Maintain accurate proportions, spacing, alignment, shadows, highlights, and other visual details.
* Reproduce packaging elements such as the *pouch shape, sealed edges, folds, reflections, and realistic material appearance*.
* Ensure the brand logo, product name, flavor text, food imagery, chilies, and decorative elements are positioned professionally.
* Create a polished design that looks as close as possible to the supplied reference while maintaining high visual quality.
* Make revisions according to feedback and deliver the final artwork in production-ready quality.

### Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of *Adobe Illustrator and Adobe Photoshop*.
* Experience in *food packaging, snack packaging, pouch design, and FMCG branding*.
* Excellent skills in typography, composition, color matching, image editing, and retouching.
* Ability to recreate designs accurately from reference images.
* Strong understanding of realistic product presentation, shadows, lighting, and packaging effects.
* Knowledge of *CMYK, bleed, resolution, dielines, and print-ready artwork*.
* High attention to detail and ability to deliver professional commercial designs.

### Final Deliverables

* High-resolution final packaging artwork.
* Print-ready file in the required dimensions.
* Editable source file such as *AI/PSD*.
* Realistic packaging mockup for presentation, if required.

title: Wix Studio E-commerce Designer & CRO Specialist
description:
# Wix Studio E-commerce Designer & CRO Specialist — Premium Hair/Beauty Brand

**Project-based | Remote | Potential Ongoing Work**

## About the Project

We are a UK-based premium hair and beauty brand preparing for a significant stage of e-commerce growth and international expansion.

Our ambition is to build a **high-end international hair brand** with a digital presence that feels elevated, editorial, modern and commercially strong.

Our Wix website is already in development and we have established the overall brand direction, content, products and visual positioning.

We are now looking for an experienced **Wix Studio E-commerce Designer with strong UX/CRO knowledge** to take the website to a professional international DTC standard.

This is **not simply a website beautification project**.

The website needs to achieve two things:

**1. Present the brand at a premium/luxury level.**
**2. Convert visitors into paying customers.**

We therefore want someone who understands both **high-end design and e-commerce conversion**.

---

# Brand Direction

The desired aesthetic is:

* Premium
* Luxury
* Editorial
* Minimal
* Modern
* Sophisticated
* International
* Image-led
* Clean and intentional

The website should feel like a **premium hair/fashion/beauty brand**, rather than a traditional local salon website.

We do not want:

* Overly busy layouts
* Generic Wix templates
* Excessive animations
* Cheap-looking sales graphics
* Too many colours
* Cluttered product pages
* A traditional salon aesthetic

Strong experience designing websites for **beauty, hair, skincare, cosmetics, fashion, jewellery or premium DTC brands** is highly desirable.

---

# E-commerce Offering

The website will sell premium hair products including:

* Wigs
* Hair bundles
* Frontals
* Other hair products/collections

The wider brand also provides professional hair artistry, bridal services and education.

However, the website should position the business first and foremost as a **premium hair brand**, rather than making it appear to be simply a salon that also sells products.

The product/e-commerce experience is therefore extremely important.

---

# Scope of Work

## 1. Existing Website Audit

Before redesigning anything, we want you to review the existing Wix website and identify:

* Design inconsistencies
* UX problems
* Conversion barriers
* Navigation issues
* Mobile problems
* Product-page weaknesses
* Trust issues
* Customer journey problems
* Unnecessary sections
* Missing e-commerce elements

We want thoughtful recommendations rather than immediately replacing everything.

---

# 2. Homepage

Refine/rebuild the homepage to create a strong premium customer journey.

Potential sections include:

* Hero
* Brand introduction
* Featured collections
* Wigs
* Bundles
* Frontals
* Brand philosophy/story
* Hair artistry/services
* Bridal
* Education
* Social proof
* Reviews
* Editorial imagery
* Email capture
* Strong CTAs

The final structure should be determined based on **UX and conversion strategy**, rather than simply including every possible section.

---

# 3. E-commerce Experience

Build/refine the shopping experience across:

* Shop
* Collections
* Product categories
* Product pages
* Cart

title: Chief of Staff - Strong EA - Ops Manager (AI Native - Right hand to CEO)
description:
AI-Native Executive Assistant / Chief of Staff to Founder

This role is ideal for an exceptional Executive Assistant with Chief of Staff experience who is highly capable with AI.

Compensation will reflect your demonstrated strength across executive support, operations, management, accountability, judgment, and AI execution.

The Role

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position. It is a high-ownership role supporting the founder of a fast-moving group of businesses.

The work is varied by nature. On any given day, you may be:

• Managing the founder’s inbox, priorities, calendar, and follow-ups
• Resolving an operational issue between departments
• Chasing a lender, insurance company, vendor, lawyer, or director
• Reviewing a contract, claim, compliance issue, or financial analysis
• Holding a manager accountable for a missed commitment
• Mediating between directors or aligning teams around a decision
• Translating sales requirements into clear actions for operations or support
• Running management meetings and ensuring decisions are executed
• Using AI to investigate an issue, develop a solution, complete the work, and monitor the outcome

That is the reality of supporting a founder across several growing businesses. I would rather explain it clearly now than have you discover it during your third week.

The Situation

I own several separate legal entities across home services, energy, consumer financing, real estate, and short-term rentals in Canada and Florida.

I have directors responsible for sales, operations, funding, and finance, along with external developers and professional advisors.

Right now, too many questions, arguments, approvals, and status updates come directly to me. My directors often report upward instead of resolving matters with one another. I have effectively become the routing layer for my own businesses, which is an excellent way to remain busy and a terrible way to scale.

Your job is to replace me as that routing layer.

You will decide what I never need to see, close matters that do not require me, and bring me only the issues that genuinely need the founder’s judgment. When you escalate something, I expect a concise explanation, viable options, and your recommendation. I do not want forwarded threads followed by “What do you think?”

The objective is simple: I want my time back.

What Success Looks Like

You must integrate quickly, immerse yourself in the businesses, and learn how I think, communicate, prioritize, and make decisions.

Everything in my inbox and much of my daily work will eventually flow through you. After the initial training period, you should be capable of handling approximately 80% of incoming matters without requiring my direct involvement.

You will use AI to review historical emails, understand how similar matters were handled, identify patterns in my decision-making, and accelerate your own learning. You will receive training, but you must also be highly self-directed.

I am not looking for another helper whom I need to organize, remind, and manage. That would create more work for me, not less.

I need a right-hand person who takes ownership, closes loops, follows through relentlessly, and brings order to complexity.

AI Capability Is Essential

AI will be one of the most heavily valued skills in this position.

I use AI extensively myself. I am not looking for someone who copies emails into a chatbot, produces a summary, and sends the problem back to me. I can already do that.

I need someone who uses AI to multiply their own output and complete real work.

For example, if a complicated legal email arrives and you do not initially understand it, you should be able to use AI to:

1. Review the entire related email history and supporting documents
2. Reconstruct the facts and timeline
3. Identify the decision, risk, deadline, and responsible parties
4. Research or verify what is required
5. Develop a practical recommendation
6. Draft the necessary communications or action plan
7. Coordinate the people involved
8. Monitor the matter until the required outcome is confirmed

The same approach applies to insurance, compliance, operations, management, contracts, and financial analysis.

Experience creating lightweight AI agents, automated workflows, scheduled processes, triggered tasks, or repeatable AI-assisted systems will add substantial value. I am particularly interested in examples where AI produced a real output or completed a workflow without requiring you to watch it continuously.

I already have people who build larger systems. What I need from you is force multiplication in your own work, combined with the judgment to recognize what AI should never decide or handle independently.

Core Responsibilities

• Own the founder’s inbox, calendar, priorities, and follow-up system
• Triage incoming issues and determine what requires the founder
• Resolve operational and administrative matters independently
• Coordinate directors, managers, external professionals, and vendors
• Run weekly management meetings and maintain clear accountability
• Track commitments, deadlines, decisions, and unresolved matters
• Identify when managers or departments are failing to communicate or execute
• Address performance issues directly and professionally
• Handle sensitive HR conversations, compensation requests, and internal disputes
• Review contracts, claims, correspondence, and financial information
• Prepare concise executive briefs with options and recommendations
• Use AI to investigate, execute, automate, and monitor work
• Ensure that acknowledged tasks are actually completed and verified
• Protect the founder’s time by preventing avoidable issues from reaching him

Who Will Succeed Here

You are likely a strong fit if you:

• Have worked as a senior Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, executive operations lead, or in a comparable high-ownership role
• Are exceptionally organized without becoming bureaucratic
• Exercise sound judgment with incomplete information
• Communicate directly, clearly, and professionally
• Can challenge directors and managers without creating unnecessary conflict
• Are comfortable handling confidential, financial, legal, HR, and operational matters
• Learn unfamiliar subjects quickly
• Take ownership without waiting for constant instructions
• Close loops instead of merely sending reminders
• Can distinguish between what is urgent, important, delegable, or irrelevant
• Are naturally proactive and regularly identify issues before being asked
• Use AI as an execution engine, not merely as a writing assistant
• Want one serious primary role, not another side engagement

Availability

title: Format Hindi-language book for IngramSpark and Amazon KDP (paperback and ebook)
description:
I.  Description:  This is the Hindi translation of the original English book, Warfare in the Spiritual Realms (published 2023).   A war is constantly raging between the holy angels and demon spirits who are seeking to influence and control your life. Warfare in the Spiritual Realms will teach you to recognize and resist the work of the enemy so that you can live victoriously.

This book is already published in English.  It has now been translated into Hindi.  I had previously hired someone to format the book. They did an adequate job overall.  However, it had some deficiencies.  The primary problem was the margins and gutters were not correct for a 5.5” x 8.5” size book.   Paragraphs were pushed into the white spaces.

Thus, I need a person who understands Adobe and Hindi and could adjust the margins so it would be acceptable to IngramSpark and other on-demand printing companies. I have attached a copy of the manuscript in pdf.  I have also attached a few screenshots which show examples on how the margins are off.    The book is approximately 315 pages. 

II.	Schedule

Contractor will comply with the following schedule:

a.	I need an initial draft within 3 weeks of acceptance of this project.  There should not be obvious margin or spacing errors, especially if it has been reviewed carefully. 
	
b. 	Once I receive your draft, I will review it and provide comments within 1 week.

c. 	Contractor will make any necessary changes and finalize the paperback formatted version within 1 week.

d.   	After the formatted paperback version is approved, contractor will convert it to E-Pub within an additional 1 week and provide a final product.

e.  	In summary, contractor will have 6 weeks from beginning to end. (3 + 1 +1 +1 = 6).

III.	Deliverables

 Contractor will provide the following deliverables:

a.   	Ready to upload to IngramSpark a pdf version (with margins, spacing, and gutters correct). Contractor will update page numbers in the Table of Contents for the paperback book if pages shift (because margins changed).

b.   	A Word version of the formatted paperback book (This is important because in the coming months or years slight changes may be made to the book and we want to make any changes in Word and quickly convert to pdf and upload 2nd edition).

c.   	E-Pub version.  Contractor must have experience with converting formatted manuscripts into E-Pub Version.   This includes having (1) logical / navigation Table of Contents NCX, and (2) visible Table of Contents at the beginning of the book not with page numbers, but with clickable links. Note – E-books do not have fixed page numbers. 


IV.	Payment

 	a.	Contractor will provide a proposed cost for project.

b.	 Contractor will be paid:

1/3 upon acceptance of project, 
1/3 upon final approval of Paperback portion (i.e., pdf and Word), and 
1/3 upon providing all deliverables.

title: Instagram Growth Strategy + 30-Day Content Plan + Meta Ads Review
description:
Instagram Growth Strategy + 30-Day Content Plan + Meta Ads Review

We are looking for an Instagram marketing specialist to review and improve the social media strategy for a small business.

The Instagram account is already active and has existing content, but posting has become inconsistent and we do not have a clear system for deciding what content to create, what formats to prioritise, or how to turn profile traffic into enquiries and customers.

This is a one-time strategy and optimisation project. We are not looking for ongoing daily social media management at this stage.

Scope of Work

The selected freelancer will review the current Instagram presence and provide practical recommendations covering:

- Instagram profile positioning
- Bio, CTA, highlights and profile structure
- Existing content mix and performance
- Reels and short-form video opportunities
- Engagement and reach patterns
- Audience positioning and messaging
- Content pillars
- Conversion opportunities from profile visits to enquiries
- Current Meta Ads structure and targeting
- Retargeting opportunities
- Basic KPI and performance tracking recommendations

Deliverables

The final project should include:

1. Instagram Account Audit

A clear review of:

- What is currently working
- What is underperforming
- Profile and positioning issues
- Content gaps
- Engagement opportunities
- Priority improvements

2. Profile Optimisation Recommendations

Recommendations for:

- Bio
- CTA
- Highlights
- Pinned content
- Link structure
- Overall first impression

3. 30-Day Content Strategy

Please provide:

- 3–5 core content pillars
- 30-day content calendar
- Recommended posting frequency
- Suggested balance between Reels, carousels, static posts and Stories
- 15+ specific content ideas

4. Reels Direction

Please provide at least:

- 8 Reels concepts
- Suggested hooks
- Basic storyline or structure for each
- CTA recommendations

The business will create the actual videos, so video editing is not required.

5. Meta Ads Review

Review our current or planned Meta Ads approach and provide recommendations on:

- Audience targeting
- Campaign structure
- Cold vs warm audiences
- Retargeting
- Creative direction
- Budget allocation
- Basic A/B testing ideas

This is primarily a strategic review rather than full campaign management.

6. KPI Tracking

Recommend the most useful KPIs to monitor over the next 30–60 days, such as:

- Reach
- Profile visits
- Engagement
- Saves
- Shares
- DM enquiries
- Cost per result
- Conversion-related metrics

What We Are Looking For

Someone who understands that Instagram growth is not simply about posting more content.

We want someone who can analyse the account, identify what is wasting effort, and build a practical system around content, audience behaviour and conversion.

Experience with small businesses, local brands, cafés, hospitality, boutiques, retail or service businesses would be especially useful.

Experience with both organic Instagram strategy and Meta Ads is preferred.

Use of AI tools for research and analysis is welcome, but the final recommendations must be specific to our business and account.

Budget

$150 fixed price

Timeline

Ideally completed within 4–5 days after receiving the necessary account information and analytics.

To Apply

Please answer the following briefly:

1. What are the first 3 things you look at when auditing an Instagram account?
2. How do you decide which content formats a small business should focus on?
3. How would you connect organic Instagram content with a small Meta Ads budget?
4. Please share one relevant Instagram strategy, content planning, local business or Meta Ads example from your previous work.

title: Marketing Consultant for Fashion Store
description:
## Marketing Consultant & Event Lead: Luxury Women’s Fashion (Calgary)
We are seeking a hands-on **Marketing Consultant & Event Lead** to anchor the launch of our new luxury women’s fashion boutique in Calgary.
You will not just be designing a strategy; you will be on the ground with us, providing end-to-end guidance from the initial marketing rollout through to the execution of our launch events. We need a partner who understands the nuances of the high-end female fashion market and knows exactly how to build, manage, and sustain the excitement required for a successful retail debut.
### Your Mission
You will serve as our lead strategist and operational partner. Your expertise will define our brand identity in the Calgary luxury scene, ensuring that our advertising reaches the right audience and our launch events provide a seamless, high-end experience that converts visitors into loyal clients.
### Core Objectives
| **Immediate** | **Brand Presence** | Develop a high-impact advertising strategy and drive targeted store traffic. |
| **Short-Term** | **Event Execution** | Hands-on coordination of a refined Soft Opening and a high-buzz Grand Opening. |
| **Long-Term** | **Loyalty & Growth** | Establish the brand as a premier destination in the Calgary women’s luxury retail space. |
### Scope of Work
 * **Strategic Advertising:** Create and execute a 6-month advertising roadmap, specifically tailored to the luxury female fashion consumer.
 * **End-to-End Event Management:** Provide comprehensive, on-site guidance and coordination for our launch events:
   * *Soft Opening:* A curated, feedback-driven event to refine our customer service and store flow.
   * *Grand Opening:* A high-visibility, buzz-generating event designed to establish brand authority and social media presence.
 * **Influencer & Media Outreach:** Identify and manage strategic partnerships with local Calgary fashion influencers and lifestyle media to build authentic, high-end brand associations.
 * **Personalized Engagement:** Design a "white-glove" customer experience strategy that fosters long-term brand loyalty.
### Who You Are
 * **Fashion Industry Expert:** You have deep, verifiable experience specifically within the **women’s fashion and clothing sector**.
 * **Hands-On Partner:** You are comfortable being "in the trenches." You provide high-level strategy but are equally adept at managing the operational details of event production and advertising execution.
 * **Local Network:** You possess an existing, high-quality network of Calgary-based fashion influencers and luxury retail stakeholders.
 * **Results-Driven:** You are focused on measurable outcomes: foot traffic, event attendance, and customer acquisition.
**Ready to help us define the future of luxury women's fashion in Calgary?**
Please submit your portfolio and a summary of your experience in the fashion retail sector. We are particularly interested in seeing examples of your past work regarding event management and how you have successfully navigated a brand launch.

title: Webflow UX Auditor — Bilingual (EN/ES) Wireframe Review for Health Membership Site
description:
Description:

I need a UX/Webflow specialist to audit Figma wireframes for a bilingual health membership site (English/Spanish) built on Webflow + Memberstack. This is a screen-share review only — I will not be sharing the Figma link directly.

The site: A longevity education platform for adults 45+ with tiered membership gating, a Nutritional Reference Library (CMS), Articles (CMS), Video Library, and full Spanish localization via Webflow Localization.

What I need from you:

Screen-share review of the Figma wireframes with me (30–60 min)
Written assessment of what is missing or incomplete by industry standards
Join a follow-up call with my design team as my technical advisor (you will articulate findings directly to them)
Critical — you must have experience with:

Webflow Localization (not Google Translate plugins — the native Localization feature with /es URL structures, locale switching, and CMS-level translation workflows)
Memberstack membership gating (element-level hiding, preview/gating logic, tier-based access)
CMS filter systems in Webflow (category-based filtering for collections like Articles and Foods)
Mobile interaction states (hamburger menu open/close, accordions, stacked reflows — not just scaled-down desktop views)
Hispanic/Latino market UX — I specifically need someone who understands that Spanish localization is not just translation. It includes cultural adaptation, tone adjustment, and layout accommodation for text expansion (Spanish runs 20–30% longer than English). If you have worked on sites targeting the Hispanic community, tell me about it.
The core dispute I need you to assess:

My developer claims that language toggle placement, /es URL flow visualization, CMS filter bars, and distinct mobile interaction states are "design decisions" that do not belong in low-fidelity wireframes. I disagree. I need a professional verdict on whether these are structural wireframe elements or purely visual design choices.

To apply, answer these two questions:

Provide 2–3 live links to Webflow sites you have built or audited that include Memberstack gating AND bilingual/multilingual setup.
Beyond technical implementation, how do you approach UX for a bilingual site targeting the Hispanic community? Specifically: How do you handle content expansion in wireframes? Have you adapted tone or imagery for a Hispanic audience? Do you have native Spanish speakers you consult for cultural review?
Timeline: I need this completed within 3–5 days of hiring.

If this works out there could be more work if you are interested

title: Elegant Video Editor & Instagram Content Designer (Minimalist, Conscious Aesthetic)
description:
I am seeking an artistic, detail-oriented Video Editor and Visual Designer to handle the end-to-end production of my Instagram content and grid curation. I will provide the raw footage.

This project is dedicated to inspiring consciousness and awakening leaders. I need a creative partner with an intuitive eye for minimalist, elegant aesthetics who understands how to evoke a sense of calm, depth, and grounding through visuals. 

You will also plan my grid layout strategy so my profile feed feels beautifully curated, intentional, and sanctuary-like.

This is an ongoing monthly collaboration. The listed budget reflects the first month of content (~12-13 posts based on 3 posts per week, plus 2 Story template uses); future months will continue as separate milestones at the same rate, based on how our work together goes.

Responsibilities:
Grid Layout Strategy: Plan the visual flow of my Instagram grid. Map out how the covers look side-by-side to ensure a cohesive, balanced, and sophisticated feed before anything is published.

Thumbnail & Cover Design: Adapt pieces from my existing library of website graphics into vertical Instagram covers. Moving forward, you will design new covers. Note: AI image generation is accepted as a tool, provided the output looks organic, natural, or abstract—strictly avoiding hyper-polished, synthetic, or cartoonish styles.

Typography: Add high-end, elegant typography (e.g., serif and clean sans-serif styles) to all covers and carousels, ensuring excellent use of negative space.

Video Editing (Reels): Edit clean, elegant Reels with minimalist captions, intentional breathing room, and smooth, organic pacing. No loud or hyper-active YouTube/TikTok style editing. Craft an engaging opening moment that draws viewers in within the first few seconds,  without relying on loud, jarring, or attention-grabbing tactics. The hook should feel intentional and elegant, not abrupt. 
Note: I record using a teleprompter, so the spoken content is already scripted and delivered cleanly -  no restructuring narration, reworking pacing of speech, or cutting filler words/stumbles is needed.

Visual Enhancements: Layer subtle atmospheric music (ambient, cinematic, or acoustic) and weave in slow-paced, natural B-roll footage to gracefully support the narration.

Carousels: Design modern, multi-slide carousel posts using spacious layouts and plenty of "breathing room" for complex philosophical ideas.

Story Template Design: Design a 3-page Instagram Story template in the same minimalist, elegant style as the rest of the feed. This template will be reused twice per month, with the text/copy updated for each use.

Podcast-to-Reel Conversion: Transform selected audio clips from podcast episodes into polished, visually engaging Reels — pairing the audio with slow-paced, grounding B-roll that reflects and supports what's being said, layered with elegant typographic pull-quotes, so each clip feels as calm, sanctuary-like, and intentional as the rest of the feed. Note: podcast episodes occur here and there rather than on a fixed schedule, and will replace a scripted Reel that week rather than adding to the workload. This skill is required for ongoing work, but there are no podcast episodes to convert in the first month.

Requirements:
A portfolio that demonstrates a strong eye for minimalist, clean, organic, or editorial styles across video editing and graphic layout — including experience turning short audio clips (from podcasts or interviews) into short-form video content.

A good understanding of elegant typography and the use of white/negative space.

An appreciation for, or understanding of, the personal growth, mindfulness, or conscious leadership space is a massive plus.

To Apply: Please share a link to your portfolio or attach examples of Instagram feeds, Reels, Carousels, or podcast-to-video edits you have designed that showcase a calm, elegant, minimalist style. Please mention your favorite style of ambient music or visual aesthetic in your first sentence so I know you read this brief.

title: DTC Ecommerce Growth Marketer (Shopify / K-Beauty) – Unit Economics & CRO Audit
description:
Job Description:

Bloomea (bloomea.gr) is a Korean skincare (K-Beauty) store on Shopify serving Greece and Cyprus (~600 SKUs, 50+ brands). We have clean data, fast decision-making, and fulfill from our own stock.

Current Stats:

• Traffic: ~9,000 sessions/month

• Orders: ~200 orders/month

• AOV: ~€35

• Gross Margin: ~35-40% (~€12.25 to €14.00 gross margin / order)

• Blended CPA: ~€11.00 (eating almost all gross margin on first-order acquisition before fulfillment costs)

• Checkout Drop-off: 56% (468 reached checkout to 205 completed)

• Repeat Customer Rate: ~8%

The Problem:

Traffic is solid and our margins are healthy at 35-40%, but our low AOV and checkout leakage keep net contribution margins razor-thin on first purchases. We need a sharp DTC marketer to help us fix conversion, raise AOV (bundling/upsells), and structure retention.

The Engagement:

• Phase 1 (Audit & Action Plan): Review our setup (Shopify, Meta/Google ads, email retention flows) and deliver a prioritized 90-day execution roadmap.

• Phase 2 (Ongoing Growth): If Phase 1 delivers clear value, transition to ongoing management (campaigns, retention, CRO).

How to Apply:

Start your proposal with the word "BLOOM" to show you read this. Please answer these 5 questions directly (generic AI proposals will be skipped):

Share one DTC store you scaled: Starting metrics, what exact levers you pulled, and the numerical result.

With our CPA (€11) absorbing almost all gross profit on a €35 order, what is the very first lever you would optimize to unlock immediate net profit, and why?

More than half our users drop off at checkout (56%). What are the 3 most common causes you see on Shopify?

With a small ad budget, what would you spend the first €1,000 on?

What is your flat rate for Phase 1 (Audit), and your ongoing monthly rate for Phase 2?

title: 2D Animator / Motion Designer
description:
2D Animator / Motion Designer

****MUST READ AND COMPLY BEFORE YOU APPLY****
- Due to client compliance requirements, applicants must be in CANADA, USA, OR EUROPE 
- Applicants must be solo freelance professionals - NO AGENCIES or subcontracting arrangements.
- Apply through Upwork only. Calls, emails, LinkedIn messages, or contact through any other social media or channel will result in immediate disqualification.
- You must provide a portfolio with samples of your own 2D animation and motion-design work. Please identify your role in any work involving a larger production team.
- Professional experience is required. This is not an entry-level position.
- Provide your expected monthly salary/compensation in your application.
- You must be available full-time, 35–40 hours per week for approximately one year.

MDR Strategy Group is seeking an experienced 2D Animator / Motion Designer to join our team for approximately one year.

We produce short-form animated videos that translate information into clear, engaging visual communications. The successful candidate will take projects from approved script through storyboarding, presentation of the creative concept, animation, and final production.

DUTIES AND RESONSIBILITIES

- Develop professional storyboards for each project.
- Present storyboards and creative concepts to our team and clients.
- Translate scripts and voiceovers into compelling visual narratives.
- Produce polished 2D animation and motion graphics.
- Combine animation, typography, illustration, voiceover, music, and sound into finished videos.
- Create and animate illustrations, icons, characters, graphics, and transitions.
- Incorporate feedback and revisions efficiently.
- Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
- Conduct detailed quality-control reviews before delivery.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This is a demanding, fast-paced production role. We are looking for someone who can work quickly while maintaining exceptional standards for accuracy, detail, creativity, and production excellence. Speed cannot come at the expense of quality.

You should have significant professional experience in 2D animation and motion design, excellent storyboarding and visual storytelling skills, and advanced proficiency with Adobe After Effects and related professional design and editing software.

You must also be comfortable presenting your creative thinking, receiving direction, and working collaboratively with a professional communications team.

TO APPLY

Please submit through Upwork:

- Your resume and a brief introduction.
- A portfolio/reel containing your own relevant work.
- Examples of storyboards or visual treatments, if available.
- Your expected monthly salary/compensation for a 35–40 hour-per-week engagement.

Applications without relevant work samples or monthly compensation expectations will not be considered.

title: Mechanical Engineer + CAD/Prototyping — Field Soil-Sampling Mechanism (Concept → Working Prototype)
description:
We're a product design and manufacturing firm developing a field-deployable soil-sampling mechanism for an ag-tech client. We need a mechanical engineer (with CAD/design support, whether that's you or a paired resource) to take this from concept through a working benchtop prototype.

The device mounts to the rear of an ATV/UTV and, as it drives, collects and filters a soil sample at a set interval — engaging the ground, pulling a sample across a target depth band, rejecting rocks and roots, and breaking up clods. Think a small, ground-engaging mechanical implement, drawing on familiar ag equipment (aerator-style coring vs. seed-drill/coulter-style furrowing are the two candidate approaches).

This is not a rendering exercise. The deliverable has to physically work. We care about mechanisms that can actually be built and function when assembled — not CAD that looks good but was never validated.

Scope (two phases):

Phase 1 — Concept (~4 weeks): Generate 3–5 distinct mechanical concepts across both approaches, with feasibility, trade-offs, and rough study models. We down-select one together.
Phase 2 — Functional Prototype (~6–8 weeks): Develop the chosen concept into a working benchtop prototype (3D-printed and/or machined parts) that demonstrates the mechanism. Real build-and-test iteration. We can support fabrication (in-house and via overseas 3D printing/machining), so your files must be genuinely build-ready — proper tolerances, fits, and DFM.

description:
Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy Consultant
4 week engagement  /  75% to 100% of time  /  Mid Sept to Mid Oct, 2026  /  Fully Remote

THE COMPANY

This staffing leader has a unique problem. Retention is strong, delivery works, revenue north of $20M. The Co-Founders are targeting $100M in 3 years. What they don't have is a decision about how to acquire customers at that scale.

They place exceptional remote professionals inside U.S. SMB and Mid-Market businesses. Not gig workers ... these are dedicated people who become real members of a client’s team & stay 1+ years. Named to Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies 3 consecutive years. 

THE 4-WEEK ENGAGEMENT

An outside sales team experiment didn't work. Rather than hire another VP Sales & hope, the Co-Founders paused to figure out the right motion first. That's this engagement ... 4 weeks to settle the questions that determine where the next several million are invested.

What you'll recommend:
•	ICP. Confirm the customer profile & engagement economics (including how AI's commoditization of low-end marketplace work reshapes where the company should play.)
•	Channel. Outbound, inbound, marketing-led, or partnerships. Recommend a primary & secondary, defend with #s
•	Demand. Design the lead gen model that feeds the machine.
•	Referrals. Design a simple, effective client referral program

How you'll work: Secret-shop competitors from the buyer's seat; model the channel economics & capacity; review the Playbook used so far; meet the existing team. You report directly to the company’s Co-Founders. Your work becomes the operating plan for the permanent revenue leader who follows.

MUST-HAVES
•	Available to start mid Sept, 75% to 100% capacity, 4 straight weeks
•	Built GTM strategy for recurring-revenue B2B services business targeting SMB/Mid-Market (not Consumer/Enterprise)
•	Experience across sales, marketing, and partnerships (not depth in just 1)
•	Analytical mind, with a bit of modeling ... model before you recommend
•	Defined-scope engagements that ended in a decision, not only long-term operating roles
•	Willing to say that a channel won't work when the math says so
•	No conflicts with competing remote-talent or staffing businesses

Bonus: The engagement may convert to a full-time role if both parties agree.

title: Creative Canva Designer for Reusable Social Media Template System
description:
I’m looking for a creative Canva designer with a strong eye for social media design to create a custom, reusable template system for my brand.

This is a new creative direction, so I’m looking for original ideas and imagination — not existing Canva templates adapted to my colours and fonts.

What I need:
4 distinct carousel systems: photography-led, typography/text-led, existing character artwork, and a creative/editorial style
Reel covers
Instagram Stories
Quote/lifestyle posts
Educational/fact layouts
Announcement posts
CTA/closing slides

The carousels are particularly important. Each system should have several interchangeable slide layouts so posts can vary while remaining recognisable and consistent.

Everything must be fully editable and easy to reuse in Canva.

My goal is simple: open Canva, choose a template, add my copy/image and post.

I will provide brand guidelines, logo, colours, fonts and artwork.

When applying, please include examples of relevant social media/carousel work and your price for the complete project.

title: Brand Naming Strategist Needed for New UK Food Brand
description:
I’m developing a new UK food brand and need help creating a strong, distinctive and trademark-conscious brand name.

The brand will initially focus on indulgent cookies, with potential to expand into other baked goods and food products over time.

I want the naming direction to feel modern, playful, memorable and highly brandable similar in spirit to brands such as Crumbl, Pleese, Crumbz and SUGRD. I am not looking for generic bakery names.

I originally liked the name ONE MORE because of the psychology behind it: wanting just one more bite, indulgence, temptation and reward. However, the food space is crowded with similar names, so I now want a more distinctive and ownable direction while keeping that same emotional idea.

I’m looking for someone experienced in brand naming, verbal identity, naming strategy, competitor research and consumer/FMCG branding.

Deliverables should ideally include:

* a shortlist of strong, original name options
* strategic reasoning behind each name
* competitor/naming landscape research
* preliminary UK trademark, domain and social-handle screening
* recommendations on the strongest options for long-term brand growth

I do not want a long AI-generated list. I’m looking for thoughtful, strategic naming work.

Experience with food, hospitality, FMCG or consumer brands is a big plus.

title: Facebook Group & Social Community Marketing Specialist
description:
We operate several established supplement brands, and Mortgage Lending Company  and are looking for someone experienced in Facebook group and social community marketing.

The primary focus will be identifying and participating in relevant Facebook groups in the health, fitness, weight loss, wellness, real estate, and supplement spaces. We are also interested in opportunities across Instagram, TikTok, Youtube, X/Twitter, and other relevant online communities. (NOT REDDIT)

The goal is to become an active participant in these communities, identify conversations where our products are genuinely relevant, and create natural brand awareness without obvious spam or aggressive promotion. You MUST have established accounts on each platform. 

You should be experienced at:

Finding active, highly targeted groups and communities
Participating naturally and building account credibility
Identifying recommendation/product discussions
Introducing brands where appropriate
Starting relevant discussions that generate engagement
Finding similar opportunities across Instagram, TikTok, X, and other communities
Tracking which communities and conversations generate traffic or sales

Please provide examples of similar work and explain how you would approach this while avoiding spam and account bans.

This is an ongoing opportunity across multiple brands and products.

We need a QA Engineer to map, document, and build a regression pack for a mentoring platform. The work includes reviewing existing test coverage, identifying gaps, and creating a clear test plan for manual and API testing. You will also debug issues, validate fixes, and help improve overall test coverage. This is a part-time role for someone who can work independently, communicate clearly, and support a reliable testing process for a mentoring platform.

Requirements

--Proven experience doing exploratory testing on a product with little or no documentation
--Comfortable working across multiple permission roles and reasoning about what each role should and shouldn't be able to do
--Fluent with Chrome DevTools (Network tab, console) and Postman
--Able to read GraphQL queries, mutations, and responses and use them to localize a defect
--Clear, concise technical writing — the documentation you produce is a primary deliverable, not a by-product
--Experience structuring a regression suite by risk, not just by feature
--Reliable availability for the four weekly 9 AM ET standups

title: AI UGC Video Creator for Ads
description:
We're looking for an experienced AI UGC Video Creator / AI Video Editor to create realistic, engaging, and high-converting short-form video ads for our brands and products.

You should understand AI UGC, DTC advertising, eCommerce, direct-response marketing, performance creatives, and short-form storytelling, not just AI video generation.

The goal is simple: create videos that look real, stop the scroll, hold attention, and drive clicks and conversions.

What You'll Create
AI UGC Ads & UGC Product Reviews
TikTok & Meta Ads
Instagram Reels & YouTube Shorts
DTC & eCommerce Video Ads
AI Spokesperson & Avatar Videos
Product Demonstrations & Testimonials
AI Commercials & Promotional Videos
Direct-Response Video Ads
Responsibilities
Turn scripts, products, and briefs into realistic AI UGC videos.
Create natural AI actors, presenters, product scenes, and voiceovers.
Maintain realistic faces, hands, products, expressions, movement, and lip-sync.
Create strong hooks, storytelling, CTAs, captions, and sound design.
Produce multiple creative variations for A/B testing.
Optimize videos for TikTok, Meta, Instagram, and YouTube.
Deliver polished, conversion-focused creatives consistently.
Preferred Tools

Veo 3, Sora, Kling, Runway, Higgsfield, Seedance, HeyGen, Creatify, Arcads, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, Flux, ChatGPT, CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar.

Ideal Candidate

You have a strong portfolio of realistic AI UGC videos and video ads, understand modern social-media advertising, and know how to create scroll-stopping hooks, retention-focused edits, and conversion-driven creatives.

Long-term opportunity available for the right creator.

To Apply

Please send:

3–5 of your best AI UGC videos
Examples of TikTok, Meta, or DTC ads you've created
AI tools and editing software you use
Your turnaround time for a 30–60 second video

Start your proposal with “AI UGC CREATOR” so we know you've read the post.

Relevant AI UGC samples are required.

title: Marketing Operator (Part-Time, 2 hrs/day) — Local SEO + Gohighlevel
description:
READ THIS FIRST: THIS ROLE RUNS ON TORONTO BUSINESS HOURS.

We are in Toronto, Canada. Our clients are Canadian, so the work happens during Canadian business hours -- in most of Asia that means a late evening / night shift. Your 2-hour block sits between roughly 9 PM and 12 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday, and your training hour is 10-11 PM Manila. Plenty of people prefer this shift. But if it is not for you, please don't apply -- we would much rather you tell us now than discover it in week two.

WHAT WE DO
We are a small Canadian agency. We build websites, run Google Business Profiles, and generate leads for local trades and restaurants -- contractors, epoxy installers, renovators, restaurants. Real businesses with real phone numbers.

WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY DO
Six repeatable lanes. Each one has a written runbook, a checklist, and a recorded video walkthrough -- you are never guessing:

1. Audit a website -- an 8-point check on a client site, written up as a short report
2. Build a website -- from a filled brief, using our template stack
3. Test the lead forms -- submit a real test lead and confirm it lands in the database
4. Google Business Profile -- categories, services, photos, posts, reviews, citations
5. Missed-call text-back -- set up and verify the automation
6. Local SEO -- run our 60-day sprint checklist against a client's listing

THE ONE HABIT THAT MATTERS MOST
Every task you finish gets an evidence link -- a URL, a screenshot, a database row. "Done" without evidence does not count as done here. If that sounds fussy, it is the single thing that makes a remote team work.

TERMS -- ALL OF THEM, UP FRONT
- $7.00 USD/hour, 2 hours/day, Monday-Friday (10 hrs/week, about $300 USD/month)
- Weekly payment cycle
- You need: your own laptop, reliable internet, and a noise-cancelling headset
- Time is tracked; invoices must match tracked hours
- There is a written contractor agreement. You sign it before day one.
- We intend to move to direct contracting after the trial period, in compliance with Upwork's terms.

YOU'LL DO WELL HERE IF YOU
Write clear plain English, follow a checklist exactly, ask when you're unsure instead of guessing, and show your work without being chased.

YOU WILL NOT DO WELL HERE IF YOU
Need someone watching you, mark things done without proof, or go quiet when stuck.

EXPERIENCE
Genuinely optional. Every lane is documented and recorded. We would rather have someone careful and coachable than someone with five years of vague "digital marketing."

title: Python coder for Polymarket API Trading Bot
description:
1. Project Overview
I am seeking an experienced developer to build a specialized, fully automated trading bot exclusively for Polymarket professional tennis markets. The bot will focus on a high-volume “percentage-shaving” approach: identifying clear player dominance situations and executing a large number of small-edge trades (targeting roughly 2–3% net gains per trade after fees) that compound over time.
Scope is strictly limited: Polymarket only • Professional tennis only • High-volume small-percentage trades only • Python only • Must run natively on a new MacBook Pro (Apple Silicon / macOS). No other sports, no other prediction markets, and no large directional bets.
2. Core Trading Strategy
The primary edge is “percentage shaving” on high-probability outcomes when one player is clearly more dominant than the other.
Key Principles
•  High volume, small edges: Execute many trades per day/week aiming for consistent 2–3% net gains after fees and slippage. The goal is compounding through frequency rather than large single-trade returns.
•  Dominance filter: Only enter when one player shows clear superiority based on the data signals below. Avoid coin-flip or closely matched matches.
•  Percentage-shaving mechanics: Typically buy the high-probability side (e.g., 0.90–0.97 range) when the market underprices the dominant player relative to our model, or apply complementary complete-set / near-resolution logic where appropriate. Hold or exit according to predefined rules that lock small gains repeatedly.
•  Strict risk rules: Position sizing limits, daily loss caps, maximum exposure per match, and automatic kill switches are mandatory.
3. Data Requirements – Sofascore Integration
The bot must scrape or reliably ingest live and historical data from Sofascore.com (or equivalent public tennis data sources if Sofascore becomes restricted). Priority signals:
1.  UTR Disparity – Universal Tennis Rating difference between the two players. Larger gaps increase confidence in the dominant side.
2.  Serve Dominance – Metrics showing one player’s superior serving performance (hold percentage, aces, first-serve points won, etc.).
3.  Break-of-Serve Dominance – Ability to break the opponent’s serve (break points converted, return points won, etc.).
These three signals should be combined into a clear “dominance score” or set of filters that decide whether a match qualifies for entry and which side is favored. The developer should propose a clean, tunable implementation of this logic.
4. Technical Requirements
•  Language: Python only (no TypeScript or other languages).
•  Platform Compatibility (Critical): The bot must run natively on a new MacBook Pro (Apple Silicon M-series chips + current macOS). It should work out of the box with standard Python on macOS. Avoid any Windows-only or Linux-only dependencies.
•  Platform: Polymarket CLOB API only (official Python client preferred – current py-clob-client / V2 equivalents).
•  Markets: Professional tennis match markets exclusively (ATP, WTA, and relevant Challenger/ITF events that appear on Polymarket with sufficient liquidity).
•  Execution: Real-time WebSocket order-book monitoring, EIP-712 order signing, limit / FOK-style orders where beneficial, fill monitoring, and automatic cancellation of unfilled orders.
•  Data pipeline: Robust Sofascore scraping or API ingestion (with fallback handling if the site changes), rate-limit respect, and local caching.
•  Risk engine: Hard-coded or config-driven position size limits, daily loss limits, max concurrent matches, and emergency kill switch.
•  Modes: Full paper-trading / dry-run mode that uses live market data but places no real orders. Easy switch to live.
•  Logging & Alerts: Detailed trade logs, decision rationale (why a match was taken or skipped), and Telegram (or Discord) notifications for entries, exits, and errors.
•  Deployment: Must be able to run locally on a MacBook Pro. Optionally also deployable on a standard VPS (Ubuntu). Clear setup documentation and configuration via .env or simple config file.
5. Expected Deliverables
1.  Fully working Python source code with clean structure and comments that runs on macOS / MacBook Pro.
2.  Paper-trading mode that can run continuously against live Polymarket tennis markets.
3.  Configurable parameters for dominance thresholds, target price bands (e.g., 0.92–0.97), position sizing, and risk limits.
4.  Documentation: setup guide (including macOS / MacBook Pro instructions), strategy explanation, parameter reference, and how to switch from paper to live.
5.  Short video demonstrating the bot scanning markets, applying filters, and placing (or simulating) trades.
6. Important Notes for Developers
•  Security first: I will never share private keys. The bot must support paper mode and allow me to control the wallet / API credentials myself.
•  No guarantees requested: I understand markets are competitive. Focus on clean, reliable execution of the defined logic.
•  Start simple: Prefer a solid, well-tested core (dominance filters + percentage-shaving entries + risk controls) over overly complex AI.
•  Communication: Please confirm prior experience with Polymarket CLOB and with web scraping of sports data sites. Also confirm the bot will run cleanly on a new MacBook Pro (Apple Silicon).
7. Next Steps
If this project interests you, please reply with:
1.  A short summary of relevant experience (Polymarket / CLOB / tennis data / trading bots).
2.  Proposed tech stack and rough timeline (must be Python + MacBook Pro compatible).
3.  Estimated cost (fixed price preferred for the initial version).
4.  Any questions about the dominance signals or percentage-shaving rules.
Looking forward to working with a developer who can deliver a clean, reliable, and tightly scoped tennis percentage-shaving bot on Polymarket that runs natively on a MacBook Pro.
Thank you.

title: Experienced CAD Jewelry Designer & 3D Renderer
description:
About This Role:

We are seeking an experienced CAD designer with a strong background in fine jewelry and goldsmithing to create detailed 3D models and hyper-realistic renders for our luxury jewelry brand. You will be responsible for translating design concepts into production-ready CAD files and delivering photorealistic visualizations for presentations, marketing, and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities:

- Create detailed 3D CAD models of fine jewelry pieces (rings, earrings, necklaces, bracelets, etc.)
- Produce hyper-realistic renders suitable for e-commerce, lookbooks, and editorial use
- Manage stone specifications, dimensions, and gemstone placement with precision
- Develop technical drawings and specifications for manufacturing
- Collaborate on design refinements and iterations
- Ensure all files are optimized for 3D printing, CNC cutting, and casting
- Maintain detailed documentation of design parameters and material specifications

Required Experience:

- Minimum 3+ years professional CAD design experience in fine jewelry
- Proven goldsmithing or jewelry craftsmanship background
- Expert knowledge of stone sizing, gemstone dimensions, and setting techniques
- Proficiency in professional CAD software (Rhino, Matrix, JewelCAD, or similar)
- Advanced rendering skills (V-Ray, KeyShot, or equivalent) producing gallery-quality output
- Experience with precious metals (gold, silver, platinum) and their properties
- Understanding of manufacturing processes and production constraints
- Portfolio demonstrating hyper-realistic renders and completed fine jewelry projects

Technical Requirements:

- Fluency with 3D modeling software for jewelry
- Ability to work with STL/STP files for 3D printing and CNC production
- Experience creating both artistic renders and technical production drawings
- Knowledge of gemstone grading, sizing, and setting security
- Capability to deliver files in multiple formats as needed

What We're Looking For:

- A detail-oriented professional who understands both the artistic and technical sides of fine jewelry
- Someone with genuine goldsmith/jewelry background (not just CAD training)
- An artist who can deliver photorealistic work that captures luxury and craftsmanship
- A reliable, communicative partner who can manage revisions and feedback
- Commitment to excellence and meeting deadlines

Application Requirements:

To be considered for this role, please provide:

1. Detailed Work History - Your background in jewelry design, goldsmithing, and CAD work. Include dates, companies/clients, and specific roles.

2. Portfolio - Links to 5-8 of your best fine jewelry CAD projects and renders. Include:
- Screenshots or renders of completed pieces
- Variety of jewelry types (rings, earrings, pendants, bracelets, etc.)
- Examples showing both artistic renders and technical drawings
- Proof of stone sizing and gemstone work

3. Software Proficiency - List all CAD and rendering software you're proficient in, with years of experience in each.

4. References - Contact information for 2-3 previous clients or employers who can speak to your jewelry design and rendering work.

5. NDA Acknowledgment - Confirmation that you understand and agree to sign a Non-Disclosure Agreement protecting our designs, processes, and brand information. This is non-negotiable.

Important:

- All work will be subject to a signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) before any project details are shared
- Confidentiality is strictly enforced
- We require exclusivity on design concepts during active projects
- Files and intellectual property remain the property of our brand

Hiring Timeline:

We are hiring immediately for ongoing collaboration. Strong candidates will be contacted within 48 hours.

title: Seeking WordPress Plugin Expert
description:
WordPress Plugin Developer for a Small Attorney Directory

Hospital Watchdog, an independent nonprofit organization, is creating a straightforward online directory of medical-malpractice attorneys. We are looking for a talented WordPress plugin developer to build a lightweight, easy-to-manage directory on our staging website.

This is a relatively contained project. The directory will initially include approximately 300 attorneys and should grow to about 2,000. Visitors will browse a scroll-down alphabetical list of cities and states rather than use a complicated search system. The number of cities has not yet been determined.

What the directory needs to do
Import attorney listings from a CSV spreadsheet.
Display a scroll-down, alphabetical list of cities and the attorneys in each city.
Display a consistent listing for each attorney, including a sketch, name, short bio, three qualification points, firm name, phone number, and website button. See the attached design.
Allow us to edit or correct individual listings in WordPress.
Update existing records without creating duplicates when a revised CSV is imported.
Work well on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Include a standard PayPal payment button or link already in place. Automated subscriptions and payment management are not required.
Who we hope to find

This opportunity may be a particularly good fit for a WordPress plugin developer who is new to Upwork but already has a track record of building WordPress plugins. You do not need an established Upwork history. You do need genuine WordPress plugin experience that you can show us.

We appreciate clear communication, practical solutions, and developers who can explain their work in plain language. We will provide the spreadsheet, attorney sketches, a design, and access to the staging website.

Budget and application

Budget: $250 fixed price.

If this project interests you, please send:

Examples of WordPress plugins or directories you personally built.

We welcome your interest and your questions.

title: Marketing Data Analyst/Analytics Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a Marketing Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer to help us build cleaner reporting, better attribution, and actionable insights across our marketing and sales efforts for a growing home services company.

This is not a “just pull reports” role. We need someone who understands how marketing data connects to actual revenue, lead quality, phone calls, booked jobs, and ROI  especially in small business or home service environments.

Industry experience in restoration, HVAC, plumbing, roofing, pest control, legal, med spa, or similar lead-generation businesses is strongly preferred.

About Us
We are a multi-location home services/restoration company focused heavily on lead generation through:

Google Ads
Local SEO / GBP
Meta Ads
Call tracking
Landing pages
CRM + offline conversion tracking

We care much more about the following over vanity metrics:
qualified calls
booked appointments
jobs sold
revenue

What We Need Help With
Build and maintain marketing dashboards and reporting systems

Analyze lead quality,  calls, bookings, and revenue in comparison against campaign

Help improve attribution across platforms

Identify where leads are actually coming from and which campaigns are profitable

Audit and troubleshoot tracking issues

Connect marketing data with CRM and operational data

Create clean reporting for leadership

Help us understand true ROI by campaign/location/channel

Assist with conversion tracking setup, tag mangement and QA

Platforms / Tools We Use
Experience with some or most of these is required:

GA4
Google Tag Manager
Google Ads
Meta Ads
Call tracking platforms (when applying please specify)
Looker Studio
CRM integrations
Google Sheets / Excel
Offline conversion tracking
UTM strategy
API integrations or ETL experience is a plus
Ideal Candidate

Has experience with small business or home service marketing data
Understands lead generation funnels
Can explain data clearly and simply
Knows how to identify tracking problems and attribution gaps
Comfortable working with messy real-world data
Understands the difference between leads and actual revenue performance
Proactive and strategic not just task-based
Bonus Points If You Have Experience With

Restoration or emergency services marketing
Multi-location businesses
Call tracking attribution
Offline conversions
Revenue reporting
PPC performance analysis
Local SEO reporting
Building automated dashboards

To Apply Please include:

Examples of dashboards or reporting you’ve built
Tools/platforms you’ve worked with
Experience with home services or small businesses
A short explanation of how you would determine whether a Google Ads campaign is actually profitable beyond platform-reported conversions
Your hourly rate and availability

Project Type
Ongoing freelance/contract role with potential for long-term work.

We value responsiveness, accuracy, strategic thinking, and clear communication.

title: Redesign Apple App Store Screenshots
description:
We’re looking for a highly skilled mobile app designer to redesign the Apple App Store screenshots for ClearCal, an AI-powered calorie and nutrition tracking app.

This is not simply a graphic design project. We are looking for someone who understands App Store conversion, visual hierarchy, mobile product marketing, and how to communicate an app’s value within the first few screenshots.

The goal is to create a premium, highly polished screenshot set that immediately communicates what ClearCal does, why it is different, and gives users a strong reason to download.

You will work from our existing app UI, brand direction, product features, and current screenshots. We want the final creative to feel modern, premium, minimal, and aligned with top-performing consumer iOS apps—not generic App Store templates.

Key responsibilities include:

Develop a strong visual and messaging concept for the full screenshot sequence
Redesign 5–7 App Store screenshots using our actual ClearCal interface
Create compelling headlines and supporting copy focused on conversion
Highlight key product benefits such as AI meal scanning, calorie and macro tracking, detected-food transparency, personalized goals, and nutrition insights
Maintain consistency with ClearCal’s existing branding and product UI
Optimize layouts for Apple App Store screenshot dimensions and multiple iPhone sizes
Deliver organized, editable source files in Figma
Provide final export-ready App Store assets

We are especially interested in designers who have experience with App Store Optimization (ASO), mobile subscription apps, health/fitness apps, or high-converting consumer app creatives.

Please include examples of App Store screenshot sets you have designed, particularly projects where your work was focused on improving conversion or downloads.

We are looking for someone with strong creative judgment who can also challenge our current ideas and recommend a better screenshot sequence, messaging hierarchy, and visual approach where appropriate.

Success for this project means the screenshots look premium, communicate the app in seconds, and make someone want to download ClearCal before they even read the description.

I’d also add one line at the very bottom:

Please start your proposal with “CLEARCAL” and include a link to your best App Store screenshot project.

title: QuickBooks Catch-Up Bookkeeper - Car Dealership
description:
We are a used car dealership in Texas. Our 2025 books were never done in QuickBooks Online and we need them rebuilt and reconciled in three weeks for a September 15 tax filing. We sell mostly retail (the customer gets bank financing) plus a smaller number of in-house financed deals.

This is a catch-up and cleanup project with a hard deadline, not ongoing bookkeeping. If it goes well there is ongoing monthly work after.

WHAT THE JOB INVOLVES

- Rebuild 12 months of 2025 in QuickBooks Online from source documents
- Enter opening balances from our filed 2024 tax return
- Build a deal register for every vehicle sold in 2025 (roughly 250 to 400 units) from mixed sources: our DMS export, state title filings, floor plan lender statements, and lender funding notices. Our DMS data is incomplete, so part of this job is reconstructing the full list and proving it is complete
- Post monthly summary journal entries for vehicle sales, cost of vehicles sold, and inventory movement
- Reconcile three bank accounts for all 12 months
- Reconcile two floor plan (inventory financing) lines to lender statements
- Produce an inventory rollforward that ties beginning inventory plus purchases minus cost of sales to ending inventory
- Categorize operating expenses from bank feeds

REQUIRED

- Real experience with inventory-based businesses and cost of goods sold, not only service business bookkeeping
- QuickBooks Online, journal entries, and bank reconciliation at a high level
- Comfort working from messy and incomplete source documents, spreadsheets and PDFs
- Strong Excel or Google Sheets
- At least 3 hours a day of overlap with US Central Time
- Able to start within 3 days and commit real hours

NICE TO HAVE

- Car dealership, equipment dealer, or any floor plan / inventory financing experience
- Experience with US auto lenders or a DMS (DealerCenter, CDK, Dealertrack)

TWO ROLES, ONE POSTING

1. Lead bookkeeper, 12 to 15 hrs per week. Owns the chart of accounts, the deal register logic, and reviews the work. For the right person with dealership or floor plan experience we will pay above the posted range.

2. Support bookkeeper, up to 40 hrs per week. Data entry and bank reconciliation.

Tell us which role you are applying for.

TO APPLY, ANSWER THESE THREE QUESTIONS IN YOUR PROPOSAL

Short answers are fine. We will not read proposals that skip them.

1. We buy a truck at auction for $18,000 using a floor plan line, and the floor plan lender pays the auction directly, so no cash leaves our bank. We spend $1,200 on reconditioning. We sell it for $24,500 and the buyer's bank wires us $25,900, which is the $24,500 sale price plus $1,400 of tax, title and license we collected on their behalf. We then pay the floor plan lender $18,150, being $18,000 principal and $150 interest. Give the journal entries and tell us the gross profit on the vehicle.

2. An in-house finance customer pays us $450. Of that, $310 is loan principal, $120 is interest, and $20 is a late fee. What is the journal entry?

3. Our DMS is missing roughly a third of our 2025 deals. What sources would you use to rebuild the complete list of vehicles we sold, and how would you prove to us that the list is complete?

We pay for a short paid test task before hiring. Please include your hourly rate and your available hours per week.

title: Brand Identity & Digital Menu Designer/Agency – GCC Project
description:
We are looking for an experienced **branding designer, packaging designer, or creative agency** to execute a complete brand identity and print/digital design project for a **GCC-based client**.

Should have **strong portfolio, excellent design sense, and experience working with Middle East/GCC businesses**.

## Scope of Work

### 1. Brand Concept Development
- Brand positioning, narrative and visual direction
- Moodboards and creative concept exploration

### 2. Logo Design
- Primary logo
- Secondary logo
- Icon/monogram
- Black/white and single-colour versions
- Basic logo usage guidelines

### 3. Company Profile
- 8–12 page professionally designed company profile
- Print + digital PDF
- Content structure, layout and visual design

### 4. Business Card
- Front & back design
- Print-ready artwork with bleed and crop marks

### 5. QR Business Card
- Dynamic QR code setup
- Branded QR design
- Print-ready artwork

### 6. Premium Date Box Packaging
- Structural and graphic design
- Premium/luxury presentation
- Print-ready artwork based on supplied guideline/specifications

### 7. Premium Paper Bag
- Branded paper bag design
- Print-ready artwork
- Correct colour profile and production specifications

### 8. Digital Menu & QR Platform – 12 Months
- Mobile-optimized online menu
- Menu categories and item organization
- Product descriptions, pricing and dietary tags
- Dynamic QR code
- Branded QR design
- Responsive iOS/Android experience
- 12-month hosting/platform access
- Basic menu updates and support

## Ideal Freelancer / Agency

We prefer someone who can handle **the complete project under one team**, rather than coordinating multiple individual freelancers.

You should have proven experience in:

- Brand identity design
- Logo development
- Luxury/premium packaging
- Food/FMCG branding
- Corporate profile design
- Print production and prepress
- QR/digital menu solutions
- GCC/Middle East branding projects

**Bonus:** Experience with Arabic/bilingual branding and right-to-left layouts.

## Deliverables

All final artwork should be supplied in appropriate editable and production-ready formats, including **AI/PSD/INDD/SVG/PDF/EPS** where applicable.

We expect professionally organized source files and print-ready artwork suitable for commercial production.

## Budget

Please submit your detailed & competitive **best fixed-price proposal for the complete scope**.

In your proposal, clearly mention:

1. Total project price
2. Estimated delivery timeline
3. Number of revision rounds included
4. What digital menu platform you propose
5. What is included in the 12-month platform/support
6. Your experience with GCC clients
7. Link to your relevant portfolio

**Please do not send generic portfolios.** We are particularly interested in seeing examples of **branding + packaging + corporate profile work**, especially premium/luxury or food-related projects.

We are looking for a **reliable long-term creative partner** for future projects, not simply the lowest bidder.

title: Data Miner / Lead Generation Specialist – Medical & Cosmetic Spas
description:
We are looking for an experienced Data Miner / Lead Generation Specialist to build a large, accurate database of medical spas, cosmetic spas, aesthetic clinics, wellness clinics, and medical weight-loss clinics throughout targeted U.S. markets.

The primary deliverable will be a clean, organized Excel spreadsheet containing business information, contact information, decision-maker information, and details regarding whether each business currently offers GLP-1 weight-loss programs and/or peptide services.

This database will be used by our sales and business development team, so accuracy and completeness are extremely important.

Geographic Markets

We need businesses researched in the following markets:

Florida
Texas
California
New York
New Jersey
Connecticut
Massachusetts
Georgia, with a strong focus on Atlanta
North Carolina
Maryland
Arizona
Illinois
Colorado
PRIORITY MARKETS

The largest concentration of research should initially be placed on:

1. Florida
2. Texas
3. California
4. New York
5. New Jersey

We want these five states built out as extensively as possible before moving deeper into the remaining markets.

Required Excel Columns

Every business should have its own row. The Excel spreadsheet should include the following columns:

Column Information Required
Business Name Full legal/public business name
Website Business website
City City where the location operates
State State
Business Phone #1 Primary office number
Business Phone #2 Secondary number, if available
Business Email General business email
Office Manager Name Full name of office/practice manager
Office Manager Email Direct email whenever available
Office Manager Phone Direct phone/mobile number whenever publicly available
GLP-1 Offered? Yes / No
GLP-1 Products Semaglutide, tirzepatide, etc., if publicly listed
Peptides Offered? Yes / No
Peptides Offered List peptides/services found publicly
GLP-1 Pricing Online? Yes / No
GLP-1 Pricing Record publicly advertised pricing
Peptide Pricing Online? Yes / No
Peptide Pricing Record publicly advertised pricing
Source URL Page where GLP-1/peptide information was verified
Notes Any useful additional information
Research Requirements

We are not looking for a basic scraped list containing only business names and generic phone numbers.

The researcher should go deeper into each business and determine:

Does the business currently advertise GLP-1 or medical weight-loss services?
Do they advertise semaglutide, tirzepatide, or other GLP-1 programs?
Does the business advertise peptide therapy or peptide-related services?
Which peptides are publicly listed?
Are prices advertised directly on the website?
What are those prices?
Who appears to be the office manager, practice manager, operations manager, owner, or appropriate decision-maker?
Can a direct business email and phone number for that individual be identified from legitimate public/business sources?

Information should be gathered from sources such as company websites, Google Business listings, LinkedIn, professional directories, social media business pages, and reputable lead-generation databases.

Data Quality Standards

Accuracy is more important than speed.

We expect the researcher to:

Remove duplicate businesses and duplicate locations.
Verify emails whenever possible.
Clearly distinguish direct contact information from generic office information.
Never invent or guess contact information.
Use only legitimate public/business contact information.
Include the source URL used to verify GLP-1 and peptide offerings.
Mark unavailable information as N/A rather than leaving us unsure whether it was researched.
Keep formatting consistent throughout the entire spreadsheet.
Separate businesses by state so the database can easily be filtered and segmented.
Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone with experience in:

Data mining
B2B lead generation
Web research
Medical spa or healthcare lead generation
Excel / Google Sheets
LinkedIn research
Email finding and verification
Apollo, Hunter, RocketReach, Snov, Clay, or similar tools
Google Maps/business scraping
Data cleaning and deduplication

Experience researching medical spas, aesthetic clinics, weight-loss clinics, wellness clinics, or healthcare businesses is strongly preferred.

Initial Priority

The first phase of this project should focus heavily on:

Florida → Texas → California → New York → New Jersey

We want to build a comprehensive database in these five markets first, particularly businesses offering GLP-1 weight-loss programs, peptide therapy, or both.

After these markets are sufficiently covered, research should expand into Connecticut, Massachusetts, Georgia/Atlanta, North Carolina, Maryland, Arizona, Illinois, and Colorado.

When Applying

Please include:

Your experience with data mining and lead generation.
Which research/data tools you currently use.
