title: Cold Email & LinkedIn Outreach Infrastructure Setup
description:
We’re preparing a new B2B outbound campaign and need someone to set up the systems we’ll use for cold email and LinkedIn outreach.

The initial project is mainly focused on getting everything organized and ready before we start sending messages at scale.

What we need help with
Review our current outbound setup and identify anything that needs attention
Help organize domains, mailboxes, and sending accounts
Check basic email authentication including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC
Configure our cold email platform and campaign settings
Organize prospect lists and prepare them for outreach
Set up LinkedIn outreach workflows
Configure connection and follow-up sequences
Make sure email and LinkedIn campaigns are separated by audience and messaging
Set up basic tracking for replies, bounces, and interested prospects
Create a simple process for managing positive responses and follow-ups
We’re looking for someone with experience in
Cold email infrastructure
LinkedIn outreach setup
Email deliverability
Domain and mailbox configuration
B2B outbound campaigns
Lead list preparation
Outreach campaign management

Experience with Instantly, Smartlead, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Expandi, or similar tools is a plus.

The project

We’ll provide the target audience and campaign requirements. Your job will be to help us build a clean and organized outreach system that our team can use once the setup is complete.

After the infrastructure is ready, there may be ongoing work managing the campaigns, monitoring performance, handling follow-ups, and improving the outreach process.

When applying, please tell us about a previous cold email or LinkedIn outreach infrastructure project you have worked on and which platforms you used.

A simplified vector quilting guide for trapunto-style stitching is also required.

🚀 WE’RE HIRING — SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR

We’re looking for a top-notch Senior Video Editor who can create premium, fast-paced commercial and social media videos at a high professional standard.

Position: Senior Video Editor — Cinematic & Social Content

Location: Multan DHA, Innovista

Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PKT

Type: Full-Time

Salary: Competitive Salary

What We’re Looking For
You should have strong experience with:

Adobe Premiere Pro
Adobe After Effects
Cinematic editing & visual storytelling
Advanced transitions and match cuts
Speed ramps and dynamic pacing
Strong typography and motion graphics
Professional color grading
Sound design & SFX
Music and beat synchronization
Presenter + B-roll integration
High-quality 9:16 and 16:9 social media content
Ability to adapt content into different aspect ratios when required
Clean, premium final finishing
Good knowledge of AI tools and how to generate, enhance, and integrate AI content into raw footage
We need an editor who understands how every shot connects through movement, pacing, typography, music, sound and visual flow — not someone who simply adds random transitions.

Important
This is not a basic video editing position.

title: Growth Marketing for Startup
description:
We’re building a platform that connects curious learners with people who can teach, guide, and support them around what they want to learn.

Our waitlist is live and our MVP is in development. We’re looking for someone hands-on to lead our early growth, building our initial audience, guide network, and community from the ground up.

We already have design support for graphics and branded content. We need someone who can think beyond posting - how do we reach the right people, get them interested, start conversations, and turn that interest into an early community and user base?

The right candidate would develop and execute our early growth strategy, including:
* Finding and reaching potential learners and guides through scalable outreach
* Identifying partnerships, communities, and other growth opportunities
* Creating a social media plan that supports broader growth
* Working with our designer on content and campaigns
* Testing channels, messaging, and new ideas

We’re looking for someone resourceful, strategic, and hands-on who is comfortable taking ownership,. AI is fine as a tool, but we’re not looking for generic AI-written posts, lead lists, content calendars, or strategies. We are looking for someone who understands the audience, brings original ideas, and turns those ideas into action.

title: Solana and Rust Developer
description: We are looking for a talented Solana and Rust Developer to join our cutting-edge blockchain development team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing smart contracts and decentralized applications on the Solana blockchain. You will work closely with product managers, blockchain engineers, and security teams to create scalable, secure, and efficient blockchain solutions. Develop, test, and deploy smart contracts and on-chain programs using Rust on the Solana blockchain. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project requirements and translate them into technical specifications. Optimize smart contract code for performance, security, and cost-efficiency. Participate in code reviews, write comprehensive documentation, and maintain high coding standards. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to smart contract development, deployment, and interaction. Stay updated with the latest developments in Solana, Rust, and blockchain technology, and incorporate best practices. Contribute to the design and implementation of blockchain protocols, wallets, and user interfaces as needed. Conduct security audits and vulnerability assessments of smart contracts and on-chain programs. Proven experience developing on the Solana blockchain with a strong understanding of its architecture and ecosystem. Expertise in Rust programming language, with a solid portfolio of blockchain or systems programming projects. Hands-on experience with Solana SDK, Anchor framework, or other relevant development tools. Knowledge of cryptography, consensus algorithms, and blockchain security principles. Familiarity with decentralized finance, NFTs, or other blockchain use cases is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently or within a team. Excellent communication skills and attention to detail. Experience with other blockchain platforms is a bonus. Contributions to open-source blockchain projects are advantageous. Knowledge of front-end development for dApps is a plus. Join us to be at the forefront of blockchain innovation, building the next generation of decentralized applications on Solana.

title: Supplier RFQ & Offer Comparison Portal
description:
PROJECT: SUPPLIER RFQ & OFFER COMPARISON PORTAL

We are looking for an experienced software development company or team to build a web-based procurement tool for construction and project purchasing.

Today, supplier enquiries, quotations and price comparisons are handled partly manually using Excel, PDF files, GAEB files and e-mail.

The goal is to automate the process from importing a bill of quantities, Leistungsverzeichnis or LV, through supplier quotations and price comparison, to supplier selection and transfer of the purchasing result into Microsoft Dynamics NAV.

A particularly important requirement is the ability to process supplier quotations returned as PDFs, scans or images, including handwritten prices and comments.

The project should be divided into the following deliverables.

---

DELIVERABLE 1 – OFFER RECOGNITION AND PRICE COMPARISON PROOF OF CONCEPT

---

This is the most important first deliverable. It should prove that supplier quotations can be read and matched reliably.

INPUTS:

* GAEB files containing the original LV or bill of quantities
* Excel and CSV where applicable
* Supplier quotations returned as:

  * PDF
  * scanned PDF
  * image
  * partially handwritten PDF

Real examples will be provided.

REQUIRED FUNCTIONALITY:

The system should:

* import the original LV structure
* identify:

  * LV position number
  * description
  * quantity
  * unit
* read supplier quotations using OCR and AI
* recognise:

  * unit prices
  * total prices
  * handwritten prices
  * supplier comments
  * product and system references where available
* automatically match recognised supplier prices to the correct LV position
* identify missing or unpriced positions
* flag uncertain recognition results for manual review
* allow users to correct recognised values
* validate values where possible, for example:
  Quantity x Unit Price = Total Price
* combine multiple supplier quotations into one price comparison
* identify:

  * cheapest price per LV position
  * total quotation value per supplier
  * cheapest supplier overall

OUTPUT:

* Excel
* CSV

IMPORTANT:

The software must not blindly trust OCR or AI results.

Each recognised value should ideally retain a reference to the original document and page and have a confidence status so users can review uncertain results.

Preferred logic:

AI and OCR extract, software validates, user confirms uncertain results.

---

DELIVERABLE 2 – PRODUCTION-READY INTERNAL APPLICATION

---

Turn Deliverable 1 into a proper multi-user web application for internal employees.

PROJECT MANAGEMENT:

Users should be able to:

* create projects
* edit projects
* view all projects
* manage project status
* store multiple LVs per project
* retain project and quotation history

LV MANAGEMENT:

The system should support:

* GAEB import
* Excel and CSV import
* positions and subpositions
* quantities
* units
* descriptions
* optional additional information
* LV versioning

The exact GAEB versions supported should be agreed before development.

SUPPLIER MANAGEMENT:

Maintain a central supplier database containing at least:

* company name
* address
* contact person
* e-mail

Supplier master data should be capable of being imported or synchronised from Microsoft Dynamics NAV.

USERS AND ROLES:

Minimum roles:

* Administrator

  * full access
  * user and permission management
  * system configuration
  * system logs

* Project Manager or Calculation

  * create and manage tender projects
  * create supplier enquiries
  * evaluate quotations

* Purchasing

  * access projects
  * create supplier enquiries
  * evaluate quotations
  * make purchasing decisions

DOCUMENT MANAGEMENT:

Users should be able to:

* upload documents
* assign documents to projects
* assign documents to supplier enquiries
* download authorised documents
* retain quotation versions

SECURITY:

Minimum requirements:

* HTTPS
* secure authentication
* secure password storage
* role-based access control
* audit logging
* GDPR-compliant storage and processing

---

DELIVERABLE 3 – WEB-BASED PRICE COMPARISON AND PURCHASING DECISION

---

Replace the current Excel-based price comparison with an easy-to-use web interface.

PRICE COMPARISON:

Show each LV position together with the prices submitted by all suppliers.

The system should support:

* supplier comparison by position
* cheapest unit price
* cheapest total price
* cheapest supplier overall
* supplier total
* missing quotations
* unrecognised or uncertain positions
* manual corrections

DISCOUNTS AND NEGOTIATION:

For each supplier, users should be able to enter negotiated discounts and automatically recalculate:

* individual prices
* supplier total
* ranking

INTERNAL TARGET PRICES:

Import K+B target or order prices from NAV.

The system should:

* compare supplier prices against the internal target price
* visually highlight prices above the internal target

PRODUCT AND SPECIFICATION COMPARISON:

Where supplier quotations include alternative products or systems, the tool should support comparing the offered product against the original LV specification.

The first version may use AI to:

* extract relevant product and specification information
* highlight differences
* flag potentially non-compliant products for human review

The final definition of how far the system should automatically determine technical compliance must be agreed before this feature is fixed-priced.

PURCHASING DECISION:

Users should be able to select the preferred supplier.

The system should support either:

* one supplier for the complete package
* different suppliers for individual positions

The exact award logic should be confirmed during specification.

NAV OUTPUT:

The selected purchasing result should be transferable to the existing Microsoft Dynamics NAV purchasing process.

The current Excel solution already creates NAV purchasing import data.

The new system should therefore support either:

* NAV API or web service integration

OR

* compatible CSV or import files

The final integration method depends on the available NAV interface.

---

DELIVERABLE 4 – RFQ AND SUPPLIER ENQUIRY MANAGEMENT

---

Allow users to send quotation requests directly from the application.

Users should be able to:

* select a project or LV
* select individual LV positions if required
* select suppliers
* define a quotation deadline
* generate enquiry documents
* send the enquiry by e-mail
* track:

  * sent date
  * deadline
  * supplier
  * response status

AUTOMATED E-MAILS:

The system should support:

* new RFQ notification
* reminder before quotation deadline
* notification when a quotation is received

E-mail integration should preferably support Microsoft 365 or standard SMTP.

---

DELIVERABLE 5 – SUPPLIER PORTAL

---

Create a secure external portal for suppliers.

Suppliers should be able to:

* access RFQs sent to them
* view the relevant LV positions
* download enquiry documents
* upload quotations
* upload:

  * GAEB
  * Excel
  * CSV
  * PDF
  * images
  * supporting documents and datasheets
* submit prices manually where appropriate
* see open enquiries and deadlines

The portal should be simple and require as little effort from suppliers as possible.

Possible login approaches include:

* supplier account and password
* secure invitation or one-time link

We are open to recommendations.

---

DELIVERABLE 6 – HOSTING, DEPLOYMENT AND HANDOVER

---

The final solution must be deployable either:

* in a cloud environment

OR

* internally or on-premises

The preferred solution should be proposed by the development company.

The proposal should consider:

* hosting
* database
* document storage
* backups
* monitoring
* security
* OCR and AI operating costs
* scalability
* GDPR and EU data processing

HANDOVER:

The project must include:

* complete source code
* database schema
* deployment documentation
* technical documentation
* user documentation
* installation documentation
* testing
* user acceptance support

All code and project-specific intellectual property must be transferred to us upon payment.

---

PREFERRED TECHNICAL APPROACH

---

We are open to recommendations, but our preferred architecture is a modern web application.

A suitable technology stack could be:

* Backend: C# and .NET
* Frontend: React and TypeScript
* Database: SQL Server or PostgreSQL
* Architecture: modular monolith rather than unnecessary microservices
* asynchronous or background processing for OCR and large document processing
* separate abstraction layer for OCR and AI providers so providers can be changed later

We are open to alternative technologies if the applicant can explain why they are better for this project.

The system should be designed for long-term maintainability rather than as a short-term prototype.

---

IMPORTANT TECHNICAL CHALLENGE

---

The largest technical challenge is automatic recognition and interpretation of supplier quotations.

Real supplier quotations can contain:

* printed prices
* handwritten prices
* handwritten comments
* missing positions
* alternative products
* scanned documents
* supplier-specific layouts

Applicants should briefly explain:

* which OCR or document AI technology they propose
* how handwritten values will be processed
* how LV positions will be matched
* how uncertain results will be handled
* whether users will have a review and correction interface

---

INFORMATION WE CAN PROVIDE

---

We can provide:

* existing functional requirements
* existing Excel and VBA price-comparison solution
* real GAEB and LV examples
* multiple real supplier quotations
* handwritten quotation examples
* existing NAV purchasing import examples
* access to business users for clarification and testing

Before final development starts, detailed acceptance criteria should be agreed for each deliverable.

---

WHAT EVERY APPLICANT MUST INCLUDE IN THE PROPOSAL

---

Please do not submit only a generic company introduction.

Every proposal must clearly include the following:

1. QUOTE EACH DELIVERABLE SEPARATELY

Please provide a cost quote OR estimated development hours plus hourly rate for each deliverable individually:

* Deliverable 1
* Deliverable 2
* Deliverable 3
* Deliverable 4
* Deliverable 5
* Deliverable 6

For every deliverable, please state:

* estimated hours
* hourly rate
* estimated cost
* estimated duration
* important assumptions
* important exclusions

2. CONFIRM FIXED-COST AVAILABILITY

Please explicitly confirm:

"Yes, we are willing to execute the agreed development scope on a fixed-cost basis."

The final fixed price can be agreed after clarification of requirements and acceptance criteria, but willingness to work on a fixed-cost basis is mandatory.

3. CONFIRM AVAILABILITY TO START

Please explicitly confirm whether your team has sufficient capacity to start development around MID-SEPTEMBER 2026.

Also provide:

* expected team size
* expected project duration
* which roles and team members would work on the project

Applications that do not clearly answer these three points may not be considered.

title: Senior Creative Strategist
description:
We're a fast-growing multi-brand e-commerce company looking for an expert-level Senior Creative Strategist to lead creative strategy across our DTC brand portfolio — from paid social testing to brand campaigns. You'll own the call on what creative bets get made and why, working as a peer to performance marketing and brand leadership.

What You'll Do

- Own creative strategy across paid social (Meta, TikTok, YouTube) and brand campaigns for multiple DTC brands.
- Run a high-volume testing engine: hypotheses, briefs, analysis, and repeatable winning frameworks.
- Turn performance data (CAC, LTV, ROAS, hook rate) directly into creative direction.
- Lead a team of creative strategists, editors, and/or freelance creators and manage a creator network.
- Partner with growth leadership on budget allocation and creative-driven efficiency gains.
- Present strategy and results to executive leadership with clear recommendations.

What You Bring

- 8+ years in creative strategy or performance marketing, including 4+ years in DTC/e-commerce specifically.
- A track record of creative that measurably moved CAC, ROAS, or revenue — at real ad spend levels.
- Expert fluency in Meta and TikTok Ads at scale (six-to-seven-figure monthly spend).
- Experience managing people and/or a creator network.
- A portfolio showing creative strategy tied to named performance results.

Nice to Have

Experience across a multi-brand portfolio; AI-assisted creative tools; beauty/wellness/apparel/CPG background.

title: Freelance Food Truck Event Booker & Catering Sales Representative
description:
Mila’s Cuisine is a Charlotte-area mobile food business offering fresh, crowd-friendly food for corporate lunches, private events, community events, festivals, and other gatherings.
We are looking for an experienced and motivated Event Booker / Catering Sales Representative who can help us consistently secure profitable, quality events.
We are not looking for someone who simply finds vendor applications online. We need someone who understands how to evaluate opportunities, communicate with event organizers and businesses, generate leads, and turn those leads into profitable bookings.
What You'll Do
Research and identify profitable food truck opportunities throughout Charlotte and surrounding areas.
Conduct direct outreach to corporations, warehouses, office buildings, apartment communities, breweries, schools, event planners, property managers, HOAs, hospitals, universities, construction sites, and other potential clients.
Pursue corporate lunches, employee appreciation events, private catering, recurring food truck stops, festivals, community events, and special events.
Contact event organizers and decision-makers by email and/or phone.
Follow up consistently with potential clients.
Help negotiate vendor fees, guaranteed minimums, deposits, and other booking terms.
Maintain an organized calendar or spreadsheet of leads, contacts, follow-ups, bookings, and outcomes.
Build relationships that can turn one-time bookings into recurring accounts.
Event Qualification Is Extremely Important
We have experienced events where vendor fees were high but actual food sales were very low. Your job isn't simply to fill our calendar—it is to help fill it with events that make financial sense.
Before recommending a paid event, you should investigate factors such as:
Expected attendance
Historical attendance
Number of food vendors/trucks
Whether competing food concepts will be present
Vendor fee or percentage of sales
Event duration
Whether food is being provided elsewhere
Whether attendees are expected to purchase meals
Previous vendor sales, when available
Expected customer-to-food-vendor ratio
Possibility of a guaranteed sales minimum
We would rather have fewer profitable bookings than a calendar full of events that lose money.
Priority Opportunities
We are especially interested in:
Corporate and employer-paid catering
Employee appreciation events
Recurring workplace/warehouse lunches
Private parties and celebrations
Apartment and residential community events
Large events with strong historical vendor sales
Festivals and public events with reasonable vendor fees and favorable vendor-to-attendee ratios
Ideal Candidate
You may be a great fit if you have experience in:
Catering sales
Food truck booking
Event sales
Hospitality sales
Corporate catering
Lead generation
Business development
Event planning or vendor management
Existing relationships with Charlotte-area businesses, event planners, property managers, venues, or event organizers would be a major plus.
Compensation
We are open to discussing a commission-based or base + commission structure based on experience.
Our goal is to create a compensation arrangement where you are rewarded for successfully generating profitable, completed bookings, particularly new corporate clients and recurring accounts.
Please include your proposed compensation structure in your application.

title: Proofreader
description:
I'm an author with a completed YA epic fantasy novel (Book One of a series, ~88,000 words). This job is the first three chapters (5,663 words) as a paid trial. If it goes well, I'll hire you for the full manuscript, so please quote both.

The main job is proofreading — this manuscript has already been through developmental, line, and copy editing, so I'm looking for a fresh set of eyes on the surface, not a rewrite. Specifically:

Typos, misspellings, doubled or missing words
Punctuation and mechanics
Grammar errors and obvious inconsistencies (character names, capitalization, hyphenation, number style)
Anything that would embarrass me in print

Please do not rewrite sentences or flag style preferences — if a line is correct but you'd word it differently, leave it.

Alongside the proofread, I'd also love a short honest reader response — a paragraph or two on how the chapters flow, whether the characters come through, how the scenes connect, and anything you'd suggest to improve it. Be blunt; I'd rather have useful criticism than encouragement. This is a bonus, not a full editorial report.

Style conventions: US English spelling and Chicago Manual of Style. This is fantasy, so it has invented names and terms (people, places, made-up vocabulary). Please leave those alone and only flag when the same invented term is spelled or capitalized inconsistently between instances — don't "correct" them to the dictionary.

Deliverable: the same Word file(s) returned with Track Changes on, plus your short reader note.

Turnaround: within 5 days of hire.

Fantasy or genre-fiction experience is a plus.

title: Apparel Technical Designer / Tech Pack Specialist Needed for Innovative Sensory Hoodie
description:
I am developing an innovative premium athletic/lifestyle hoodie that incorporates discreet sensory and tactile features designed to support focus and self-regulation. The product concept is already established, and a U.S. provisional patent application has been filed.

I am looking for an **experienced apparel technical designer/product developer** to take my existing concept and turn it into a refined, manufacturable design and a professional, factory-ready tech pack.

 What I Already Have
* Established product concept and feature set
* Preliminary product specifications
* AI-generated concept mockups
* General feature placement
* Preliminary material and construction ideas
* Provisional patent filing

The AI mockups are **conceptual references only** and are not intended to represent final construction or technical specifications.

What I Need

I need someone who can do more than illustrate the garment. The ideal freelancer should be able to evaluate the concept from a **garment construction and manufacturing perspective** and recommend practical solutions for integrating specialized components into the hoodie.

The project will include:
* Refining the overall hoodie silhouette and design
* Creating professional front/back technical flats
* Evaluating feature placement and garment construction
* Developing practical construction and attachment methods for specialized components
* Recommending appropriate fabrics, trims, hardware, and materials
* Considering comfort, durability, washability, safety, and manufacturability
* Creating detailed construction callouts
* Developing a Bill of Materials (BOM)
* Creating measurement/specification sheets
* Developing component and placement specifications
* Creating branding/label placement specifications
* Producing a complete, manufacturer-ready tech pack
* Providing editable source files
* Completing revisions based on feedback

### Important
This is **not simply a fashion illustration project**.

Some of the garment's features are unconventional, so I specifically need someone who understands apparel construction and can help determine **how the concept should actually be engineered for sampling and manufacturing**.

I am open to modifying aspects of the initial concept if there is a more effective, durable, comfortable, or manufacturable construction solution.

Ideal Experience
Strong candidates will have experience with:

* Apparel technical design
* Tech pack development
* Cut-and-sew garments
* Hoodies, activewear, athleisure, or performance apparel
* Garment construction
* BOM development
* Fabric and trim specification
* Product development and sampling
* Manufacturing/factory communication

Experience with **adaptive apparel, modular garments, sensory products, wearable components, or other technically complex apparel** would be especially valuable.

Deliverables

At completion, I would like to have a professional package that can be provided to a sample maker/manufacturer to begin prototype development, including:

1. Final technical flats
2. Detailed construction/component drawings
3. Complete tech pack
4. Measurement/specification sheet
5. Bill of Materials
6. Fabric, trim, and hardware specifications
7. Construction and attachment callouts
8. Feature placement measurements
9. Branding/label specifications
10. Editable source files

When Applying

Please send **examples of tech packs you personally created**, particularly for hoodies, activewear, performance apparel, or garments involving unusual construction.

Please also briefly answer:

1. Have you taken apparel products from concept through sampling/manufacturing?
2. Are you comfortable recommending construction solutions rather than simply illustrating an existing design?
3. What software do you use for technical apparel design?
4. What would your process be for taking this concept from the current stage to a manufacturer-ready tech pack?
5. What is your estimated timeline for this project?

This project involves proprietary product features. Additional technical details will be shared with the selected freelancer under appropriate confidentiality terms.

title: Magazine Ad Designer Needed
description:
Graphic Designer Needed for 25 Print & Digital Book Ads

Fixed Price: $300

The Strand Magazine is looking for a talented graphic designer to create 25 polished advertisements for books, authors, publishers, and related literary clients.

These are not complicated agency campaigns. Most ads will involve working with supplied book covers, author photographs, logos, blurbs, and promotional copy and turning those materials into clean, professional, visually striking advertisements.

We want someone with a strong sense of typography and composition who can make an ad look sophisticated rather than crowded or templated.

Scope

* Design 25 individual advertisements
* Primarily print magazine ads, with some designs potentially adapted for digital use
* Sizes will include full-page, half-page, and quarter-page formats
* We will supply the book covers, copy, logos, photographs, and basic direction
* Designer will create the finished layout and prepare print-ready files
* Some ads may require light creative interpretation or background treatments
* Reasonable revisions should be included

Style

We publish a literary magazine, so we are looking for work that feels:

* Elegant
* Professional
* Contemporary
* Literary
* Clean and readable
* Appropriate for books from major publishers as well as independent authors

We do not want 25 ads that look like variations of the same template.

title: Vendor Operations & Sourcing Manager
description:
*THIS IS A FULL TIME JOB WITH 40+ HOURS A WEEK, AND MUST BE IN NEW YORK TIME ZONE EAST COAST, 830 AM TO 5 PM EST** - IF U CANNOT WORK IN USA TIME ZONE EST FOR THOSE HOURS, DO NOT APPLY.

We are an established automotive e-commerce company looking for a Vendor Operations & Sourcing Manager to take ownership of our vendor relationships and continuously make our supply network more profitable, reliable, and efficient.

This is not simply a purchasing or administrative role. We want someone who finds opportunities, solves problems, and owns vendor performance.

What You'll Own
Find and onboard new vendors, distributors, and inventory sources
Identify opportunities to expand inventory and product availability
Compare vendor costs and find better purchasing opportunities
Negotiate pricing, payment terms, freight, returns, and other vendor terms
Maintain strong day-to-day vendor communication
Investigate delayed shipments, missing tracking, backorders, cancellations, and short shipments
Monitor vendor performance and identify recurring problems
Track vendor returns, RMAs, and outstanding credits
Follow up aggressively on money owed to us
Investigate high-return products/vendors and help reduce return rates
Resolve invoice and cost discrepancies
Identify opportunities to improve shipping speed and tracking
Work with internal teams to resolve vendor-related issues
Use AI, spreadsheets, data, and automation to work faster and identify opportunities
What Success Looks Like

Your job is to continuously produce measurable improvements:

More inventory available → Better costs → Better terms → Faster shipping → Faster tracking → Fewer cancellations → Lower returns → Credits recovered → Better vendor performance → More profitable sales

We want someone who doesn't just say:

"I contacted the vendor."

We want someone who says:

"I identified the problem, resolved it, recovered the money, and put a process in place to prevent it from happening again."

Experience We're Looking For

Strong experience in vendor management, sourcing, procurement, purchasing, supply chain, dropshipping, or e-commerce operations.

Automotive aftermarket or large-catalog e-commerce experience is a major plus.

You should be analytical, organized, persistent with follow-ups, comfortable negotiating, and capable of independently solving problems.

Experience using Claude, ChatGPT, Excel/Google Sheets, and automation tools is strongly preferred.

Individual applicants only. No agencies.

title: Sportsbook Promo Affiliate Marketing & Short-Form Content Strategist
description:
I’m looking for an experienced marketing and short-form content strategist to help me launch and test an affiliate business centered around sportsbook promotions.

This is NOT a sports-picks or handicapping page.

I already have access to an established company that provides the education, platform and proprietary software. I am an affiliate for the program, so I do not need betting software developed.

My goal is customer acquisition.

I want to create short-form content that attracts the right audience, explains the concept simply, builds curiosity and ultimately sends qualified prospects to the existing education/software platform through my affiliate link.

The concept

Instead of teaching people to predict winners, the content focuses on understanding and using sportsbook promotions, including:

• Signup promotions
• Bonus bets
• No-sweat / second-chance offers
• Low-hold betting
• Hedging / matched-betting concepts
• Promotion conversion
• Current sportsbook offers
• Common mistakes and how promotions actually work

A possible core message is:

“Stop trying to pick winners. Start understanding the promotions.”

I also want to differentiate this from conventional gambling content. The educational angle is that trying to consistently beat sportsbooks by predicting games is difficult. The opportunity I’m interested in is understanding the promotional incentives sportsbooks offer to acquire customers and using risk-management/hedging techniques where appropriate.

Target audience

One of the first things I want the strategist to help validate is who we should target.

My current hypothesis is that the strongest audience is roughly ages 21–45, particularly Gen Z adults and Millennials.

Younger adults tend to be comfortable with short-form content, apps, promotions and online sportsbooks, while Millennials may combine strong sportsbook participation with greater disposable income.

I’m particularly interested in testing two audiences:

1. Side-hustle / extra-income audiences
People interested in unusual ways of making or saving money who may not currently consider themselves sports bettors.

2. Existing sports bettors
People already familiar with sportsbooks who may be interested in a different approach based on promotions rather than picks.

I currently believe the side-hustle audience may be the larger opportunity, but I want someone who will test this rather than simply agree with me.

All marketing must be directed toward adults of legal gambling age in the applicable jurisdiction.

Platforms

I want to initially test:

TikTok
Facebook Reels
YouTube Shorts

Ideally, we develop repeatable content that can be adapted across all three rather than creating an entirely separate production process for each platform.

What I need help with

I’m looking for someone who can help determine:

• Target customer/avatar
• Positioning and messaging
• Organic short-form content strategy
• Hooks that generate attention without relying on misleading earnings claims
• Content pillars and repeatable video formats
• Faceless vs. AI-avatar vs. other presentation styles
• CTAs and profile optimization
• Landing-page/affiliate funnel strategy
• Affiliate conversion optimization
• Compliance-conscious messaging for gambling-related and earnings-related content
• Analytics and testing
• Views → profile visits → clicks → leads → affiliate conversions
• How to determine customer acquisition cost and ROI

What I DON’T need yet

I’m not looking to spend heavily building an AI automation system before proving the marketing concept.

Initially I want inexpensive, efficient content testing. Once we identify messaging and formats that actually generate qualified customers, we can scale production and potentially automate more of the process.

Ideal candidate

I’d particularly like to hear from people with experience in one or more of these areas:

Sports betting / sportsbooks
Affiliate marketing
Matched betting / promotional betting
Side-hustle or make-money content
TikTok organic growth
YouTube Shorts / Facebook Reels
Direct-response marketing
Performance marketing
Affiliate funnels

Experience marketing in a regulated or platform-sensitive industry is a major plus.

Please answer these questions when applying

1. Have you marketed sportsbooks, sports betting, affiliate programs, finance, side hustles or another regulated/sensitive offer before?

2. Would you initially target existing sports bettors or side-hustle/extra-income audiences for this concept? Why?

3. If you had a limited budget, what would your first 30-day test look like?

4. What 3–5 short-form video formats would you test first?

5. How would you measure whether the content is generating customers rather than simply views?

6. Please show examples of short-form accounts, affiliate funnels or campaigns you’ve personally worked on and explain specifically what you did.

I’m looking for someone who thinks about customer acquisition and conversions, not someone whose only goal is generating views or followers.

title: Squarespace Web Designer Needed – Redesign & Mobile Optimization
description:
Hi,
I’m looking for a Squarespace designer to improve an existing website for a small wellness and lifestyle brand. The website is already live, but some areas need a visual refresh to make the site cleaner, more modern, and easier to use.

This is a small redesign project, not a complete website build. I mainly need someone who can work with the existing Squarespace pages and improve the overall presentation.

 What I need help with:

* Refresh the homepage and selected sections
* Improve the overall page layout and visual hierarchy
* Adjust spacing, typography, and section alignment
* Refine buttons, images, and other visual elements
* Improve the mobile layout and responsiveness
* Fix minor design inconsistencies
* Make the website easier to navigate and use
* Keep the existing brand style and content intact

 Requirements:

Experience designing websites in Squarespace
Strong understanding of responsive website design
Good eye for clean, modern layouts
 Experience improving existing website designs
Able to work efficiently within a small project scope

Good attention to detail

Budget: $10 Fixed Price

I’m looking for someone who can make practical improvements without overcomplicating the project. If the work goes well, there may be additional Squarespace design and customization work in the future.

title: **British English Natural Conversation Recording Project**
description:
Invitation to Participate in a Collaborative Conversation Recording Project for Native British English Speakers

To help us gather conversational data for linguistic research, language development, and educational projects. 
We are looking for native British English speakers. In this position, two native speakers' natural conversations on particular subjects are recorded. The app (Funcrowd) will be used for recordings

Because of dialogue based conversation recording project, you need a native partner with whom you will converse. No gender and age preference

**What You’ll Do:

1. **Working in Pairs: **
   - **This project requires two people to work together. You and your partner will have free conversations on the given topics.

2. **Conversation Requirements: **
   - **Topic Duration: ** **Each topic should be discussed for 20 minutes. **
   - **Total Time: ** **The total task will take 2.5 hours, covering various (7) topics. **
   - **Natural Flow: ** **Make sure the conversation flows naturally without long pauses. **

4. **Recording Instructions:**
   - **Main Speaker:** ** Identify the main speaker in the conversation.**
   - **Stay on the Page:** **Don’t lock your screen or leave the app during the recording, or it will stop automatically.**
   - **Avoid Hands-Free:** **Don’t use the speakerphone, and make sure both participants are in different rooms.**
   - **Upload the Data:** **After each session, both people must upload the recording. If it fails, you can retry using the "one-click upload."**

5. **Recording Environment: **
Quiet environment
   - **Microphone Position: ** **Hold the phone like you’re making a call, with the microphone aimed at your mouth. **
   - **Quiet Space: ** **Record in a quiet place to ensure the audio is clear. **
   - **Consistency: ** **Do all the recordings in the same place and don’t switch participants. **

6. **Content Requirements: **
   - **Start with a Phrase: ** **Begin each recording by saying “magic data sound recording.” **
   - **Natural Conversation: ** **Keep the conversation flowing naturally, avoiding long pauses. Make sure no silent section lasts more than two minutes. **
   - **Session Length: ** **Each conversation should be at least 21-22 minutes long, aiming for 2.5 hours of recording in total. **
   - **No Sensitive Topics: ** **Don’t discuss politics, religion, or other sensitive issues during the recording. **

7. **Topics to Discuss:**
   - **Talk about everyday topics such as finance, education, health, entertainment, current events, technology, art, relationships, and personal experiences.**

**Additional Opportunity:**

- **If you have any friends or relatives who can join you in completing this task, please feel free to contact us.**
- **We also offer a commission for providing additional people who can complete these recordings.**

**Who We’re Looking For:**

- **Two people who can follow instructions carefully.**
- **Native  speakers with good pronunciation.**

**How to Apply:**

**If you’re interested, please submit your details. ** You’ll receive an invitation code and further instructions to get started. **

Note: Two people are needed, and you will make second-person arrangements. This is an interesting and easy project

Note: $80 is the total amount of the budget, and secondly, you have to arrange your native partner, and it is not necessary He/she on this platform or not.

Candidates who have previously participated in a similar recording task for another client are not eligible to participate again. Duplicate participation is not permitted

title: Travel Video Editor for Cinematic Family Film
description:
We just got back from a big family trip through Milan, Lake Como, Mykonos and London, and I’m looking for someone really talented to help me turn all of the photos and videos into something we’ll actually keep and watch for years.

Between my phone, my wife’s phone and my Meta glasses, I’ll probably have somewhere around 1,100-1,200 photos and video clips.

I’m not looking for someone where I have to go through everything first and tell them exactly which clips to use.

That’s actually a big part of what I need help with.

I want to send you the raw files and have you go through everything yourself, find the great moments, get rid of the repetitive stuff, and figure out what tells the story of the trip best.

There are definitely going to be:

-Several versions of the same photo
-Photos where one angle or expression is much better than another
-Longer videos where only 10 or 20 seconds are really worth using
-Short random clips that might end up being some of the best moments
-A lot of candid footage from my Meta glasses
-Family moments, restaurants, beaches, boats, sightseeing, birthdays, funny moments, etc.

The finished video should feel like a really well-made family travel film, not a slideshow or something that looks like it came out of a template.

I’d like it to be fun, cinematic and emotional in the right places, but still natural.

One thing that’s important to me is keeping some of the real sound from the trip. If my kids are laughing, saying something funny, reacting to something, or there’s a great moment captured naturally, I’d rather hear that than just have music playing over every clip.

What I’d Like Created

Main family film:
Around 10–12 minutes that tells the story of the entire trip.

Short highlight video:
Around 2–3 minutes with the absolute best moments.

Vertical version:
Around 45–60 seconds that works well on a phone/social media.

I also need someone with a very good eye for photography.

This is important.

After you go through all of the photos, I’d like you to create a separate folder with roughly the 150–200 best photos from the entire vacation.

I’m going to use those to make a high-end printed photo book.

So I’m not only looking for a good video editor. I want someone who understands what makes a great photo and can look at five similar shots and know which one is clearly the keeper — best expression, lighting, composition, sharpness, etc.

I really don’t want to personally sort through 700+ vacation photos trying to decide between nearly identical shots.

How I’d Like to Work

I’ll organize the files roughly by destination and give you some background on the trip.

After that, I’d like you to take the lead.

Go through everything, make the creative decisions and put together the first version.

Then I’ll watch the finished rough cut and give you feedback.

I don’t want a process where you send me hundreds of photos and clips asking me which ones to use.

I’m hiring you because I want someone with good taste who can make those decisions.

title: E-Commerce Lifecycle & Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
We are an established automotive e-commerce company looking for an experienced Lifecycle & Retention Marketing Specialist to take ownership of marketing to our existing customers, prospects, and professional repair-shop accounts.

Your mission is simple:

Turn our existing customer and prospect database into more profitable revenue.

We already have traffic, customers, abandoned carts, previous purchasers, professional repair shops, leads, and significant customer data.

We need someone who wakes up thinking:

Who should we market to today? What should we send them? Why should they care? How do we get them to purchase or come back? And did the campaign actually make money?

This is NOT primarily a social-media position.

This is NOT a graphic-design position.

This is NOT someone who simply sends a weekly newsletter.

We want someone who understands e-commerce lifecycle marketing, segmentation, automation, remarketing, experimentation, and customer retention.

What You'll Own

You will own lifecycle and retention marketing across both our consumer/DIY customers and our professional repair-shop customers.

This may include:

Klaviyo
Email marketing
SMS marketing
Customer segmentation
Automated flows
Abandoned-cart recovery
Browse abandonment
Post-purchase marketing
Win-back campaigns
Customer reactivation
Repeat-purchase campaigns
Cross-sell and upsell campaigns
Product/category campaigns
Seasonal automotive campaigns
Promotional campaigns
Customer onboarding
Pro customer onboarding
Pro account activation
Pro reorder campaigns
Dormant Pro account reactivation
Lead nurturing
Remarketing strategy
Campaign experimentation
A/B testing
Personalized marketing
Campaign reporting and analysis

Your job is not simply to execute campaigns we give you.

We expect YOU to identify the opportunities and develop the marketing calendar and strategy.

Consumer / DIY Marketing

Our consumer customers purchase automotive parts for repairs and maintenance.

You should constantly look for opportunities such as:

Customer purchased X → what might they reasonably need next?

Customer viewed products but didn't purchase → what stopped them?

Customer abandoned checkout → how should we recover them?

Customer hasn't purchased in 6 months → should we reactivate them?

Customer owns a particular vehicle → what relevant maintenance/product campaigns could we create?

Customer purchased one component of a repair → are there complementary products we should recommend?

We want intelligent segmentation rather than blasting the entire database with the same promotion.

Professional / Repair Shop Marketing

We also serve professional automotive repair businesses.

This audience should be treated differently from DIY consumers.

You may develop campaigns around:

New Pro account onboarding
Getting approved Pros to place their first order
Reordering
Dormant account reactivation
New brands/products
Special pricing
Repair-shop-specific promotions
Quote/RFQ follow-up
Customer relationship nurturing
Account engagement
Product availability
Shop purchasing behavior
Pro portal adoption

The objective is to make AutoBuffy something professional customers continue coming back to use.

Klaviyo

Strong Klaviyo experience is highly preferred.

We expect you to understand more than simply creating an email.

You should understand:

Segments
Profiles
Events
Flows
Campaigns
Triggers
Conditional logic
Dynamic content
Personalization
Deliverability
A/B testing
Revenue attribution
List health
Suppression
Customer lifecycle stages

You should be able to look at our existing setup and identify what we're missing.

AI-First Marketing

We strongly encourage the use of AI.

You should be comfortable using tools such as:

Claude
ChatGPT
Other AI marketing tools
Automation tools

We want AI to make you faster and more productive, not replace your judgment.

For example, AI might help you:

Analyze customer segments
Generate campaign concepts
Research automotive repair/maintenance topics
Produce multiple copy variations
Personalize campaigns
Analyze campaign results
Identify patterns in customer behavior
Develop A/B testing ideas
Build campaign calendars
Analyze customer feedback

We expect a modern marketer to use AI to accomplish significantly more than was previously possible.

How We Think About Marketing

We do NOT want:

"It's Tuesday, so let's send an email."

We want:

Customer Data → Opportunity → Segment → Hypothesis → Campaign → Test → Revenue → Learning

For example:

Not:

"Let's send a brake-parts email."

Instead:

"We identified 18,000 customers who previously purchased front brake components but haven't purchased related rear components. I want to test this targeted campaign against a control group and measure incremental revenue and contribution."

That is the level of thinking we're looking for.

What Success Looks Like

You will NOT be judged primarily on:

Number of emails sent
Open rates
Number of campaigns created
Number of SMS messages sent
How pretty an email looks

Those can be useful diagnostic metrics.

But ultimately, we care about:

Revenue from owned channels
Incremental campaign revenue
Contribution/profit from campaigns
Repeat purchase rate
Customer reactivation
Abandoned-cart recovery
Flow revenue
Revenue per recipient
Pro activation rate
Pro reorder rate
Customer retention
Lifetime value

We want marketing that makes money.

Required Experience

You should have strong hands-on experience with:

E-commerce Email Marketing
Lifecycle Marketing
Retention Marketing
Klaviyo
Customer Segmentation
Marketing Automation
Campaign Strategy
A/B Testing
Customer Retention
E-commerce Analytics
Email/SMS Campaigns
Remarketing
Strongly Preferred

Experience with:

Large e-commerce catalogs
Automotive
Automotive aftermarket
Technical products
B2B e-commerce
B2C e-commerce
Repair shops
Customer loyalty
Cross-selling
Upselling
Customer reactivation
Google Analytics / GA4
PostHog or behavioral analytics
CRM systems
AI-assisted marketing workflows
What We DON'T Want

Please do not apply if your primary experience is:

Social media posting
Influencer marketing
Graphic design
General virtual assistance
Writing newsletters without strategy
Generic "digital marketing"
Running campaigns without measuring revenue

We are looking for a lifecycle/retention marketer who understands e-commerce economics.

Individual Applicants Only

We are looking for an individual who can become deeply familiar with our customers and business.

No agencies.

We want the person applying to be the person actually doing the work.

Hours

We expect this role to begin around 10-20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a larger long-term role based on performance and workload.

We care about results and ownership, not simply filling hours.

title: Supply Chain Manager for Growing US Fashion E-Commerce Brand (Long-Term)
description:
We're a US-based women's fashion e-commerce brand shipping to the US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. We run several hundred active products and process a few thousand orders a month, sourced through Chinese suppliers.

We're looking for one person to own our supply chain end to end. Right now these tasks are spread across the team and things fall through the cracks — we want someone who takes it over and makes it their responsibility.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

1. Product quality and listing accuracy
Check incoming products against what's shown on our website. Catch mismatches before customers do — wrong colour, wrong fabric, sheer where the listing says lined, poor stitching. Flag anything that shouldn't be sold and tell us why.

2. Shipment monitoring
We have an automated dashboard that flags problem orders — failed deliveries, shipments stuck past 14 days, orders unfulfilled past 48 hours. Your job is to work that list daily: find out what happened, get it resolved with the supplier, and keep our customer support team in the loop so nobody is left waiting.

3. Supplier relationship management
Daily communication with our Chinese supplier. Chasing stock, restocks, quotes, delivery timelines, and quality complaints. You'll be our main point of communication with them, and you'll need to be persistent without being difficult.

4. Size charts (Chinese to US conversion)
Our suppliers provide measurements in Chinese sizing and centimetres. Our customers are American. Sizing complaints are one of our biggest sources of returns, so getting this right directly affects the business. You'll build and verify accurate US size charts for each product.

Start your response with:"strawberry" if you have read everything.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Coachable — we'll show you our systems and written procedures. You follow them, and tell us when you think they're wrong.
- Proactive — you spot problems and bring solutions, rather than waiting to be assigned tasks.
- Manager mindset — this is an ownership role, not a task-taking role. You'll be trusted to run this area.
- Available daily — supply chain problems don't wait. We need someone consistently available on weekdays.
- Wants to learn — we're growing, and this role grows with us.

NICE TO HAVE (not required)

- Experience working with Chinese suppliers or wholesale sourcing platforms
- Working knowledge of spreadsheets
- Familiarity with Shopify
- Mandarin language skills (helpful for supplier communication, not essential)


DETAILS

- Hours: 7 hours per week to start, with room to grow
- Long-term position — we're hiring someone to stay, not for a one-off project
- Some overlap with US Eastern time preferred


HOW TO APPLY

Please don't send a generic proposal — we read every application and generic ones get skipped.

title: Long Form VSL Copywriter
description:
About Us

We're a fast-growing direct response supplement brand on track to hit 8 figures in annual revenue within our first fiscal year. We scaled from $0 to $1M/month in a matter of months, and we're pushing toward $5M/month.

That growth runs on long form copy & VSLs, so we need fresh ones going out consistently. 

That's where you come in.

About the Role

We're looking for a long-form VSL copywriter to work with us on an ongoing basis, new scripts shipping every week.

This is for someone who can reliably turn around strong long-form VSLs week after week without us having to hand-hold the process.

If that sounds like you, keep reading.

What the Engagement Looks Like

Ship new material on a weekly basis
Research and tear down winning VSLs using Ad Library, Atria, AdSpy, etc. 
Develop the big ideas, leads, and unique mechanisms strong enough to carry a full VSL and hold a cold audience the whole way through.
Where needed, write the supporting assets that feed a VSL like short-form hooks and cutdowns, advertorials, listicles, quizzes, landing and product pages.
Use performance data to sharpen the next script.
Work closely enough with our creative team to hand off scripts that are ready to produce.

The Ideal Candidate

You're fluent in English.
You've written for supplements or health DTC brands.
You've written VSLs with real money behind them.
You understand long-form structure cold: lead types, mechanism development, proof sequencing, pacing, open loops, and the close.
You've launched in tier 1 markets (US, UK, AU, CA).
You can hold a consistent weekly output without quality dropping (reliability matters as much as talent here).
You're not a robot, you come with ideas.
You love the game: you study, buy courses, join paid groups, etc.
You have your own AI workflows or prompts.
You can take direct feedback.
You know the compliance ropes of the health niche.

What's In It For You

Strong pay + performance bonuses on ad spend
A steady, predictable stream of work
Non-corporate, low-friction culture
Minimal meetings (under 2 hrs/week)
Long-term partnership potential

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Live product, launching soon. We need a senior dev to revamp the UI, fix performance, optimize AI costs, and get us App Store + web ready for our first users.

We want someone creative and opinionated! Not just executing tasks but helping to shape the product. We intend for there to be clear communication on every decision.

We expect to do it in a phased approach; after each phase we intend to incorporate user feedback.


Priorities 
Both timing and sequencing is open - we want your input on the right order. 

Phase 1:  Core functions, rock solid
User onboarding + initial data collection
Checklist, Budget, and Inbox working perfectly. 
Fix broken flows. Some features aren't fully wired up (e.g. differentiated user roles continue to give the same experience). Audit what's working, what's half-built, and what's broken.
Optimize AI usage and spend from day 1 
TestFlight via Capacitor. App Store + web, same experience

Phase 2: Explore tab
Fix generation in the Explore tab. Target: under 1 second, accurate photos, Reels/Hinge style swiping. 
Build a recommendation algorithm driven by what the user tells us and what they do - dwell time on certain venues, saves, data collection via chat or voice bot
AI chatbot improvement - improve conversational flow
 
Phase 3:
UI overhaul every tab. We have built an MVP but parts may need to be reworked. Every screen needs to feel premium and warm, not spreadsheet-like! 

Ongoing:
AI cost optimization. Ensure we have the most efficient but cost effective model. We're model-agnostic (aware of OpenRouter). No migrating on a hunch.

Other priorities: consider AWS migration, full framework rewrite, Android. 


Stack
•  Python + FastAPI backend
•  Vanilla JS PWA frontend (would like to move to React)
•  Supabase (Postgres, auth, storage)
•  Multi-model AI (reasoning model + fast cheap model, vision, web search, structured outputs)
•  Docker, Railway
•  No test suite, no linter currently.


Required
•  Strong frontend skills (consumer apps that feel premium, not dashboards)
•  Python / FastAPI
•  PostgreSQL / Supabase
•  Multiple AI/LLM APIs — can compare providers on quality, speed, cost
•  Prompt caching, model routing, cost optimization
•  Consumer / lifestyle app experience
•  GitHub, English fluency
•  App Store / TestFlight


Nice to Have
•  Capacitor / Ionic (web → native)
•  OpenRouter
•  CI/CD, Docker
•  AWS or Azure production deployments
•  Monitoring (Sentry, Datadog)

Important: Please start your proposal with the word "TRADES" so I know you've actually read this posting. Proposals that don't include it will not be considered.

What You'll Do:

Make high-volume outbound calls to candidates
Conduct phone interviews with candidates
Schedule interviews and coordinate calendars
Check references

What We're Looking For:

Proven experience recruiting in the staffing/staffing agency industry (not just corporate in-house recruiting)
Strong background in high-volume recruiting
Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and Indeed/job board sourcing
Background recruiting for manufacturing and/or construction skilled trades strongly preferred
Comfortable on the phone all day, organized, and able to move fast

Contract Details:

Start: ~10 to 30 hours/week for 3-4 weeks to support an active staffing project
Ongoing: Potential for continued as-needed work as we grow — flexibility on both sides is important

We’re looking for a **reliable Scripted Calling Agent & Customer Service Representative** to join our remote team.

The ideal candidate can follow a structured script while keeping conversations natural, communicate professionally with customers, and accurately document each interaction.

### 📞 Responsibilities

* Handle inbound and/or outbound calls using provided scripts.
* Communicate with customers clearly and professionally.
* Follow the required call flow and project guidelines.
* Listen carefully and understand customer questions or concerns.
* Provide accurate information based on the provided resources.
* Qualify customer needs when required.
* Record call notes, responses, and outcomes accurately.
* Escalate issues that require additional assistance.
* Maintain a positive and professional customer experience.

**$20–$45/hour**

The final rate may depend on experience, communication skills, responsibilities, call quality, and overall performance.

### ⭐ What We’re Looking For

* Clear spoken English and strong communication skills.
* Good listening and conversational ability.
* Comfortable following scripts and instructions.
* Professional, patient, and reliable.
* Basic computer skills.
* Stable internet connection and a suitable workspace.
* Previous experience in customer service, calling, surveys, sales, or appointment setting is a plus.

We value **quality conversations over rushed calls** and want someone who can represent the project professionally.

All contracts, time tracking, and payments will be handled through **Upwork**.

**Apply with a short introduction and tell us about your relevant experience and availability.**

title: Creative Video Editor for Personal Brand — TikTok & Instagram
description:
I'm starting a personal channel on TikTok and Instagram — a private account, not a company one. Two content pillars, roughly half and half:

1.	Thoughts and commentary on what's going on in the world — talking head, text-driven cuts, essay pacing

2.	Leisure and life — music, going out, travel, food, everyday moments — visual, mood-driven, little or no talking

The tone is personal and direct. Nothing corporate, no product content, no ads.

I write the scripts and shoot the raw material. I'm looking for one reliable editor who turns that into finished, ready-to-post content, long-term.

What you'll do

•	Edit TikToks and Reels from my footage, photos and voice-overs, following scripts and references I provide

•	Build Instagram Story sets from supplied images, text and templates

•	Cut and rescue raw material: trim, restructure, colour, audio clean-up, stabilise, reframe to 9:16

•	Add captions, on-screen text, hooks, B-roll, light motion graphics

•	Produce German and English versions of the same core piece — different subtitles and on-screen text, sometimes a different cut and pace

•	Occasionally build short AI-assisted sequences: morphing my own photos into moving shots (Seedance, Pollo.ai or similar) for Stories and trailer-style cuts — a few seconds per video, as an accent, always labelled (see the rules section)

•	Deliver export-ready files per platform, plus the project file and a short asset log with every video
Volume

•	8–12 finished videos per month (2–3 per week) plus Story sets, scaling up if it works

•	48–72 hours turnaround per video after handover

•	One revision round per deliverable; I batch my feedback and give timecodes


Tools

Your choice, as long as quality holds and you can hand over editable project files: CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Photoshop / Figma / Canva. Tell me what you actually work in.
For AI sequences I'd like to work with Seedance / Pollo.ai or an equivalent image-to-video tool. Experience there is a plus, not a requirement — but tools must be agreed with me before any of my material goes into them.

Languages

Content runs in German and English. You need English at a professional level and either working German (B2+) or a proven, careful process for handling German copy exactly as I supply it — subtitles and on-screen text with no introduced errors. If German isn't yours, tell me honestly how you'd handle it; I'd rather have a good editor with a good process than a mediocre native speaker.

Rules I need you to work within

I'm in Germany, so a few things are non-negotiable. None of it is complicated once it's a habit — I'll give you the full one-pager after hiring.

1.	Music. I decide the track per video, and I'll tell you which of two routes applies. For posts that stay inside the platform, we can use the app's own music library. For anything that might be reused elsewhere, the track comes from my licensed library subscription. Never pull audio from YouTube, SoundCloud, a rip, or a purchased download — buying a track is not a licence to use it under video.

2.	AI content must be labelled. Every AI-generated or AI-morphed sequence gets three things: the platform's AI toggle, an on-screen "KI-generiert / AI-generated" marker in the first second of the sequence, and a line in the caption. Non-negotiable — this is EU AI Act and platform policy, not a preference.

3.	AI only on my own images, never on other identifiable people, never to depict a real event or a real public figure.

4.	Stock, fonts, templates, effects: commercial licences only, and the receipts come to me with the deliverable. Some CapCut templates and effects are personal-use only — check before building a house style on one.

5.	No broadcaster or news-agency footage as B-roll. Ever.

6.	Anyone recognisable other than me gets flagged to me — I confirm consent or you blur/cut them. Same for licence plates, house numbers, name plates, screens with messages.

7.	Asset log per video: music track and licence reference, stock IDs, fonts, AI tool and prompt. Three minutes of work, and it's how I stay out of trouble.

8.	Confidentiality and data handling. My raw material stays in the agreed toolset, isn't uploaded anywhere else, and gets deleted after an agreed window. There's an NDA and a GDPR data processing agreement to sign; if you're outside the EU that's a standard annex, nothing dramatic.

9.	Rights. You grant me exclusive, worldwide, unlimited rights of use in what you create for me, including the right to edit. Portfolio use is fine with my written OK, per piece.
If some of this is new to you, say so plainly in your application — it isn't a knock-out. Working around it quietly is.

How we'd work

•	Raw material, scripts and references in shared OneDrive / SharePoint folders, one per video, with a short brief

•	Feedback through Upwork Messages with timecodes

•	Weekly async check-in

•	Time tracked through Upwork

•	I'm in Central European Time (Europe/Berlin) — you don't need to match it, but I'd like a few overlapping hours
Rate & start

•	Hourly, $12–20, depending on experience — tell me your rate

•	5–10 hours a week to start, room to grow

•	I'd like to begin with a small paid test project: one video plus one Story set from material I supply, at your normal rate, capped at 4 hours

•	The goal is a long-term collaboration, not a one-off

To apply

Skip the generic cover letter. I'll only read applications with:

1.	2–3 links to short-form videos you edited yourself, and what exactly was your work on each

2.	What tools you work in, and whether you've used AI image-to-video tools

3.	Your German and English level, and how you'd handle German subtitles

4.	Your hourly rate and realistic weekly availability

title: TikTok Marketing & E-Commerce Sales Expert — Proven Track Record Required
description:
We are looking for an experienced **TikTok marketing and e-commerce sales expert** who has a proven track record of successfully advertising, promoting, and selling physical products through TikTok.

This is not a position for someone who has simply managed social media accounts. We are looking for someone who understands how to turn TikTok traffic into **actual product sales**.

### Responsibilities

* Develop and execute a TikTok marketing strategy for our products
* Create and test product-focused TikTok content and advertising campaigns
* Identify winning hooks, angles, trends, and creative concepts
* Manage and optimize TikTok Ads campaigns
* Help grow sales through **TikTok Shop**, where applicable
* Analyze campaign performance, including ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rate, and other relevant metrics
* Recommend improvements to product pages, offers, pricing, creatives, and funnels
* Identify and coordinate with TikTok creators/influencers when appropriate
* Continuously test new creatives and advertising strategies
* Scale campaigns that demonstrate profitable results

### Required Experience

You must have:

* **Proven experience selling products through TikTok**
* Experience with TikTok Ads Manager
* Experience developing TikTok creatives specifically designed to generate sales
* Strong understanding of direct-response marketing
* Experience testing and scaling paid campaigns
* Ability to provide examples or case studies showing measurable results
* Strong understanding of current TikTok trends, algorithms, hooks, and short-form video strategy

### AI Experience Is a Plus

Experience using AI tools to improve marketing performance is highly preferred, including:

* AI-generated or AI-assisted video content
* AI product advertisements
* AI voiceovers and avatars
* AI-assisted copywriting and scripting
* Automated creative testing
* AI tools for content research, competitor analysis, and campaign optimization

We are especially interested in someone who understands how to combine **AI + TikTok + e-commerce** to produce content efficiently and increase sales.

### When Applying

Please include:

1. Examples of products you have successfully marketed or sold through TikTok.
2. Specific results you achieved, such as sales, ROAS, CPA, or revenue.
3. Screenshots or other evidence of campaign performance, if available.
4. Your experience with TikTok Shop.
5. The AI tools you currently use for advertising, content creation, or e-commerce.
6. A brief explanation of how you would approach launching a new physical product on TikTok.

**Please do not submit a generic proposal.** We are specifically looking for someone who can demonstrate that they have successfully used TikTok to generate product sales.

This has the potential to become a **long-term position** for the right person if you can consistently produce measurable results.

description:
I am looking for an experienced legal consultant with strong expertise in commercial lease agreements to assist my business with drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a commercial lease for a business property.
Entering into a commercial lease without proper legal review is one of the most costly mistakes a business can make. Hidden clauses, unfavorable renewal terms, unclear maintenance obligations, and poorly defined exit provisions can expose a business to significant financial and legal risk over the life of a lease. I need a senior legal advisor who understands commercial property law, lease negotiation, and business protection to ensure every term in this agreement works in my favor before I sign anything.

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist (E-Commerce Car Parts)
description:
This is a USA EST Role, you must be able to work within our hours for at least 4 hours a day. 

We are an established automotive e-commerce company looking for an experienced Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist to take ownership of improving conversion across our entire customer journey.

This is not a graphic design position.

This is not a position where you simply audit our website, give us 50 recommendations, and disappear.

We're looking for someone who continuously asks:

Where are customers dropping off? Why is it happening? What does the data tell us? What should we test? And did the experiment actually make the business more money?

You will work directly with our CEO (who is a coder himself) and development team. We can implement changes quickly.

Your primary responsibility is figuring out WHAT deserves to be improved, WHY, what we should TEST, and whether it actually WORKED.

What You'll Own

You will analyze and optimize the complete e-commerce journey:

Traffic → Search/Vehicle Selection → Category → Product → Add to Cart → Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Repeat Customer

Your responsibilities may include:

Analyze GA4 and customer behavior data
Review Microsoft Clarity/session recordings
Identify major funnel drop-offs
Analyze mobile vs. desktop conversion
Analyze conversion by traffic source and landing page
Investigate product discovery and search behavior
Identify PDP conversion opportunities
Identify cart and checkout friction
Identify opportunities to increase AOV
Identify opportunities to increase repeat purchases
Analyze new vs. returning customers
Analyze different customer segments
Develop hypotheses supported by evidence
Prioritize opportunities based on expected business impact
Maintain a prioritized experimentation backlog
Design A/B tests
Define primary and guardrail metrics before launching tests
Create clear experiment requirements for developers
QA experiments before launch
Analyze experiment results
Document wins, losses, and learnings
Continuously determine what we should test next

We don't want someone focused on only one page.

You own finding conversion opportunities across the entire customer journey.

How We Think About CRO

We don't want:

"I think this page would look better if..."

We want:

Data → Problem → Hypothesis → Experiment → Measurement → Learning → Next Experiment

For example:

Not:

"The PDP needs a redesign."

Instead:

"Mobile visitors without confirmed vehicle fitment convert significantly worse. Session behavior suggests uncertainty around compatibility. I recommend testing X. Here is the evidence, hypothesis, primary metric, guardrails, and engineering requirement."

Our developers can then implement the experiment.

You measure what happens.

If it wins, great.

If it loses, that's okay too.

We want someone who learns from the result rather than trying to prove every idea was correct.

What We Measure

We care about business outcomes such as:

Conversion Rate
Revenue Per Visitor / Session
Gross Profit or Contribution Per Visitor
Add-to-Cart Rate
Checkout Completion Rate
Average Order Value
Repeat Purchase Rate
Customer Lifetime Value

Increasing conversion while destroying AOV or profitability is not necessarily a win.

We want someone who understands the economics behind the metrics.

Required Experience

We're looking for someone with strong hands-on experience in:

E-commerce Conversion Rate Optimization
A/B Testing
GA4
Funnel Analysis
Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, FullStory, or similar tools
Behavioral Analysis
Experiment Design
Statistical Analysis / Significance
Product Page Optimization
Cart & Checkout Optimization
Mobile Conversion Optimization
Data Analysis

You should be comfortable working directly with developers and turning your hypotheses into clear implementation requirements.

Strongly Preferred

Experience with:

Large-catalog e-commerce
Technical products
Automotive
Electronics
Industrial products
Hardware
Parts
Marketplaces
Google Tag Manager
PostHog
Customer research
Lifecycle/retention optimization
Basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript understanding
AI Experience

Experience using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, or other AI tools is a plus.

You do not need to be a software engineer.

We care much more about finding someone with exceptional CRO judgment, analytical ability, and commercial thinking.

Our technical team can implement your ideas.

About AutoBuffy

AutoBuffy is an automotive e-commerce company selling aftermarket automotive parts across a large catalog.

Automotive e-commerce presents an interesting conversion challenge:

Customers aren't simply deciding whether they like a product.

They need confidence that they're purchasing the correct part for their specific vehicle and repair.

Our long-term goal is to make buying automotive parts remarkably simple, accurate, informative, and trustworthy.

We already have meaningful traffic and sales.

Your job is to help us generate more profitable customers from the traffic and opportunities we already have.

Hours & Relationship

We expect to begin around 15–20 hours per week.

This is intended to be a long-term relationship, and the role can grow based on performance and business needs.

We care more about the quality of your thinking and results than simply filling hours.

Individual Applicants Only — No Agencies

We are looking for an individual CRO professional who wants to become deeply familiar with one e-commerce business.

No agencies.
